chapters.title: Chapter 2530 The Curtains Draw Close! III
paragraphs: Along with a ridiculous 50% Convergence right at its founding, the Thanatos Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity domineeringly took up space within Noah's soul as a verdant obsidian deathly light spread out!
{The features of Quintessential Undead Rise, Quintessential Thanatos Embodiment, and Chthonian Sinners of Thanatos have been born!}
Three dazzling features bloomed as Noah's visions of what he saw in Adumbrative Viewpoint were coming closer to fruition and even being exceeded.
However potent this feature used to be, it was now something else entirely after the changes Noah made for the forging of the Quintessential Absolute Thanatos Dynamis of Extremity.
And this showed itself clearly with just the first feature.

{Quintessential Undead Rise}:: Death is not the end. The authority of Thanatos burns strong as it allows you to gaze upon the masses, and from among those who have perished- you can cause the rise of something even grander in their stead. This ability is both an active and a passive one that requires 5% of your Maximum Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values to express the passive and active effects every minute. Quintessential Undead Rise utilizes the authority of the Thanatos Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity to re-write the Recorded Histories of all affected perished existences, transforming them into Quintessential Undead Thanatos Vassals who live only for the glory of the authority of Thanatos. Each Quintessential Undead Thanatos Vassal will undergo such a drastic change in their Recorded History as while the fresh form they will take is random, each one will have at a minimum 10 Apex Thanatos Soul Values- no matter which type of Lifeform they originally spawned from...}

{...When Quintessential Undead Rise is triggered against perished existences who have more than 10 Apex Thanatos Soul Values, it will transform their Recorded Histories to grant them their original Parameter Values and then further enhance them by 100%. All of the Thanatos Vassals will become bound to your soul and follow your will as they will continue to endlessly spawn from perished existences until a certain threshold is reached- this threshold is based on the level of power that the Boundaries supporting Thanatos have currently reached. Legions of Quintessential Undead Thanatos Vassals will form across the land as when the authority of death and chaos is potent enough, even more powerful Vassals will rise until the grandeur of Thanatos is spread across the vicissitudes of reality...}
A dreadful offensive ability of horrendous proportions came!

An ability that granted Noah Legions of Quintessential Undead Thanatos Vassals as the maximum number was still not known- and it could only be determined by the power of the 21 Boundaries that Thanatos was forged from.
The most ridiculous thing was that no matter what corpse Noah triggered Quintessential Undead Rise from...a terror with a minimum of 10 Apex Thanatos Soul Values would be born.
An Apex Aeonic Lifeform...born on any corpse Noah gazed upon and extended this dreadful authority!
It was so balance breaking that the only semblance of any balance stemmed from the fact that this ability required corpses.
It required perished existences to re-write the Recorded Histories of as if Noah could simply summon them freely...the scales would be even more destroyed!

When he utilized it on dead Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who exceeded 10 Apex Aeonic Soul Values, they would rise into random Quintessential Undead Thanatos Vassals that retained their original power...and then received a 100% boost all around for it as Noah truly didn't have any words for this terrible feature.

And it would cost him nothing to retain all of these Thanatos Vassals as when they continued to be forged in the upcoming battles...Legions of such terrors would be following behind the Shadow of Alexander King!
At this moment, the words of Commander Vladic in the vision showed from the {Adumbrative Viewpoint} crossed Noah's mind as he smiled.
He could now understand why this Noblesse had called him a Demon.
But...no matter what distinction he was given, after the changes he had made- things were bound to get even more ecstatic!
"Unbelievable..."
Aurelia uttered out in a daze as she felt the budding Seed in her soul.
Was it truly...an Absolute Seed of Extremity?
Something like that had actually bloomed in her soul?!
It was so surreal that she felt golden tears inadvertently form on the rims of her eyes- tears that were then outshone by the golden words that appeared before her eyes.
{An Unnamed Absolute Dynamis of Extremity has been born.}
The words affirmed her current reality as she felt the brilliant seed in her soul- a seed that seemed to be asking her to name it!
Fortune and grandeur overflowed in her Aspects of Existence as she calmed down.
She then called out lightly.
"Thesauros."
WAA!
{The Thesauros Absolute Dynamis of Extremity has formed under unprecedented circumstances- the resonance of concepts within it placing its rate of Convergence at 20%}
Thesauros.
A word that was closely related to a treasury or location where profound riches and treasures were collected and laid out.
This was the first Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that the True Emperor of Fortune forged under the guidance of the True Emperor of Quintessence!
It was also the second existence within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven to achieve such a feat!
It showed the rapid pace of progression of a power that was relatively unknown at this point in time in the Aeonic Havens of Extremity.
It showed that the grandeur the True Emperor of Quintessence held was something that could also be expressed by those around him!
When the Infinite Hyperversal Haven fully unveiled itself and all of its wonders in the future to come...just how would the myriad of Inheritances and Clans compare?!

{Name}:: Dr. Hall
{Realm}:: Aeonic Vital Haven
{Lineage}:: Human
{Titles}:: The Doctor, Master of Medicine, Big Pharma...
{Vital Apex Mana Value}:: 20
{Vital Apex Vitality Value}:: 200
{Vital Apex Soul Value}:: 20
{Vital Apex Defense Value}:: 200
{Vital Apex Damage Value}:: 20
{Dynamis of Extremity}:: None
{Boundaries of Extremity}:: Medicine, Prana, Life, Antediluvian, Genesis, Manadynamics, Biochemistry, Epidemiology, Essensology, Pharmacology...

chapters.title: Chapter 2531 The Curtains Draw Close! IV
paragraphs: In a blinding stellar region filled with churning liquified essence of Dissolution distorting space constantly.

This essence felt vile and majestic at the same time as any being with weak Aspects of Existence nearing it could be corroded in a short period of time, and rivers of this essence seemed to be extending from all directions like endless branches and joining together into a vast sea- a sea that formed an interminable wall before the eyes of all beings who had managed to make it this far as it had no end in sight.

The wall seemed liquid and solid at the same time as it was akin to countless branches intersecting together...as if it was the junction between an outer layer of the Vein of Dissolution and an inner layer!

Within the veins of Existences, they were composed of the tunica adventitia which was the outer layer, the tunica media which was the middle layer, and the tunica intima which was the innermost layer lined up by smooth endothelial cells.
This region...seemed akin to the junction from the outer and into the middle layer!

In between the surging conjoining rivers and branches of Dissolution, Obsidian Extremity Panaceas could be seen floating serenely as they dared any beings brave enough to attain them- with massive Leviathans of Dissolution nearing 1 Apex Aeonic Soul Values roaring out in this region as powerful Scions like Erikson, Atlas of the Plum Sword of Extremity, and Lodovico among others could be seen.

Their bodies released blinding radiance and power as they had forged their Extremity Foundations, beings like Atlas having even attained a Dynamis of Extremity as the power they released was enough to rival Leviathans of Dissolution who were almost nearing a singular Apex Aeonic Value!

They still fought as apart from Obsidian Extremity Panaceas, there were also blinding singularities of Aeonic Treasures of Extremity that were either precious loot that allowed one to traverse towards the 10th Boundary Layer with ease, aid in forging a Dynamis of Extremity, or Panaceas that were useful in reinforcing one's foundation.
They fought tooth and nail as all of them felt the urgency that others had begun to openly mention the last few hours.
That the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification was close to an end!
That the Extremity Panaceas were becoming rarer to find unless one came in this region where a massive wall of a sea of dissolution stopped the advancement of any beings forward!
The reason for this could all be attributed to a single being.
BOOOM!

While others were struggling or grouping up against the Leviathans of Dissolution nearing the power of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, any single one that he came across was bullied into oblivion as the visage of the Quintessential Emperor of Extremity had just ripped apart five Leviathans of Dissolution who were guarding a group of Loot filled singularities right before the endless barrier of Dissolution.

The one to bring everything to an early end was none other than the True Emperor of Quintessence as he had his Reified Sources of Extremity sweep away all obstacles easily while obtaining an overabundance of Loot himself!

It was to the extent that apart from the Loot stemming from the two Apex Aeonic Lifeforms he had killed, Aeonic Treasures of Extremity that were conducive to elevating Boundaries, forming Dynamis of Extremity, and the faster Convergence of Dynamis of Extremity were within his hands in abundance.
Each of them held a myriad of names like the Blazing Hyphae of Extremity, Glacial Perennial Hartwig, Radiant Moon Grass, Singularity Torn Bud...and many more.

When categorizing them, Noah was able to quantify 233 Aeonic Treasures of Extremity geared towards helping the progression of Boundaries up to the 13th Boundary Layer, many others sharing this quality like the Blazing Hyphae of Extremity!

There were 198 Aeonic Treasures of Extremity geared towards increasing the chances of the successful Convergence of Boundaries into a Dynamis of Extremity- these beings things utterly useless to Noah as he would actually have to try really hard to be capable of failing in forming a Dynamis of Extremity.
But they would be invaluable for his people, so even they held their importance.
Lastly, he had scoured and attained 174 Aeonic Treasures of Extremity geared towards increasing the rate of Convergence of already formed Dynamis of Extremity!
It was a heavy haul for a single being, and this wasn't counting the Extremity Panaceas he collected for the Shadowlings of the Cult of Endless Shadows and others he kept for his own collection.

All in all, he had dominated the Scions that had risen up in this stage of the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification, and he now stood before a huge demarcation of a barrier that seemed to be something only Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could cross!

His eyes were full of calm as he had utilized the feature of {Adumbrative Viewpoint} greatly these past moments with the might of Alexander, finding out many more things in the unfolding future as he understood that this wall...would only begin to buzz and initiate a profound new process when the last set of Crimson Extremity Panaceas were plucked.
Yes.
A set!
He had seen this with his own will as his body in this junction of a space filled with Dissolution turned away and gazed towards an entirely different direction.
The hidden space far away from here when the set of Crimson Extremity Panaceas would bloom...and where the visage of Ayame of Infinite Extremity was hidden.

The horn on her forehead shone with a Crimson gold glint at this moment as she seemed like a priestess of flames and honor, her figure hidden from others as the region she was in had been enacted with veils that masked the very Records of this area!
If others were to look- even Scions like Lodovico may be fooled into seeing an Altered Record than was currently happening.

Because as fewer and fewer Extremity Panaceas remained with tens of thousands of Scions struggling for even a smidgen of an edge in order to stand out on the stage of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms about to unfold, a heavy aura and a blinding crimson light had begun to blare from this region!

It was a light that would normally tell others and cause them to rush here to fight for one of the ultimate opportunities, but Ayame's fearsome means contained it all as she gazed towards a blooming Singularity with great expectations.
That is until...
WAP!
Her eyes flashed as her gaze changed, turning towards her left side as she saw the Altered Recorded she had set up be twisted as an existence calmly stepped in!
An air of majesty emanated from him as he was none other than the Reified Source of Dreams.
The Dreamer of Extremity carrying Noah's devilishly handsome visage and adorned in sandy gold robes appeared at this position that nobody else should have been able to discern!

chapters.title: Chapter 2532 The Curtains Draw Close! V
paragraphs: "You came."
Ayame turned to focus on the visage of Noah's Dreamer of Extremity as she spoke calmly, but one could still see a sense of veiled surprise deep in her eyes!
Noah gazed at the center of the blooming Singularity whose blooming would mean the end of one stage and the start of another as he asked with a smile.
"Were you actually expecting me?"

"I was expecting that if there was anyone who might exceed all my expectations and appear at such a critical juncture, it had to be you." Her eyes shone with profound brilliance as her will delved into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
She looked at Noah, and then turned to look at the crimson light that was blooming with even more intensity than the first Panacea as she seemingly came to a decision, her voice ringing out in waves.

"There are many theories I have of you, but being the first to observe you when you dealt with the Scions of the Genesis Institute of Extremity and then watching you move against all others in the past days...it has made me realize that you and I may be on the same path."
WAA!
"Oh?" Noah held a smile on his face as with his hands behind his back, he floated towards the area where the crimson blooming light was concentrated with immensity!
Ayame didn't stop him as she nodded and continued.
"Yes. You...are also seeking to complete an Aspect of Infinity, are you not?"
An Aspect of Infinity!
If it were the past Noah, he would have been surprised and given Ayame even more interest as he heard more of her shocking words out!
But the current Noah was a vastly different being compared to even an hour ago.

"You think that I am trying to forge the Infinity of Essence while you yourself chase the Infinity of Heat. You wish to promise me information and secrets of your Inheritance of Infinite Extremity to help me achieve what I seek."
His words were akin to a clap of thunder as genuine shock bloomed in Ayame's eyes!
It was because she couldn't believe the words that had come out of Noah's mouth since their implications were too grand.
For him to speak about the things she was planning on saying...
"You...you couldn't have possibly been able to discern all this through future Records. That is only something that Hyperversal Extremities are capable of!"
A heavy thought to have!
A capability that a being like him should not have as it was the only way for him to state what he stated!
Noah smiled as he didn't confirm or deny any of her words.
Something only Hyperversal Extremities could do.
Of course, they could only do such a thing with their means of forming powerful Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!
And Noah...was already doing that in abundance now.
But the subject matter was Infinity.
The Inheritance that was Infinite Extremity was a grand one as those within it sought different Aspects of Infinity- such beings always showing terrifying power!

For the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification, they had only sent forward Ayame as without Noah's participation, she would be one of those who attained the strongest boon here without the help of any others.
This was the behemoth that was the Infinite Extremity- their Hyperversal Extremities being forces that even those from the Seven Clans were wary of.
"Do you know how many beings have successfully expanded the concept of Infinity itself into Extremity?"
Noah retained his smile as he asked a question that Ayame would have asked him if this conversion was going according to her plans.
And she knew this answer as she became even more certain of her thoughts while replying.
"None."
WAA!
"None Recorded in History, anyways."
None!
Nobody had been capable of expanding and taking the concept of Infinity towards Extremity as it was simply too grand.
Too unachievable.
But...would this be the same case for Noah?
HUUM!
His body began to blare with a cerulean brilliance as from the soul of Alexander King in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, the concept of Infinity was roused and began its venture towards Extremity.
Once expanded, Quintessence would do its job and seamlessly take it towards the 9th Boundary Layer as in no time, his main body and Reified Sources of Extremity were able to express it!
A concept others could not take to Extremity.
Noah embarked on its tumultuous path today as his visage began to burn brightly with it while speaking towards Ayame.
"No need for you to appeal to my better nature or promise to aid in my search for infinity. You can have one of the Crimson Extremity Panaceas that is about to bloom...
in exchange for you taking me to the Heart of your Infinite Extremity. From there, I would like to attain any single opportunity of my choosing."
One of the Panaceas about to bloom.
Ayame heard this and connected the dots as she didn't need to take long to nod her head.
"Of course, and while we are in the depths of Infinite Extremity, you may even find yourself unwilling to leave."
Entry into a grand Inheritance and taking an opportunity for himself from it.

Noah was already doing this with the Cult of Endless Shadows as he was now adding an even more powerful Inheritance on top of it, all for the cost of an Extremity Panacea he no longer had any use for!
HOONG!
Behind him, the crimson radiance overflowed as the blossoming Singularity gushed out a small surging sea of essence, all of this contained by Ayame's Altered Record of the surroundings.
Noah's focus came upon the blossoming light as the grandeur of incandescent crystalline Crimson Extremity Panaceas could be seen.
A set.

Two dazzling Panaceas shone with brilliance as unlike other steps on Extremity Sanctification, deviations in how things normally went could slowly be seen within the Extremity Sanctification of Dissolution!

The plucking of these Extremity Panaceas here would effectively start the process of bringing to a close the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification where many powerful Reverend Scions reigned- tens of thousands of them having fought tooth and nail as less than half of them were able to achieve Golden, Obsidian, or Crimson Extremity Panaceas.
Others only gained Aeonic Treasures of Extremity geared towards helping their Boundaries or Dynamis of Extremity.

But those with Extremity Foundation set in place due to the Initiation Step...they would be exploding with power and joining the expanded majesty of the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification as all of this was going towards aiding them in a more rapid progression of Extremity than normal!

They didn't need to cultivate for thousands or millions of years as from the treasures they obtained here, they could make the same advancement as others who had spent a great deal of time traversing towards Extremity.
This was why it was called Extremity Sanctification.

And this was the reason why the Culmination Step that held deep boons for Apex Aeonic Lifeforms...was going to be the main concentrate for all Inheritances wishing to rapidly elevate the power of their forces!
Noah knew all of this would begin to play out as soon as he made a move towards the dazzling Panaceas before him.
And he...did not hesitate.
SAA!
His hands steeped in sandy gold light grabbed the anchored Crimson Extremity Panaceas before him, feeling their pulses in his hands as the moment he did so...
BZZZT!
The surrounding space began to shake.
Not just this region, but the whole vastness within the Extremity Vein of Dissolution was beginning to shake and vibrate with authority!

Having ushered forth this step freely, Noah threw one of the dazzling Crimson Extremity Panaceas towards Ayame while another disappeared towards his Expansive Space, the sonorous voice of Ayame ringing out as she accepted the Panacea and blazed with a fiery light, beginning to absorb its essence right away to establish her Extremity Foundation.

"You have paved the way forward and hastened the arrival and Proliferation of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from a myriad of factions across the Seven Havens. Will you be able to keep your dominance against monsters stuck on the 16th and 17th Boundary Layers as the only thing in their minds is Extremity?"
Was he ready for Apex Aeonic Lifeforms?

The current Scions like Ayame would use their Extremity Foundations to breakthrough and then assimilate the treasures they attained to quickly stabilize their power as Apex Aeonic Lifeforms- with those who had backings of the majestic Clans or potent Inheritances being fed even more resources to propel their strength upwards as they would become renowned Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as the Culmination Step was underway.
When it came to Noah who didn't have the backing of any Inheritance...
"Will I keep my dominance from here on out? Haha!"
His Tyrannical will vibrated with radiance as this was a question that didn't even need answering!

sentences.text: "You came."
Ayame turned to focus on the visage of Noah's Dreamer of Extremity as she spoke calmly, but one could still see a sense of veiled surprise deep in her eyes!
Noah gazed at the center of the blooming Singularity whose blooming would mean the end of one stage and the start of another as he asked with a smile.
"Were you actually expecting me?"

"I was expecting that if there was anyone who might exceed all my expectations and appear at such a critical juncture, it had to be you." Her eyes shone with profound brilliance as her will delved into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
She looked at Noah, and then turned to look at the crimson light that was blooming with even more intensity than the first Panacea as she seemingly came to a decision, her voice ringing out in waves.

"There are many theories I have of you, but being the first to observe you when you dealt with the Scions of the Genesis Institute of Extremity and then watching you move against all others in the past days...it has made me realize that you and I may be on the same path."
WAA!
"Oh?" Noah held a smile on his face as with his hands behind his back, he floated towards the area where the crimson blooming light was concentrated with immensity!
Ayame didn't stop him as she nodded and continued.
"Yes.
You...are also seeking to complete an Aspect of Infinity, are you not?"
An Aspect of Infinity!
If it were the past Noah, he would have been surprised and given Ayame even more interest as he heard more of her shocking words out!
But the current Noah was a vastly different being compared to even an hour ago.
"You think that I am trying to forge the Infinity of Essence while you yourself chase the Infinity of Heat.
You wish to promise me information and secrets of your Inheritance of Infinite Extremity to help me achieve what I seek."
His words were akin to a clap of thunder as genuine shock bloomed in Ayame's eyes!
It was because she couldn't believe the words that had come out of Noah's mouth since their implications were too grand.
For him to speak about the things she was planning on saying...
"You...you couldn't have possibly been able to discern all this through future Records.
That is only something that Hyperversal Extremities are capable of!"
A heavy thought to have!
A capability that a being like him should not have as it was the only way for him to state what he stated!
Noah smiled as he didn't confirm or deny any of her words.
Something only Hyperversal Extremities could do.
Of course, they could only do such a thing with their means of forming powerful Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!
And Noah...was already doing that in abundance now.
But the subject matter was Infinity.
The Inheritance that was Infinite Extremity was a grand one as those within it sought different Aspects of Infinity- such beings always showing terrifying power!

For the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification, they had only sent forward Ayame as without Noah's participation, she would be one of those who attained the strongest boon here without the help of any others.
This was the behemoth that was the Infinite Extremity- their Hyperversal Extremities being forces that even those from the Seven Clans were wary of.
"Do you know how many beings have successfully expanded the concept of Infinity itself into Extremity?"
Noah retained his smile as he asked a question that Ayame would have asked him if this conversion was going according to her plans.
And she knew this answer as she became even more certain of her thoughts while replying.
"None."
WAA!
"None Recorded in History, anyways."
None!
Nobody had been capable of expanding and taking the concept of Infinity towards Extremity as it was simply too grand.
Too unachievable.
But...would this be the same case for Noah?
HUUM!
His body began to blare with a cerulean brilliance as from the soul of Alexander King in the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, the concept of Infinity was roused and began its venture towards Extremity.
Once expanded, Quintessence would do its job and seamlessly take it towards the 9th Boundary Layer as in no time, his main body and Reified Sources of Extremity were able to express it!
A concept others could not take to Extremity.
Noah embarked on its tumultuous path today as his visage began to burn brightly with it while speaking towards Ayame.
"No need for you to appeal to my better nature or promise to aid in my search for infinity.
You can have one of the Crimson Extremity Panaceas that is about to bloom...
in exchange for you taking me to the Heart of your Infinite Extremity.
From there, I would like to attain any single opportunity of my choosing."
One of the Panaceas about to bloom.
Ayame heard this and connected the dots as she didn't need to take long to nod her head.
"Of course, and while we are in the depths of Infinite Extremity, you may even find yourself unwilling to leave."
Entry into a grand Inheritance and taking an opportunity for himself from it.

Noah was already doing this with the Cult of Endless Shadows as he was now adding an even more powerful Inheritance on top of it, all for the cost of an Extremity Panacea he no longer had any use for!
HOONG!
Behind him, the crimson radiance overflowed as the blossoming Singularity gushed out a small surging sea of essence, all of this contained by Ayame's Altered Record of the surroundings.
Noah's focus came upon the blossoming light as the grandeur of incandescent crystalline Crimson Extremity Panaceas could be seen.
A set.

Two dazzling Panaceas shone with brilliance as unlike other steps on Extremity Sanctification, deviations in how things normally went could slowly be seen within the Extremity Sanctification of Dissolution!

The plucking of these Extremity Panaceas here would effectively start the process of bringing to a close the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification where many powerful Reverend Scions reigned- tens of thousands of them having fought tooth and nail as less than half of them were able to achieve Golden, Obsidian, or Crimson Extremity Panaceas.
Others only gained Aeonic Treasures of Extremity geared towards helping their Boundaries or Dynamis of Extremity.

But those with Extremity Foundation set in place due to the Initiation Step...they would be exploding with power and joining the expanded majesty of the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification as all of this was going towards aiding them in a more rapid progression of Extremity than normal!

They didn't need to cultivate for thousands or millions of years as from the treasures they obtained here, they could make the same advancement as others who had spent a great deal of time traversing towards Extremity.
This was why it was called Extremity Sanctification.

And this was the reason why the Culmination Step that held deep boons for Apex Aeonic Lifeforms...was going to be the main concentrate for all Inheritances wishing to rapidly elevate the power of their forces!
Noah knew all of this would begin to play out as soon as he made a move towards the dazzling Panaceas before him.
And he...did not hesitate.
SAA!

BZZZT!

Haha!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2533 The Extremity Vein Rises! I
paragraphs: The Culmination Step which held unknown wonders and boons was one that received the most attention in any Extremity Sanctification.

Even the Extremity Step where only Hyperversal Extremities could truly reign did not receive as much attention- and this had its own profound reasons that many would come to find out in the future to unfold.

The Culmination Step was so favored because of many points, but one of the more common ones was the fact that Aeonic Treasures of Extremity that could aid with Boundaries past the 13th Boundary Layer appeared. During this time of the Initiation Step, Noah had only ever gathered loot similar to the Blazing Hyphae of Extremity that aided one up to the 13th Boundary Layer.

The Culmination Stage was one that forged a generation of powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and future Hyperversal Extremities as Dynamis would be more easily converged here, and the hope of forming an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity...was actually a Recorded History that had come to be in the previous Extremity Sanctifications!
It was a crucial stage.

And Noah had ushered it forth as when the space around them began to tremble, deeply black light began to cluster above Noah's visage as a pure source of Dissolution seemed to be drawn from all around and converging here- this dense authority snaking towards Noah's Dreamer of Extremity and sinking into his body as it tried to sear itself into his soul.
Ayame watched quietly as she knew what was happening.

For the being to have attained any astonishing Recorded feats in the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification, they would be branded with a profound authority that would aid them in the future Steps of Extremity Sanctification.
For the being to obtain the First Extremity Panacea.
For the being to kill the most Leviathans of Dissolution.
For the being to attain the most Aeonic Treasures of Extremity.
For the being that obtained the Last Extremity Panacea!

Normally, all of these feats would be spread out across multiple different beings. But as Ayame gazed towards Noah...she knew that he may just pull in all of these achievements for himself and attain an even grander threshold for the future to come.
The authority of an Aeonic Haven of Extremity.
It was something that any prominently powerful being with grand aspirations would seek to take for themselves, or at the very least- expand what such a Haven stood for as a concept.

But many would come to realize over the years that passed that either their expanded concepts would veer ever further away from what the Haven stood for, and that nobody could ever truly reach Extremity in what the concept of the Haven signified.

Many in the Aeonic Haven of Genesis expanded the concept of Genesis- with unique existences like Orion and Noah also expanding their version of Genesis as none of them truly had a link to what the Aeonic Haven of Genesis stood for.
One would know they weren't on the proper path of Genesis or any other concepts of an Aeonic Haven they expanded when in their Boundary Layers...nothing relating to this Haven itself would be found.
Noah and Orion's concepts of Genesis had no link to the Aeonic Haven of Genesis as they did not correlate with the authority of this Haven.

But if a being was accomplished enough and was able to enact one Recorded History after another within a Haven...they may just accumulate enough understanding and access to the extent that they would be able to truly step on an endless path of the authority of a genuine Aeonic Haven of Extremity!
On this day, Noah Osmont was receiving pure streams of Dissolution as they were forming a brand into his soul- a brand that read with brilliant obsidian grandeur...
{DIS}!
The beginnings of Dissolution.
One of the Seven Aeonic Vaults of Extremity. The Havens of Extremity!
There were the Vaults of Genesis, Helios, and Penumbra.
There were also Vaults of Andromeda, Elera, Oceanus, and Dissolution.

Noah was currently gaining a more distinct connection with the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution as anyone gaining such a distinction would only have an easier time while following the path of Extremity Sanctification!

Ayame watched the scene of such grandeur as above her head, minute traces of such authority formed as they paled in comparison to what Noah had surging into his soul, but they were there nonetheless to show her accomplishments.
With this, she knew that what her Grandfather had predicted would now come to fruition.
Extremity Sanctification would truly begin!
Space warped and twisted with this area as the epicenter, Sources of Chaos running rampant all around as fantastically, thick tentacles of Dissolution began to rise from 0
HOOONG!
The skies and land in the Endless Abyssal Thalassic Caverns of Nullity trembled and shattered for countless light years as if a cataclysm had arrived.
The endless Abyss hidden within it roared out with fervor as the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands that were deeply entrenched in the underside of Dissolution...
they began to rise!
BOOOM!

Space warped and twisted with this area as the epicenter, Sources of Chaos running rampant all around as fantastically, thick tentacles of Dissolution began to rise from the depths of the Abyss that were light years in length and diameter- these tendrils smashing onto the skies and land as the moment they did...the areas they touched seemingly became malleable and began to expand.

The very earthen glacial floor expanded as if countless tectonic plates were shifting below it, all of this change prompted by the tentacles of Dissolution writhing out and expanding from this region and continuing throughout!
Alongside this...the glacial floor split apart with utter glory as from the depths below, one could see the rough yet glorious sheen of a Vein begin to rise.

The throbbing Extremity Vein of Dissolution was rising from its depths ever so slowly as the very Haven of Dissolution split apart and expanded due to it- the expansiveness of this whole Haven about to be increased by an unknown amount!

As this occurred, the thick tentacles of Dissolution caused sparks of anomalies to bloom- singularities that sometimes formed into Planar Seeds ready to bud into Planes of Existence, while other singularities pulsed with a light of Aeonic Treasures of Extremity as they became concealed in the folding and expanding space- some becoming veiled deeply while others floated out grandly in the open!

chapters.title: Chapter 2534 The Extremity Vein Rises! II
paragraphs: Countless tremors spread across the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.

The domains that used to be explored and conquered by the Lernaeans, Noblesse, Quasarians, and Planeswalkers were about to become minuscule and small points on the map, the process taking place being so fantastical that the vast majority of this Haven would continue to be unexplored regions!
As these tremors spread within this Haven...word also spread as invisible tremors reached into the six other Havens, the power lying in wait finally being roused as they began to move.
In the Aeonic Haven of Genesis.
A golden temple stood at the very peak of one of 100 verdant gold mountains, powerful auras prevalent within it as they shot to the skies at this moment.

At the entrance of the golden temple, a Hyperversal Extremity floated out and gazed towards the expanse of grandeur and Planes of Existence littered out across the lands as behind him, dozens of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms rose.
And the mighty voice of the Hyperversal Extremity rang out.
{The time has come for you all to see whether Extremity is within your grasp. If you cannot grasp it in this unfolding Extremity Sanctification...you may never have the chance to even try again.}
Words of caution and mystery rang out as there seemed to be a hidden meaning within them, but the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms nodded without hesitation as the Hyperversal Extremity began to move.
"Let's go."
WAA!
From this mountain, dazzling auras rose and went towards a far away crack between the vast Havens to arrive towards nowhere else other than Dissolution.
On another mountain, another party with slightly less Apex Aeonic Lifeforms rose as one of them asked the Hyperversal Extremity leading them.
"Master, since many of our forces will be arriving there before the Apex War of Annihilation we are supporting starts, will we be adding any more of our Apex Aeonic Lifeforms into it?"
{We will observe and see before this small battle unfolds. If need be, we will...but this should be of little focus to you all.}
The reply was swift as the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms nodded while they followed!
Within the Genesis Institute of Extremity.
Within the Singularity Overseers.
Within the Cult of Endless Shadows.
Within the Sima Clan.
Within the Avernus Clan.
Within the Plum Sword of Extremity...

Inheritances across the Aeonic Havens of Andromeda, Elera, Oceanus...an Innumerable cluster of forces waiting for the start of the expansion and Culmination of The Last Haven began to move at this moment as their Seers or simply potent Hyperversal Extremities had long since sensed the rapid progression of this particular Sanctification.

They swarmed towards an expanding Haven of Dissolution as the Initiation Step came to an end, their arrival just happening to be a day before an Apex War of Annihilation took place as it seemed there would be a much larger audience than what many anticipated.
While waiting for the doors of the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification to open, how likely was it for these clusters of powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms to come and view an unfolding Apex War?
The chance...was extremely high!
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

Noah's Main Body felt the glorious concepts and Dynamis that the other part of his soul expanded, with him being able to express the Boundaries up to the 9th Layer while the Dynamis of Extremity forged by Alexander...would only be accessible to him when this part of his soul grew potent enough to accept their Absolute Seed or Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity!
So he felt the terrible power of the Thanatos Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity with his main body...but he couldn't express its power as it seemed abstruse and far away.
But the Boundary of Infinity that was just expanded...
He felt his endless Mana churn ever faster since its conception.
He felt the other Resources within him flare and jump excitedly.
He felt many minute changes from the expansion of this single concept towards Extremity as he carefully gazed at its details while his figure moved.
He floated across the space busting with the verdant essence of Prana and appeared before his son who rose up in respect.
His main body remained unblemished like all others as he even placed his Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity on pause, almost as if he knew what was about to happen in advance.
Noah smiled as he waved his hands and caused a dazzling Crimson Extremity Panacea to appear, his voice masking its brilliance as he spoke.
"When I took this to solidify my Foundation, I forged the Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Supreme Being Foundation. Forge your own path with it and let's see how far you can go."
From the last 2 Crimson Extremity Panaceas, one had gone to Ayame as the other went to Henry!
The Son of Destiny grasped the Crimson Extremity Panacea with a heavy heart of responsibility as beside him, Adelonly smiled as she stared at father and son.

After this, Noah's gaze turned to the Vassals around him who had their Absolute Vitalistic Clones of Extremity standing beside their main bodies while releasing powerful waves of power, his voice ringing out to address all of them while his visage swirled with the power of Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
"You all have the Foundation, Circulation Modus Operandi, and all other tools that allow you to forge an Absolute Seed of Extremity...and yet you cannot."
WAA!

"The reason for this is that even though you were able to define yourselves with the Concepts due to your Foundations, you do not and have truly expressed these concepts with your Aspects of Existence!"
Yes!
Those closest to him were granted everything from him as many of them had yet to even use the power of their new boundaries to form skills, attack, or even cast their Planar Domains!

"You all grasped the Boundary of Quintessence, but what Quintessential feat have you enacted? You hold the Boundary of Loot, but have you taken down a myriad of enemies to see their very existence turned into caches of Loot? If you truly wish to grasp an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, you must first utilize your newly granted authorities and build a sufficient amount of records with them, and paired with your Extremity Foundations...enacting an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity then would only be a reality."
They heard his words as their Aspects of Existence pulsed.
And as if to hit the nail in the coffin...

"It just so happens that within a day, there will be an Apex War with Ultimate Existences from Lineages and Inheritances who have yet to see the grandeur you all can express. In that battle, you all can create your records and enact your own legends for the eons to come."
BOOOM!
Waves of golden Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity scattered out as the Aspects of Existence of Noah's people roared.
From them...
"RAA!"
Roars and shouts of valor began to echo out as they got ready to delve into a grand war!

He floated across the space busting with the verdant essence of Prana and appeared before his son who rose up in respect.
His main body remained unblemished like all others as he even placed his Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity on pause, almost as if he knew what was about to happen in advance.
Noah smiled as he waved his hands and caused a dazzling Crimson Extremity Panacea to appear, his voice masking its brilliance as he spoke.
"When I took this to solidify my Foundation, I forged the Unrecorded Aeonic Quintessential Supreme Being Foundation.
Forge your own path with it and let's see how far you can go."
From the last 2 Crimson Extremity Panaceas, one had gone to Ayame as the other went to Henry!
The Son of Destiny grasped the Crimson Extremity Panacea with a heavy heart of responsibility as beside him, Adelonly smiled as she stared at father and son.

After this, Noah's gaze turned to the Vassals around him who had their Absolute Vitalistic Clones of Extremity standing beside their main bodies while releasing powerful waves of power, his voice ringing out to address all of them while his visage swirled with the power of Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
"You all have the Foundation, Circulation Modus Operandi, and all other tools that allow you to forge an Absolute Seed of Extremity...and yet you cannot."
WAA!

"The reason for this is that even though you were able to define yourselves with the Concepts due to your Foundations, you do not and have truly expressed these concepts with your Aspects of Existence!"
Yes!
Those closest to him were granted everything from him as many of them had yet to even use the power of their new boundaries to form skills, attack, or even cast their Planar Domains!
"You all grasped the Boundary of Quintessence, but what Quintessential feat have you enacted?
You hold the Boundary of Loot, but have you taken down a myriad of enemies to see their very existence turned into caches of Loot?

If you truly wish to grasp an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, you must first utilize your newly granted authorities and build a sufficient amount of records with them, and paired with your Extremity Foundations...enacting an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity then would only be a reality."
They heard his words as their Aspects of Existence pulsed.
And as if to hit the nail in the coffin...
"It just so happens that within a day, there will be an Apex War with Ultimate Existences from Lineages and Inheritances who have yet to see the grandeur you all can express.
In that battle, you all can create your records and enact your own legends for the eons to come."
BOOOM!
Waves of golden Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity scattered out as the Aspects of Existence of Noah's people roared.
From them...
"RAA!"
Roars and shouts of valor began to echo out as they got ready to delve into a grand war!

chapters.title: Chapter 2535 The Extremity Vein Rises! III
paragraphs: Erikson's eyes were like lanterns of singularities as he gazed at the massive and endless wall that didn't seem to want to decide on being solidified or liquified in form, his beach attire standing out amidst this scene as his slippers were back on feet- shining with a glint of an Apex Aeonic Relic.

The wall before him radiated grandiose waves of Dissolution as ever since the fundamental change began hours ago which represented the last Crimson Extremity Panacea being attained, this wall had remained just as it was now.
"Any word on who obtained the last Crimson Extremity Panacea?"

He asked with sharp eyes as behind him, Reverend Emperors with Extremity Foundations built by Obisidian Reality Panaceas floated protectively while a woman with round-rimmed glasses gazed towards a certain direction.
"There is a high probability that it was the self-titled True Emperor of Quintessence. A lot of his bodies haven't always been accounted for, and if there is anyone who can silently take it away..."
The last Extremity Panacea had been whisked away without any grand battles, with even its eruption being silent and unseen as many Scions suspiciously gazed towards a single being!

"If not for him, Master Erikson would have surely grasped one of the Crimson Extremity Panaceas..." A Scion of the Sima Clan spoke with reservation within the group as Erikson laughed while waving his hands.

"Haha, no need for it. I already altered the probability of the Obsidian Extremity Panacea I devoured to grant me similar effects to a Crimson Extremity Panacea. My current Extremity Foundation...should only be a step behind his!"

He spoke with confidence as he knew he couldn't rival it. After all, he was not able to distort the probability enough at his current stage to birth something as pristine as an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity. But this should change greatly when he became an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!
As he thought of this, he turned his gaze behind him and saw hundreds of pillars of multicolored lights blooming like suns all across this region.

Each of these pillars showed Extremity Meridians being formed, the vast majority ranging from 6 or 18 as it was all beings who had acquired an Extremity Panacea and had a guaranteed chance of becoming Apex Aeonic Lifeforms. It was the process of Scions undergoing Apexification en masse as they wanted to be entirely ready to participate in the Culmination Step that was about to unfold!
"Are you all ready to start too?" He spoke towards the Sima Clan Scions behind him as they nodded.
"Alright boys and girls..." He cracked his neck and stretched his body as the light blue beach attire on him pulsed with glorious waves of haki.

"...the next stage to come will have an easy and rapid path of progression across the stage of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform as in Recorded History, those who benefit the most from the Initiation Step and the Culmination Step...will in no doubt achieve Hyperversal Extremity at the Extremity Step of Extremity Sanctification."

"No arduous hard work for millions of years...just be outstanding enough to grab the opportunities of Extremity Sanctification as with enough fortune, you may even be standing alongside the Elders of the Sima Clan in the months and years to come."
His words caused the eyes of the Sima Clan Scions to burn as their bodies pulsed with rhythms of power and battle!

Erikson's face turned serious while he spoke as immense bravery and honor leaked from his tan skin, his voice radiating out to even be heard in the surroundings as Noah's visage in the far distance that was observing the vast Wall of Dissolution turned around to gaze at this scene.
"We of the Sima Clan are the Protectors of the Seven Havens....we make the Malignancies that wish to harm us run in fear as our power is Absolute!"
HO!
The rhythm of the Sima Clan Scions behind him formed into a booming sound that emanated out with his words.
"So live up to the name and standing of the Sima Clan. Obtain the strength required to continue our holy mission for the years to come...undergo Apexification!"
HO!
Radiance shone on the Scions behind him.

Hundreds of Extremity Meridians flourished in a grand show of power as apart from this region...all other locations had the emerging light of Extremity Meridians blooming as thousands of Scions took the step forward to get ready for wonders to come.
In one corner, the visage of Shadowlings could be seen near the wall of Dissolution as they stayed close to Noah's Reified Sources of Extremity.
Many of them also shone with the light of Extremity Meridians as some had even successfully finished their Apexification and wondrously felt the power of an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!

What was frightening though, was that some thought the being who had led them here this whole time would feel less like a mystery and an unshakable existence as those who had become Apex Aeonic Lifeforms gazed towards Noah's Reified Sources of Extremity.
With their new power, they expected to be able to at least see through him and not feel the sense of suppression, but...

Their gazes trembled in shock as their more attuned senses as Apex Aeonic Lifeforms warned them of danger when they gazed at Noah's bodies- the sense of oppression he gave off before becoming maddening!
Even after advancing as Apex Aeonic Lifeforms...they could actually not even touch a fraction of this being's power!
What the hell was this?!

There was no answer to come as not just them, many Scions becoming Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and wishing to break the feeling of inadequacy they held whenever they gazed at Noah's visage before would try to send their wills over.
But they would only receive another unfathomable shock that few would be able to forget in their lives!

Meanwhile, Noah's bodies were in front of the huge wall of Dissolution- the hands of his Quintessential Emperor of Extremity placed on it as he rippled with its massive waves of authority- thinking of even more audacious things like passing through this impassable wall without even having undergone Apexification!

chapters.title: Chapter 2536 A Glorious Apex Battlefield! I
paragraphs: Within the vast Haven of Dissolution itself, a shocking scene could be seen at this moment as one could appreciate the outer layer of an utterly majestic vein extending infinitely across, tendrils of dissolution arcing across it and constantly changing the space around them.

It seemed like less than half of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution had risen from the abyss as it showed the progression of Extremity Sanctification, its appearance filled with grandeur and mystery for any who gazed at it!
"Astonishing to view every time, isn't it?"

In a region with concentrated tendrils of Ruin and Nullity, near the Apex Battlefield where the Apex War of Annihilation between two factions would soon be taking place- a voice of wonder rang out as a humanoid woman adorned in a white robe with bright gold wings erupting behind her back could be seen.
Around her, similar humanoids with golden wings could be seen as they were of the Celestial Thunderbirds of the Celestial Thunder Inheritance!
"It still places to the Records of the Extremity Sanctification of Andromeda or Oceanus we've been shown, Priestess Persephone. Their Extremity Veins were something of wonder..."
Another voice chimed in as Priestess Persephone shook her head with a smile.

"You all have yet to see this Extremity Sanctification fully unfold, It had been Recorded that the Last Sanctification will be something surpassing any others! And this difference should be felt more in the Culmination Step as the knowledge that many Inheritances have collected before will not be useful. But...ah."

Towards the end of her words, she sighed with a sense of sadness as her will and the will of many Apex Aeonic Lifeforms veiled by a golden light gazed in the far distance where they could see the Apex Battlefield.

"For such an event to occur at the same time as a war of bloodbath...why would the Adjudicator allow something like this? Why must they fight to spill blood when we have much more terrifying enemies barely being held at bay?"
Her eyes held a light of love for all living things as she felt saddened by the bloodbath that would soon follow.
"I understand the feelings of Priestess but...where are the rest of the forces for this Apex War?"
Another voice from among the Celestial Thunderbirds rang out curiously as they gazed at the Apex Battlefield.

There, one could see that on the side with a brilliant obsidian runic ecriture reading NOBLESSE, Legions of forces could be seen enacted as they floated on the silver crimson skies with valor- many Legions being seen as each one was led by a few Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
The vast majority of them were composed of Noblesse, but on the a somber expression as he looked ahead!
forefront, one could see the commanders identifiable as Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Genesis Institute of Extremity and Singularity Overseers.
They had increased in number- especially so for the Singularity Overseers as the slightly pale figure of Zeitgeist could be seen with a somber expression as he looked ahead!
Apart from them, there were the relaxed Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from an unidentifiable faction- and yet these beings were the ones who emanated the most power.
It felt stifling for even some of the Wills arriving and watching from a distance as the main cause of it was from a single being who silently throbbed with the aura of Destruction.
Ahpuch!
This was the grandness on one side of the Apex Battlefield.

But on the other...a few Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Cult of Endless Shadows could be seen as their gazes weren't the happiest, one of them turning towards the far back and sending out a message towards none other than Roan!
The deposed Lernaean Emperor who wished to take the reins and forge relations with the Cult of Endless Shadows first.
He was backed by 4 Ancestral Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as he didn't run away when word of the Apex War spread, his gaze cold as many hidden criticisms were unsaid!
"Why aren't the forces of Lernaeans here yet?!"
This was the message Roan received from the Primeval Shadow Elders upfront as he scoffed.
Didn't they all side with the so called True Emperor of Quintessence?
Now, they would also face the same consequences of his actions!
As sad as it was to see, they might just be witnessing the end of the Lernaean Lineage in this coming day.
But still, Roan was here.
Even if the self acclaimed True Emperor of Quintessence turned tail and ran, Roan would be here to defend the honor of the Lernaeans!
Two sides of an Apex Battlefield.
One was filled while the other felt barren.
Every now and then, new Wills would sweep over it as a few forces from those arriving here across different Havens heard of or knew about a small Apex War sparking out as they came to watch.
It was like a car crash or a collapse of Planes of Existence.
Some beings just couldn't pull their eyes away from the horror!
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
Serene waves of authorities and Dynamis of Extremity pulsed like a silent storm within the depths of the Prana Aletheian Haven.
Even though his Vassals could not yet forge an Absolute Seed of Extremity, forming a Dynamis with 2-3 Boundaries forcefully was still possible due to their Extremity Foundations.
And to go even further, each of his Vassals Main Bodies had assimilated Obsidian or Golden Extremity Panaceas from the many that Noah had collected- elevating their Foundations even further!
They all prepared thoroughly for the Apex War of Annihilation that would occur within less than a day, with Noah continuing to work the most.
At this moment, multiple clones were within another area of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven that was surrounded by the golden light of Loot and the crimson light of flames.

Glorious forges burning with intense heat could be seen organized in a curved linear formation as if they were a stellar system, each one pulsing with the light of Relics as armored Breastplates, Briefs, Helmets, Boots, Gloves...a numerous of Relics radiating a light even more intense than Apex Aeonic Relics could be seen!
The Hyperversal Blacksmith's Forge was pulsing with a grand light of Quintessence as Set Items were being forged to be equipped by an already horrifying army!

chapters.title: Chapter 2537 A Glorious Apex Battlefield! II
paragraphs: The light of heat and loot permeated all around as the isolated domain holding a myriad of forges pulsed with life.
The authorities of natural laws and decreta surged wondrously in the surroundings as they flowed into every Forge, their might flowing into every Relic being forged!

The materials going into these forges were formed across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as it continued to expand and proliferate with Spiritual Herbs as well, the Relics coming out exceeding any Apex Aeonic Relics Noah had seen on the bodies of Scions.
Every few seconds, one of the massive Forges would shine brightly and spit out a dazzling relic that radiated pure wonder of Loot.

Along with Noah, there was one other being in the Hyperversal Blacksmith's Forge who had called for a recess from Dual Cultivation as her heart couldn't take it anymore, and she had sensed the pulse of Loot light occurring in this location as she was drawn here!
A light of the Thesauros Absolute Dynamis of Extremity covered her body as she gazed at the mass production of fantastical Loot and spoke out with mesmerized eyes.
"Now this...is fucking gorgeous."
It was!

Each one radiated pure wonder and Loot light as before Noah's will, there was an array of prompts that continued to repeat over and over again until he put them on the sidelines, waiting only for a single one that showed the immense progress being made.
{The Quintessential Greataxe of the Loot Harvester has been forged.}
{The Quintessential Looter's Breastplate has been forged.}
{The Quintessential Briefs of Greed have been forged.}
{The Quintessential Seagold Boots have been forged.}
{The Quintessential Wraps of Midas have been forged.}
{The Quintessential Helm of Atonement has been forged.}
{The Complete Set of Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia has been forged.}

The Relics being forged were being mass produced as each one shone with a milky white gold luster, the breastplates having been branded with a cerulean infinity symbol while the helms held burning blue flames that seemed to be pulsing with authority!
The color of milky white and gold was dominant on the rest of the Set Pieces that made the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia Set, with a cerulean shading appearing here and there.
Noah was about to view their astounding details when...
"Hold on!"
As if Aurelia could read his thoughts, she stopped him while her body began to radiate the authority of the Thesauros Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
{The Blessing of Loot}!
BZZT!

Pure halcyon grandeur pulsed from her and exploded out like a sea, going on to cover the hundreds of Relics making up the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Attire Set as well as the myriad of forges floating throughout.
"Ha...now let's see!" Aurelia sighed with happiness and excitement as her fair hands reached out to grab one of the {Quintessential Greataxes of the Loot Harvester}

{Quintessential Greataxe of the Loot Harvester}:: A Hyperversal Apex I Relic forged under the fires of the Hyperversal Blacksmith's Forge that faced the constant infusion and refinements of Natural Laws and Decreta. It has been further elevated under the light of the Blessing of Loot by the holder of Thesauros Absolute Dynamis of Extremity as its capabilities and potential have only scaled upwards. When equipped, it currently grants the boost of +100 Quintessential Hyperversal Damage Values, +5% Lifesteal of Enemy's Maximum Vitality Values Per Hit, Halcyon Flammability Effect On Hit, +50% Chance to Trigger Chaos Loot Nova On Hit(A Chaos Loot Nova deals 500% of the base Damage Value of the Relic as an Area of Effect Damage Value), +50% Increased Rarity of Loot, and a +50% Increased Quantity of Loot. This Item is only one of the 6 that makes up the {Quintessential Loot Seeker's Attire Set}- the more set items collected, the grander the effects...

"Ah! Do you see it? It was already a high quality Loot, but by Blessing of Loot raised its boosts by 25% or 50% at the very least! When I fully converge through Thesauros Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, I should be able to enhance a Relic by over 100%..."
Aurelia twirled the Greataxe of the Loot Harvester in her hands with utmost excitement as one could see the fanaticism of Loot in her eyes!

She hugged this milky gold Greataxe that looked like it could split a Plane of Existence as it was buried in her blessed chest, her eyes shifting around excitedly as she beckoned and caused one of the dazzling white gold Breastplates with a blue infinity symbol on their center float towards them.

{Quintessential Looter's Breastplate}:: A Hyperversal Peak I Relic forged under the fires of the Hyperversal Blacksmith's Forge that faced the constant infusion and refinements of Natural Laws and Decreta. It has been further elevated under the light of the Blessing of Loot...When equipped, it currently grants the boost of +150 Quintessential Hyperversal Defense Values, +150 Quintessential Hyperversal Vitality Values, 25% Absolute Damage Nullification, Boundary Essences Below the 10th Layer Cannot Bypass Through, 5% Passive Heal of Maximum Vitality Values every ten seconds, +25% Increased Rarity of Loot, and a +25% Increased Quantity of Loot. This Item is only one of the 6 that makes up the {Quintessential Loot Seeker's Attire Set...
"Ah...!" Aurelia also hugged the vibrant Breastplate excitedly as she breathed with excitement while gazing at the hundreds of similar Loot around her.
It filled her with such profound happiness that she didn't even know what to do
She felt content.
She felt at peace!
BZZZT!

Her Origin pulsed as her eye closed, the rate of Convergence of the Thesauros Absolute Dynamis of Extremity being urged forth ever faster as after gazing and blessing all the Loot here, she seemed to have entered a state of epiphany.
Noah shook his head at this Loot Fanatic who even surpassed his own enthusiasm as he called 6 of the Hyperversal Peak I Relics that made a complete set before him.
Ruination was also considered a Hyperversal Peak I Relic, and yet her capabilities were more than 10 times with pure stats alone as her characteristics and abilities were even more monstrous.
But when these Relics were worn together to grant the Set Effect...
their benefits were also astonishing!

sentences.text: The light of heat and loot permeated all around as the isolated domain holding a myriad of forges pulsed with life.
The authorities of natural laws and decreta surged wondrously in the surroundings as they flowed into every Forge, their might flowing into every Relic being forged!

The materials going into these forges were formed across the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as it continued to expand and proliferate with Spiritual Herbs as well, the Relics coming out exceeding any Apex Aeonic Relics Noah had seen on the bodies of Scions.
Every few seconds, one of the massive Forges would shine brightly and spit out a dazzling relic that radiated pure wonder of Loot.

Along with Noah, there was one other being in the Hyperversal Blacksmith's Forge who had called for a recess from Dual Cultivation as her heart couldn't take it anymore, and she had sensed the pulse of Loot light occurring in this location as she was drawn here!
A light of the Thesauros Absolute Dynamis of Extremity covered her body as she gazed at the mass production of fantastical Loot and spoke out with mesmerized eyes.
"Now this...is fucking gorgeous."
It was!

Each one radiated pure wonder and Loot light as before Noah's will, there was an array of prompts that continued to repeat over and over again until he put them on the sidelines, waiting only for a single one that showed the immense progress being made.
{The Quintessential Greataxe of the Loot Harvester has been forged.}
{The Quintessential Looter's Breastplate has been forged.}
{The Quintessential Briefs of Greed have been forged.}
{The Quintessential Seagold Boots have been forged.}
{The Quintessential Wraps of Midas have been forged.}
{The Quintessential Helm of Atonement has been forged.}
{The Complete Set of Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia has been forged.}

The Relics being forged were being mass produced as each one shone with a milky white gold luster, the breastplates having been branded with a cerulean infinity symbol while the helms held burning blue flames that seemed to be pulsing with authority!
The color of milky white and gold was dominant on the rest of the Set Pieces that made the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia Set, with a cerulean shading appearing here and there.
Noah was about to view their astounding details when...
"Hold on!"
As if Aurelia could read his thoughts, she stopped him while her body began to radiate the authority of the Thesauros Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
{The Blessing of Loot}!
BZZT!

Pure halcyon grandeur pulsed from her and exploded out like a sea, going on to cover the hundreds of Relics making up the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Attire Set as well as the myriad of forges floating throughout.
"Ha...now let's see!" Aurelia sighed with happiness and excitement as her fair hands reached out to grab one of the {Quintessential Greataxes of the Loot Harvester}

{Quintessential Greataxe of the Loot Harvester}:: A Hyperversal Apex I Relic forged under the fires of the Hyperversal Blacksmith's Forge that faced the constant infusion and refinements of Natural Laws and Decreta.
It has been further elevated under the light of the Blessing of Loot by the holder of Thesauros Absolute Dynamis of Extremity as its capabilities and potential have only scaled upwards.

When equipped, it currently grants the boost of +100 Quintessential Hyperversal Damage Values, +5% Lifesteal of Enemy's Maximum Vitality Values Per Hit, Halcyon Flammability Effect On Hit, +50% Chance to Trigger Chaos Loot Nova On Hit(A Chaos Loot Nova deals 500% of the base Damage Value of the Relic as an Area of Effect Damage Value), +50% Increased Rarity of Loot, and a +50% Increased Quantity of Loot.
This Item is only one of the 6 that makes up the {Quintessential Loot Seeker's Attire Set}- the more set items collected, the grander the effects...
"Ah!
Do you see it?
It was already a high quality Loot, but by Blessing of Loot raised its boosts by 25% or 50% at the very least!
When I fully converge through Thesauros Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, I should be able to enhance a Relic by over 100%..."
Aurelia twirled the Greataxe of the Loot Harvester in her hands with utmost excitement as one could see the fanaticism of Loot in her eyes!

She hugged this milky gold Greataxe that looked like it could split a Plane of Existence as it was buried in her blessed chest, her eyes shifting around excitedly as she beckoned and caused one of the dazzling white gold Breastplates with a blue infinity symbol on their center float towards them.

{Quintessential Looter's Breastplate}:: A Hyperversal Peak I Relic forged under the fires of the Hyperversal Blacksmith's Forge that faced the constant infusion and refinements of Natural Laws and Decreta.

It has been further elevated under the light of the Blessing of Loot...When equipped, it currently grants the boost of +150 Quintessential Hyperversal Defense Values, +150 Quintessential Hyperversal Vitality Values, 25% Absolute Damage Nullification, Boundary Essences Below the 10th Layer Cannot Bypass Through, 5% Passive Heal of Maximum Vitality Values every ten seconds, +25% Increased Rarity of Loot, and a +25% Increased Quantity of Loot.
This Item is only one of the 6 that makes up the {Quintessential Loot Seeker's Attire Set...
"Ah...!" Aurelia also hugged the vibrant Breastplate excitedly as she breathed with excitement while gazing at the hundreds of similar Loot around her.
It filled her with such profound happiness that she didn't even know what to do
She felt content.
She felt at peace!
BZZZT!

chapters.title: Chapter 2538 A Glorious Apex Battlefield! III
paragraphs: {Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia Set}:: An upheaval of a reality altering effect brought to fruition by the Infinite Hyperversal Haven. When 2 Set Items of the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia are equipped, a Loot Barrier forms around the body as it can absorb 750 Apex Aeonic Damage Values, and it regenerates fully within 1 second of being destroyed. When 4 Set Items are equipped, there is a 25% Chance Upon Killing an Enemy to cause an Explosion of Loot that grants 1,000% more Loot. When 6 Set Items are equipped, any enemy killed grants +1,000 Quintessential Loot Experience Points that can be utilized towards the progression of Boundaries up to the 13th Boundary Layer. A Quintessential Banner of Loot will also form above you as it adds +750 Quintessential Hyperversal Loot Damage Values to all attacks and abilities you release. A third effect for wearing all 6 Set Items is currently still budding from the Blessing of Loot...
Equipping all 6 items of the set granted fantastical boons that exceeded anything that Apex Aeonic Relics could grant.
A single set item and its effects exceeded what multiple weak Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could do as even their Values wouldn't reach the mere boons they granted as a set!

This was something Noah had forged in Relics in the past, and it appeared here again as when he adorned his Vassals that were already holding Extremity Foundations and exceeding normal Apex Aeonic Lifeforms with such ridiculous Hyperversal Apex I Relics, especially with their set effects...
It was a really bad future to imagine for their enemies!

As the Infinite Hyperversal Haven grew and its features became more robust...even deadlier Relics that were making their way to And this was only the first version of Hyperversal Relics that he would forge.
As the Infinite Hyperversal Haven grew and its features became more robust...even deadlier Relics that were making their way to becoming Armaments of Extremity would begin to appear!
Noah monitored all of this carefully as his voice emanated out.
"Is the other side ready?"
He asked serenely as from his surroundings...
{Yes, Master. Here are the results so far.}
The voice of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven urged out.
A part of his Will shone as it was given a vision of a veiled region within the Infinite Hyperversal Haven- a region within the depths of its Source!
There, the visage of Hyperion could be seen floating calmly as waves of pristine power at the Apex Aeonic Lifeform level reverberated out.
Alongside him, massive Hyperversal Enders of Extremity could be seen as Noah and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven had been busy!
Other beings worked hard for their lineage and domains, but did anyone work as hard as Noah?
Yes, his Mana was Infinite as his resource usage was absolutely minimal.
But the things he did in a matter of days were things that some Hyperversal Extremities could not complete in years!
And in addition to everything else he worked on these past days...
the Enders of Nature was another glorious project!
Their Realms and Origins were reconfigured and reconstructed.
Granted Extremity Foundation!
And then they were advanced to Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as the defenders of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven were truly stepping up to their role.

Besides Hyperion, the forms of regal Dragons, Phoenixes, Qilins, Cosmic Serpents, Singularity Tortoises, and many more stretched out left, right, and behind him as their eyes shone with power that waited to be expressed.
They simply waited to exert their strength!
With this and many more things, Noah felt pristinely prepared for the war to come.

The goal wasn't to have a hard fight with tension on who would be the winner. The goal was to dominate the other side so devastatingly that others would have to think twice about ever moving against them!
But of course, things never went according to plans.
And this was why his strength had to not only be overpowered, but utterly intense and obscene to account for any possibilities that may happen in the future to come!

In addition to the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia Sets and the Hyperversal Enders of Extremity, Noah was also working to expand his Boundaries to the highest possible level he could, the Loot he obtained from the Abyssal Sanctimonious Lands already brought towards Ruination to be multiplied and utilized by him.
There were even the grand Fruits of Extremity from the Perennial Yggdrasils of Extremity in his soul for the expansion of his Boundaries!
Thereafter, there was one additional thing he had to do.
One additional Dynamis of Extremity he had to forge!
Thereafter, the rest would be history!
In the Haven of Penumbra.

In a tiny speck of this endlessly vast Vault of Extremity, past rotating clusters of multiple Major Planes of Existence, within a Unique Plane of Extremity modified by the dense Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows.

Massive obsidian castles the size of Cosmos floated like bright moons in the starry space, their edges making it seem like they were on floating stellar bodies that dripped off a pure obsidian essence like endless waterfalls.
The particles of this pure black light gathered below into immaculately flowing rivers that flowed to form the runic ecriture of {SHADOWS}!

The castles rotated around one central fortress shining with crystalline grandeur, its size exceeding that of average Realities as it seemed to hold pockets of dazzling cosmos within its walls, along with other smaller castles that held an Innumerable number of beings moving about!
Massive ships and vessels could be seen stationed or moving around the floating castles and the fortress that was known as the Shadow Fortress.
The Shadow Fortress within the Tenebrous Plane Immutable Extremity where a core portion of the economy and power of the Cult of Endless Shadows flowed!

Materials, Relics, Aeonic Treasures of Extremity, and much more were constantly being imported or sent out as the Cult of Endless Shadows took hold of anything under the banner with the quality of shadows and darkness.

The auras of Boundary Expansion Realm experts were in abundance, with the shining might of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms being felt in every floating castle as within the fortress, the heavy aura of Hyperversal Extremities blazed!

Noah's gaze took in all of these scenes while Hyperversal Extremity Gabriella took him toward a portion of the massive Shadow Fortress, her voice ringing out to Primeval Elder Silas who had accompanied Noah this whole time.

{Silas, you join the group leaving with your Master to participate in the Culmination Step. I'll handle things from here. When you get back, see if more Shadow Elders need to reinforce the side of our friend here.}
Her words were undeniable as Silas nodded respectfully, giving Noah a side glance while sending him a mental message as he disappeared.
'Whatever you do...please act with decorum when interacting with Hyperversal Extremities. Especially Extremity Gabriella!'
His mental message fell on deaf ears as Noah acted as if he hadn't heard them, nodding towards Extremity Gabriella as he continued forward!
"There won't be a need for any more forces of the Cult of Endless Shadows to be sent over for this Apex War, even the current ones there won't be needed really."
{Oh?} A smile appeared on Extremity Gabriella's face as she spoke with serenity
{Are you sure about that? I hear the Apex Battlefield still doesn't have even a shred of your forces. While the other side...}
Information was constantly sent over on what was happening with the Apex Battlefield in the Haven of Dissolution!
Many were inquisitive about the being who had forged an Absolute Seed of Extremity.
What would he reveal on the Apex Battlefield, and why was his side vacant when the battle was nearly upon them?!
