chapters.title: Chapter 2539 A Glorious Apex Battlefield! IV
paragraphs: One side of the Apex Battlefield was filled with Legions led by powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, and yet the other side only had a few Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as it looked extremely barren!

{You would know more than others, but most beings are under the assumption that you will lose in this battle, but that it doesn't matter to you since the Adjudicator of Dissolution has either already put safeguards or will simply make a move when the time comes.}
The voice of Hyperversal Extremity Gabriella rang out after she brought up the topic of the Apex Battlefield.
"Then most beings would be wrong."

Noah replied with ease as he took her words lightly, their figures landing on a massive black white platform that had the character of {S} inscribed on the very floor, rows of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms pulsing with ferocious eyes spaced out in this region as they only bowed respectfully towards Gabriella.

The platform they were on led deeper into the Shadow Fortress, and yet Gabriella remained standing on the {S} character as she motioned with her hands to release a blinding light of authority, the {S} releasing a bright spatial light as her figure and Noah's figure disappeared!
The Shadow Fortress was too vast.
Each of its myriad parts were divided into the abodes of different Hyperversal Extremities who led Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
Here lay the concentrated forces of the Cult of Endless Shadows as far away from this location, their other domains had their own Hyperversal Extremities stationed and upholding their dominion.

The {S} teleportation rune Noah and Hyperversal Extremity Gabriella had activated brought them into a domain within the depths of the Shadow Fortress the size of a small world, Noah gazing around to see the floor was formed by thick Hyperversal Extremity Authority that looked like endless swirling black rose petals.
The ends of the domain held a darkness he couldn't see across, but the potency of Hyperversal Extremity Authority in this domain could not be looked down upon!
{Welcome to one of my domains, Osmont. Here, we can discuss exactly what future you see for yourself, and what outcome you're seeking with this Apex War.}
Extremity Gabriella's voice was radiant as it rang out, Noah's brows rising as he asked lightly.
"Just that?"
It was very clear what he was asking for with his words as the reply was equally quick!
{Oh, do you mean the Armament of Extremity, the Shadow Sword? I know full well of your oath and what it means.}
WAA!
As she spoke, she waved her hands as an illusory scene appeared above them, showing an utterly magnificent outline of a sword that was devouring all sources of light!
One could feel profound palpation just from gazing at it as it seemed like a smooth ticket towards Extremity!

{Unfortunately, one of our prized Primeval Shadow Elders a lineage above Silas is penetrating from the cusp of the 17th Boundary Layer as he can already sense Hyperversal Extremity Authority. You gazing upon the Shadow Sword may just have to be after this Apex War.."
She smiled sweetly as she spoke, nobody being the wiser on what she truly thought or why she did what she was doing!
The cherished Shadow Sword would be gazed at and grasped at the end of the Apex War of Annihilation as this was within the bounds of the Oath he made with Silas.
So he remained calm at Extremity Gabriella's words as she continued.
{I instead want to get past the bullshit and understand which faction you will stand on if you continue to rise with your current brilliance.}
Extremity Gabriella seemed much more straightforward as she was looking at things from the perspective of the gains of the Cult of Endless Shadows!
Would Noah stand to join them or another faction in the future to come when he had even received an invitation from a Scion of the Sima Clan?
At her question, Noah smiled and replied sharply.
"I'm afraid that such a question will only truly be answered after this Apex War."
The same words she had uttered when it related to the Shadow Sword!
But Noah wasn't just speaking here as at the end of this War, all those watching would understand just which group the True Emperor of Quintessence belonged to!
And at this moment, the Cult of Endless Shadows wondered.
Away from this Haven, the Genesis Institute of Extremity wondered.
And even further away, a Scion of the Sima Clan and a Sion of the Infinite Extremity wondered.
Many beings could only guess the results about to unfold as in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution...the hours trickled by as the time of the Apex War of Annihilation neared!
In the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, under the covers of the golden light of the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity, the True Emperor of Quintessence continued his preparations.
With every passing hour, he was ever closer to his goals as he hit all the milestones he wished to.
In the last hours before the set time of the Apex War of Annihilation...too many changes occurred with him and his body of Alexander King, along with his Son completing a profound Apexification!
They were stupendous changes that would be felt first hand by the enemies they were about to face.
The skies were bathed with a crimson silver radiance as tendrils of Nullity and Ruin dominated, their excellence becoming more focused as if they could feel what was to come.
Their light showed the expansive Apex Battlefield below as on the side under the banner of Noblesse, Legions could be seen stretched out as far as the eyes could see.
The time for the Apex War neared, and yet the situation didn't seem to change much for the other side as less than 10 sparse auras of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could be felt!

"Can this even be considered an Apex War? It just seems like a one sided stomping is about to occur, with all the reputation this Osmont has garnered for forging an Absolute Seed of Extremity about to come crashing down."
Far from the bounds of the Apex Battlefield crimson clouds of Ruin were artificially formed as atop them, luxurious thrones were enacted as Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from Inheritances sat atop them!
Some were on floating Ships or Vessels serenely parked in space, while others formed their own domains and watched the unfolding events from afar as their opinions had already begun to flow out!

They were stupendous changes that would be felt first hand by the enemies they were about to face.
The skies were bathed with a crimson silver radiance as tendrils of Nullity and Ruin dominated, their excellence becoming more focused as if they could feel what was to come.
Their light showed the expansive Apex Battlefield below as on the side under the banner of Noblesse, Legions could be seen stretched out as far as the eyes could see.
The time for the Apex War neared, and yet the situation didn't seem to change much for the other side as less than 10 sparse auras of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms could be felt!
"Can this even be considered an Apex War?
It just seems like a one sided stomping is about to occur, with all the reputation this Osmont has garnered for forging an Absolute Seed of Extremity about to come crashing down."
Far from the bounds of the Apex Battlefield crimson clouds of Ruin were artificially formed as atop them, luxurious thrones were enacted as Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from Inheritances sat atop them!
Some were on floating Ships or Vessels serenely parked in space, while others formed their own domains and watched the unfolding events from afar as their opinions had already begun to flow out!

chapters.title: Chapter 2540 A Glorious Apex Battlefield! V
paragraphs: "Still nothing from him?"

In the northern region past the Apex Battlefield, the figure of Erikson's Aped Aeonic Soul Clone could be seen on a throne atop a golden stellar vessel in the form of a leaf as the changes from him over the last hours were utterly drastic.
"No, Master Erikson. His other bodies are still floating before the Wall of Dissolution in the depths of the Extremity Vein."
Behind him, a reply came from a Sima Clan Scion as another resonant voice came beside Erikson soon after.
"There's still time before the Apex War. He'll likely arrive with a bang. He just seems like that sort of being."

The voice stemmed from Atlas of the Plum Sword of Extremity as besides Erikson's throne, the figures of many prominent Scions who had participated in the Initiation Step could be seen on their own thrones!
Erikson had invited their Apex Aeonic Soul Clones over as apart from Atlas, even the visage of Lodovico and Ayame could be seen among others!

Only their Apex Aeonic Soul Clones were here as their Main Bodies had already met up with their core forces that entered the Haven of Dissolution- each of them receiving the resources of their Inheritances on top of what they gained in the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification to rapidly stabilize their power as Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and elevate their Boundaries past the 10th Layer.

Those from truly powerful Inheritances or those part of the Seven Clans were gaining even more boons as they basked in the aura of their Hyperversal Extremities, being given unique resources to aid them in forging their Dynamis of Extremity.

The Wall of Dissolution did not crumble down as the Extremity Vein rose ever so slowly even now, the Culmination Step not yet unfolding as a decent number of the myriad factions came to the periphery of the Apex Battlefield to watch.
Some Inheritances considered it beneath them as their forces already entered the Extremity Vein of Dissolution and stood before the massive wall that stopped all others!
But the mere presence of renowned names from factions like the Sima Clan, Infinite Extremity, and Plum Sword of Extremity being here observing caused a few more eyes to be drawn over.
On the golden leaf shaped vessel Erikson and others sat on, the visage of Ayame that had been quiet this whole time had her eyes flash with brilliance as she voiced out.
"It seems the suspense and questions are about to come to an end."
The moment her words finished, on the side shining under the banner of {LERNAEAN}, space fluctuated as a majestic aura blazed forth!
The Wills of many watching eyes were roused as they focused on the Apex Battlefield.
There, with all of his glory, the single figure of Noah's Main Body appeared as fantastically, those watching truly affirmed he had yet to advance as an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!

His exceedingly handsome face was apparent to all as he was adorned in a light blue Emperor's Robe, seeming like he was going on a simple stroll as he gazed into the Battlefield ahead of him that instantly blazed with a terrifying intent for battle the moment he had appeared.
At the center of this Battlefield, the figure of Commander Vladic rose from the Legions below as after seeing Noah, his figure became surrounded by a brilliant light as he bellowed out!
"Osmont!"
WAA!
The being who had crushed Euryale's soul right before him.
He actually showed up as Vladic almost wanted to tear the veil stopping the two sides from beginning battle right away!
Yet the being he considered his life and death enemy barely spared him a glance before shaking his head.
What Commander Vladic didn't know was that Noah had already read of his death from {Adumbrative Viewpoint} as he was already considered a dead man walking!

His figure instead floated ever closer to the thin transparent wall that distinguished between the two sides, the figures of the Shadow Elders and Roan who had already been on this Battlefield coming up towards him as Roan's voice was the first to emanate out.
Before Silas's words finished, Noah's regal voice thundered out as he stopped while his facial muscles twisted in anger!
"This is the precipice you have brought our Lernaean Lineage to after taking the seat of Emperor? Complete Annihilation by-"
"Shut up."
WAA!
Before Silas's words finished, Noah's regal voice thundered out as he stopped while his facial muscles twisted in anger!
Among the Primeval Shadow Elders coming by, the figure of Silas could be seen as he had returned from the Haven of Penumbra to take the lead for the forces of the Cult of Endless Shadows aiding Noah.

Depending on how events unfolded in the next few moments, he would be given a command by the Hyperversal Extremities of the Cult of Endless Shadows watching in a hidden space on whether to increase the forces of the Cult of Endless Shadows and bring Legions of them into the Battlefield!
So he didn't stay anything at this moment as he watched Noah's figure ignore everyone else on this side and float right at the transparent veil separating the two forces.

He gazed at the sea of Legions before him that would have frightened any common Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, and yet his eyes held no fear as he turned his head to the Legions led by Elders of the Singularity Overseers and Genesis Institute of Extremity!
He even gazed in the far distance where the figure of a being surrounded by a palpating crimson aura of Destruction could be seen surrounded by extremely powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
He looked at all of them as under the banner of many eyes, his resonant voice rang out!
"Before this Apex War begins, I will give an opportunity for all those who do not have life and death conflict with me to leave."
His words were a surprise to many as Noah's gaze was directed to the forces of Genesis Institute of Extremity and Singularity Overseers who were supporting the side of the Noblesse!
Before any insignificant reactions began, he continued.
"Because for those who do remain in this Apex War of Annihilation...they shall be branded as enemies that cannot exist under the same Haven!"
WAA!

"This doesn't just include those who are present here...but the forces of Inheritances they represent. Any single Existence associated with an Inheritance on this Battlefield- your presence here means that your entire Inheritance is declaring War on me and my livelihood!"
BOOM!

Shocking words that caused many auras to burst with grandiosity boomed out, the eyes of many Apex Aeonic Lifeforms constricting as an immense silence descended only to be broken down by the True Emperor of Quintessence once more, his cerulean Emperor's Robes making him seem like a celestial Emperor advising the masses.
"The armies of the Genesis Institute of Extremity, the Singularity Overseers, and even the veiled Scions of the Avernus Clan thinking they can hide themselves."
His eyes landed on every force he was talking about until they ultimately locked upon Ahpuch and his people as their eyes blazed with brilliance at being called out like this!
Noah had long since found out their affiliation from the Mutated Entities he killed in the Extremity Vein as well as his probing with {Adumbrative Viewpoint}.
But his words caused waves as some beings gazed shockingly towards the visage of Ahpuch and others.
"The Avernus Clan is involved in this?"
"Is this appropriate..."
Many minds began to buzz as the face of Noah didn't pay attention to them.
He gazed at the Legions before him and continued as behind him...a spatial light began to shine as it seemed like his armies were being called forth!

"If a single one of your forces remains on this Battlefield when the Apex War starts, then I will take it as a proclamation of war on my and my whole Lineage. It means that the Genesis Institute of Extremity, the Singularity Overseers, and the Avernus Clan are declaring war on me and becoming deadly enemies. It means that after this war...I will not cease until these two Inheritances and Clan are deconstructed to the last being remaining!"
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2541 Violating Common Sense! I
paragraphs: If they were to participate in this war, they would be branded his mortal enemies as he would not rest until the Genesis Institute of Extremity, Singularity Overseers, and the Avernus Clan were wiped out from existence!
This being actually dared to say such words boldly under the eyes of many prominent inheritances here.
His cerulean robe glimmered with majesty as he continued.
"This is an Apex War of Annihilation. Any Lineage and factions on this Battlefield...I hold the right of Annihilation!"
WAA!

"Any Hyperversal Extremities from the Genesis Institute of Extremity, Singularity Overseers, and Avernus Clan...my words are for you to make a decision now. You have lived long enough to come across Entities and phenomena that even you do not understand. I assure you that this junction is one of them. When the War starts...everything thereafter is irreversible. You have until it starts to decide."
As soon as he finished, the blinding spatial light that had begun to bloom and covered the region behind him became clear as astonishing auras unveiled themselves.
One...two...ten...twenty!
One blazing aura of Apex Aeonic Lifeform after another blared forth as they weren't weak ones!

At the very forefront, a young man adorned in a milky white Armament could be seen, his Breastplate swinging radiantly with a blue infinity symbol as in his hands, a burning Quintessential Helm of Atonement was held.
His hair shone with blue, black, and gold radiance as his eyes carried a deep emerald hue of an Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity.

The pure power he released was suffocating as it far exceeded any common Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, those watching from afar and about to erupt up in clamor and shock at Noah's dazzling words finding their mouths tied and unable to speak as their eyes constricted in different levels of surprise and shock!

From the appearance of Henry Osmont alone, his blaring pressure alone seemed to be at upper levels of power that would only be present on Grand Primeval Elders of Inheritances who led squadrons of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
But this wasn't the main point of surprise about this being.
It was the fact that the Armament his body glimmered with...

exceeded any Apex Aeonic Relics as many eyes blinked wondering whether these beings were fitted with Quasi-Extremity Relics, the only thing they didn't feel from these terrifying Armaments being traces of Hyperversal Extremity Authority marking them as such!
What was astonishing was that the dozens of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms to appear behind the appearance of Henry...all wore similar Armaments blaring with a shining aura of brilliance.
Above their heads, the Quintessential Banner of Loot could be seen as a single illusory gold character signifying {LOOT} blazed with ecstatic power and brilliance!

It was the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia Set that all of them were adorned in, the gazing upon gazes counting 200 of these oppressively powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as each of them held a Quintessential Greataxe of the Loot Harvester in their hands!
It was a breathless scene.
It was a beautiful scene that felt as if time had stopped.
Besides Henry, the visage of the Emperor Penguin could be seen covered entirely by the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia Set as near them, Barbatos was present.
Above Henry's head, a bouncing Blue Slime could be seen as its eyes shimmered with a sly smile that seemed to gaze at everything around it with scrutiny.

Eowyn, Ophelia, the humanoid form of the Kraken, Kazuhiko, the Oathkeeper, the Sword Emperor...a myriad of beings who had been with Noah this whole time got the grand opportunity to be here as their appearance made the grand Apex Aeonic Lifeforms leading Legions opposite to them...feel just a little lacking in brilliance.
But this wasn't all.

Just when the spatial light died down, another one even more dazzling appeared as near the radiant Legion of 200 Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, the appearance of a golden-haired Caterina Aurelia Dismukes appeared.
She sighed out calmly as she gazed around cooly, her surroundings also flashing with light as the appearance of the True Emperor of Genesis appeared beside her.
They were followed by the appearance of Lucia, the Mad Apex Emperor Caesar, and the other Lernaean Apex Aeonic Lifeforms that had bent the knee to have their Realms Reconstructed!
When they appeared...they were also decorated in the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia Sets as the auras of Aurelia and Orion felt even more obscene than the Legion of 200 that had appeared first!
It was to the extent that...
"Aurelia? Orion?"
Roan's voice came out in utter shock as he actually felt his soul be pummeled by a profound sense of oppression when he looked at Orion and Aurelia.
As if their power was so much higher that they could extinguish him with a single tap of their finger!

Not too far from Roan, Grand Primeval Elder Silas gazed on in shock as he found these beings he had met before...he questioned whether he could withstand a few of their strikes and come out unscathed!
It had only been a few days.
What the hell happened?!
Who were all of these Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, and where did they come from?
Most of all, why were they all under the banner of a single being who hadn't even undergone Apexification?!
The advancing Commander Vladic who had risen from the center of the Legions came to a stop before he reached the transparent barrier as his eyes opened wide with incredulity.
The number of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms on the other side...held no Legions of Reverend Emperors or those in the Boundary Expansion Realm who only held Boundaries up to the 9th Layer.
But the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms alone...were nearly 10 times the number that were contained in the whole Noblesse Lineage!
This was a maddening thought and reality to see as suddenly, him going forward as the Commander to fearlessly stand opposite to Noah near the transparent barrier did not seem so enticing!
The silence in the surroundings was deafening as after Noah's words and the arrival of just some of his forces...those observing were utterly gobsmacked.
And at this moment, the roiling skies filled with Ruin and Nullity began to seethe and buzz.

chapters.title: Chapter 2542 Violating Common Sense! II
paragraphs: {This was your trump card?}
In the isolated space that seemed to be far above the skies of Dissolution, the veiled figure of the Adjudicator of Dissolution rang out towards Noah's Clone.

{It is astonishing even by my standards, with a preliminary gaze at these Apex Aeonic Lifeforms letting me know they hold astounding potential. But still...why mark two Inheritances and one of the Seven Clans your enemies?}
A sense of surprise was evident even in the voice of the Adjudicator as Noah's figure gazed down at the scenes below them while he replied.
"You told me before that if anyone seeks trouble with me or my livelihood after I am known, I have the right to retaliate and that you wouldn't interfere."
His words were calm as they caused Svetlana's gaze to more tightly wrap around him.

"I'm also a reasonable being and I took into account the larger situation of these unknown Hyperversal Malignancies around us as before they make themselves my mortal enemies...I am giving these two Inheritances and the Avernus Clan a chance. This is me showing appreciation to you for your actions so far, and also an opportunity for established Inheritances and one of the Seven Clans to not face utter destruction and humiliation in my hands."
WAA!
Noah's words were filled with utmost confidence.
As if what he was saying was that of utmost surety!
Hearing such words...Svetlana actually did not reply as she gazed back below!
She seemed to be pondering.
Her profoundly perceptive eyes seemed to be questioning as her gaze landed on the visage of Aurelia among the many Apex Aeonic Lifeforms Noah had called out.
And...
Her veiled robes fluttered as she voiced out in surprise.
She seemed to have sensed something rather alarming with her piercing eyes that others had yet to observe, this being just one of the surprises of what was to come!
The skies above the Apex Battlefield seethed.
The battalion of over 200 supremely high quality Apex Aeonic Lifeforms made many beings pause as after a deafening silence, immense clamor was about to erupt!
But this clamor never came.
Because the seething skies pulsed with the aura of Hyperversal Extremity Authority- and multiple ones at that!
In a hidden pocket of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.

Dense nothingness and emptiness of time and reality itself permeated as the figure of the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction could be seen within it, his gaze currently as if he had stepped on stellar shit as he gazed at the scenes of the Apex Battlefield.

Beside him, a woman with fiery purple hair and two burning purple horns could be seen as her aura was blazing with an even grander sharpness than his, her voice ringing out at this moment as she locked onto the visage of Noah and the forces he had called out with a wave of his hands!
{You and the Avernus Clan are one, but you promised us you would move with our disciples covertly and not put them in any major spotlight that would reflect on our Clan too much.}
Her words were filled with terrifying authority as she was definitely a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity, and a particularly powerful one at that!
At her words, The Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction remained silent as this being continued.

{Now, the name of the Avernus Clan is being besmirched before the eyes of numerous Inheritances and even the representatives of multiple Clans, with a being actually placing themselves on a high enough pedestal to say that he would eradicate the Avernus Clan itself lest we choose to be his enemies! At this juncture, how do you think we should move, Destruction?! Do you think we even have a choice other than to remind others of the power of the Avernus Clan?!}
She was freely enraged as the visage of Destruction had his eyes turn into blazing slits of flames as he glared at her dangerously.
And yet...
{Glare all you fucking want, but you brought this all here. This Ahpuch you're raising better be worth it, because now...we have to truly have the Avernus Clan participate in this Apex War.}
{What? But the Avernus Extremity Senate would never authorize...}
{I already sought permission, unlike you who acts wantonly.} The Hyperversal Extremity burning with purple flames spoke out curtly as she snapped her fingers.
{If any of this goes wrong any further...both your seat and mine in the Avernus Extremity Senate may be jeopardized. So you better tell me anything else I am missing about this Osmont.}
The Power of Hyperversal Extremity Authority erupted as while she carried a conversation with destruction...
The seething skies filled with Ruin and Nullity above the Apex Battlefield carried her voice as it thundered down with impunity.

{I have lived long, but not long enough to witness the name of the Avernus Clan be disrespected like this. For your indiscretion...we shall very well take your so-called stand of being mortal enemies! No matter what Absolute Seed of Extremity a junior sprouts, the whole Havens need to be reminded that this alone isn't enough to besmirch the magnificence of the Seven Clans!}
WAA!
As her voice thundered out, the gazes of numerous changed and looked above.

There, the skies split as from them, dazzling purple Hyperversal Extremity Authority proliferated as grand auras of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms began to appear, and as if to mock and tell the True Emperor of Quintessence of how far out of depth he was... exactly 200 Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were appearing.
And they weren't weak.
Each one held wild contained power and might as they each held a power equivalent to a Grand Elder of an Inheritance or Clan!

The sight astonished many as they didn't know, but this was a fourth of the most potent battalion of Avernus Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who were meant to participate in the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification that were redirected here with the authority of this Hyperversal Extremity!
The scene was an utterly shocking one as instead of pulling out, the Avernus Clans representative made a grand move that caused the current situation to become even more chaotic!
Many entities watched this scene and this stunning reaction to the words of the True Emperor of Quintessence.
But he didn't just name the Avernus Clan.

In the Apex Battlefield, there were also forces of the Genesis Institute of Extremity as at this moment, the Hyperversal Extremities who had arrived in Dissolution to bring the battalions of their Apex Aeonic Lifeforms for the Culmination Step also heard his words!
In an isolated domain that no Apex Aeonic Lifeform would ever be able to locate in the faraway skies above the Noblesse Domains.

A marbled golden floor could be seen as feathery thrones rose from them, golden pillars and archways having been fabricated to stand straight on this marbled floor as at this moment, a Hyperversal Extremity rose with pulsing power in his eyes, his voice directed toward a white-haired Extremity still sitting down beside him.
{Extremity Marcellus, we talked about recruiting this being even if forcefully, but his words now are spitting in the very magnificence of the Genesis Institute of Extremity! For this-...!}
Before the Hyperversal Extremity could finish, the aged old man known as Extremity Marcellus raised his hand and all words stopped.
Multiple gazes landed on him as his stellar eyes took them all in calmly, his stare on the illusory screen showing the figure of none other than Noah.
Nobody could know what he was currently thinking, but his next words were explosive!
{What irreconcilable enmity do we actually have with this being before us?}

But still...why mark two Inheritances and one of the Seven Clans your enemies?}
A sense of surprise was evident even in the voice of the Adjudicator as Noah's figure gazed down at the scenes below them while he replied.
"You told me before that if anyone seeks trouble with me or my livelihood after I am known, I have the right to retaliate and that you wouldn't interfere."

chapters.title: Chapter 2543 Violating Common Sense! III
paragraphs: Extremity Marcellus.
He held many disciples in the Genesis Institute of Extremity as Titus was among them.
When he had perished, he noticed and talked to a being that was devouring Titus' memories, even understanding that the whole squadron Titus led was about to die!
The being he had talked to then and the one he was looking at now...were one and the same.
He remembered that he had told this being the last time they met that if their paths crossed in the future, he may even discuss destiny with him.
And now, this being gave a warning to make the whole Genesis Institute of Extremity his enemies should they participate in this Apex War.
So he spoke towards the three other bodies of Hyperversal Extremities that came with him to the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution.
{What irreconcilable enmity do we actually have with this being before us?}
What great enmity did they have?
{He massacred some of the squadrons of Scions we sent during the Initiation Step-}

{He also killed Scions of many other Inheritances, but I do not see them here in this Apex War. I'm asking what this being did against our Inheritance that we have a smidgen of our forces, however small it is, supporting a War where from his perspective, he is fighting for his very livelihood and the lives of his whole Lineage.}
The other Hyperversal Extremities didn't reply as they could see where Extremity Marcellus was going with this.
On the third feathery throne, a woman squinted her brows as she spoke cautiously.
{Extremity Marcellus, you couldn't possibly be thinking...}
{Why not? What do we lose from it? Do you think our Inheritance would look weak from such an action?}
WAA!
His white hair danced with authority.
The other Hyperversal Extremities were quiet for a while as the female one sighed again.
{You've lived longer than all of us and are known as the Wise Extremity of Genesis. If you believe this is the best course of action, I have no qualms with it. But this Osmont's mouth...}
{Live and let live...} Extremity Marcellus waved his hands as he came to a shocking conclusion.
{For this Apex War of Annihilation, the forces of the Genesis Institute of Extremity will not be involved.}

The seething skies palpated with the aura of Hyperversal Extremity Authority even now as a moment after the voice of the Hyperversal Extremity of the Avernus Clan ended, another one came down with an equally shocking message.
A message that was simple in nature, resonantly sinking into the ears of all here.
{The forces of the Genesis Institute of Extremity will not be involved in this conflict.}
Words that caused the minds of many to buzz.
The mind of Vladic and the other Noblesse Commanders buzzed even more so than others as this faction...was their own backing!
They were about to lose the very backing they had allied with before the Apex War could even begin?
The Genesis Elders were just as shocked as them as the figures of Grand Genesis Elder Meiying and others began to disappear with a glimmer of light from the battlefield as if they were never there.
"This...!"

Commander Vladic who had just experienced euphoria when 200 terrifying Apex Aeonic Lifeforms began descending from the crack in the skies felt his smile fading as his eyes burned with shock and rage, but he gritted his teeth when he looked at the terrifying figures from the Avernus Clan while steeling his resolve.
Thereafter, his gaze went towards the beings stemming from the Singularity Overseers.
What would they do?

Before the choice came down, the figure of Noah floating before the transparent wall gazed above at the distinct Hyperversal Extremity Authority from the Genesis Institute of Extremity that had yet to fade, his hand waving upwards and sending out a portion of his volition in a vibrant ball of light.
A light melded into space and disappeared along with the Hyperversal Will that had spoken on behalf of the Genesis Institute of Extremity!

Noah's eyes were vibrant as this single action was him being interested by whoever was bold enough to actually reverse the course of the Genesis Institute of Extremity, and he established a line of communication with this single move as thereafter, he continued gazing above while voicing out.
"What shall be the path that the Singularity Overseers take?"
WAA!
He ushered forth a reply from the last remaining faction supporting the Noblesse as in the crimson silver skies, there was only silence so far.
{Devouring, you made a move on your own when this was a small scuffle, what shall you do now?}
In an isolated domain close to the lands of the Planeswalkers, a voice entered the mind of the Hyperversal Extremity of Devouring as he healed the visage of Extremity Kabul who was in a sorry state!
His eyes flashed with a vicious brilliance as he gazed before him where illusory screens showed the Apex Battlefield, his voice decisive as it thundered out.

{I shall redirect a portion of the Singularity Elders here for the Culmination Step for this War. I do not fear a creature who has merely forged an Absolute Seed of Extremity, nor will the Singularity Overseers fear such a being. This is still a minor and insignificant skirmish as we shall treat it as such...and cause as much chaos to tarnish the reputation of Svetlana!}
His eyes throbbed with both viciousness and age.

Truly, in the viewpoint of beings who had lived billions of years and held the profound power of Extremity...would they fear the words of a single existence in the face of the power they wielded, the power their Inheritance wielded, and the very Aeonic Havens themselves that they had founded themselves in?
The Hyperversal Will that had reached out to Devouring was silent with recognition as it instantly acted.
And above the recently calm skies of the Apex Battlefield...
BZZZT!
Space was torn apart once more as if it were paper, and the answer of the Singularity Overseers came with actions instead of words.

Blazing auras of exactly 300 Apex Aeonic Lifeforms descended with stern expressions, all of them riding on variations of massive stellar beasts whose bodies seemed to be formed of constructs of Cosmos, Realities, or even pulsing Singularities!
ROOAAR!
The Tamed Apex Astral Leviathans roared out with majesty as the 300 Lifeforms riding them...at least half held pulsing majesty akin to a Grand Elder of an Inheritance!

chapters.title: Chapter 2544 Violating Common Sense! IV
paragraphs: The Apex Battlefield became rowdy.
200 pristinely powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Avernus Clan and 300 from the Singularity Overseers were added as the force supporting the Noblesse became utterly massive!
Commander Vladic's dark expression became many times lighter when he saw this ever changing scene as his fists tightened.
So what if they lost the support of the Genesis Institute of Extremity?
Their number of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms on their side alone had increased by more than 5 times since just minutes ago!
Meanwhile, the opposing side, however surprising it was, held a bit over 200 exceptional Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
Would they be able to stand against the enraged forces of the Avernus Clan and the Singularity Overseers?
This was a question that some believed they had the answers to as at this moment, the silent clamor in the surroundings rose as those watching realized just how much bigger this War had become.
But while their discussions began amongst themselves, the visage of the True Emperor of Quintessence remained unfettered while staring at the myriad of beings before him.
His voice was even calmer than before, a smile forming on it as very few would be able to understand why he was smiling!
"At times, the smallest of decisions can forever change the course of one's destiny."
WAA!
"Today, the destiny of the Avernus Clan and the Singularity Overseers has diverged into another path entirely."
As he spoke, he waved his hands again.
A simple motion.
But all beings who were watching aptly remembered this motion.
When he did it before, 200 utterly powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms adorned in Relics far exceeding Apex Aeonic Relics had appeared.
What exactly was he calling forth now?
aura of utmost brilliance bloomed as an Entity appeared.
His mere presence caused the surrounding space to buzz and grind on itself heavily Time felt like it was crawling by extremely slowly.
Besides the True Emperor of Quintessence, space fluctuated as an instant later, an aura of utmost brilliance bloomed as an Entity appeared.
His mere presence caused the surrounding space to buzz and grind on itself heavily as on his very skin, a pristine authority of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity could be felt!

His hair shone black, gold, and green. His pupils shone with an obsidian verdant sheen that seemed to be filled with both life and death as any weak Apex Aeonic Lifeform gazing into them may have their Soul shattered!
His body was adorned not in the Loot Seeker's Regalia Set...but with wondrous armaments that shone with a stellar obsidian and green crystalline light as they seemed to be forged from bones.
In his right hand, a verdant staff was grasped as at its tip, a skull with its sockets inscribed with a deathly green infinity symbol could be seen.
Armaments that were forged just for him.
Relics that came together to forge a Set known as the Raiments of the Quintessential Lich Emperor!
A bony helm of this set stably adorned the visage of none other than Alexander like a crown as it blazed with horrifying green flames.
All of this was stunning, but nothing was more so stunning than his aura and the fact that from him, an aura of a fully converged Absolute Dynamis of Extremity could be felt.
Not an Absolute Seed that had yet to bud, but a genuine Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!
At his appearance, the far-away Ahpuch that the forces of the Avernus Clan had gathered near rose as his body throbbed with grandeur.
His heart beat loudly like a drum as if it was telling him...his destiny had arrived.

Before any surprise and alarm could be expressed, the motioning hand of the True Emperor of Quintessence was not done as behind his stellar force of 200, dazzling lights of titanic stature began to bloom.
The figures of Regal Beasts began to unfold by the dozens as even with their massive size, there were dozens of them who were led by none other than a titanic Draconic Elephantine Ender of Extremity!

All around him, the images of Beasts that seemed like massive celestial creatures only born in ancient times proliferated as their forms varied a great deal, taking on statures of Qilins, Phoenixes, Serpents, Crows, Dragons, or a myriad of combinations of such creatures with even more Beasts!

They didn't bellow out or roar to show their power as their eyes held interminable brilliance, gazing around at everything coldly and with precision as even average Apex Aeonic Lifeforms watching in the distance felt their blood run cold.
Their numbers and sizes filled the sparse battlefield as a count had 300 Enders of Extremity pulsing with Extremity Foundations and a dazzling aura of the Apex Aeonic Lifeform stage.
Wondrous dread and power unveiled itself as the myriad of watching gazes each held their own thoughts, each one observing a different part of the unveiled forces.
Roan could not believe the scene before him.
The figures of Oriona and Aurelia felt utterly unreachable as even though it was hard to believe, he could somewhat go through the phases and bring himself to accept it.
But when he looked at the other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms he knew very well to be weaker than him just days ago, and their auras were many times more potent than him right now...he couldn't accept it!
This was...until his eyes fully concentrated from his shock as he blinked when his gaze came to land on a figure he recognized very well.
A being with broken meridians.
A being that had failed Apexification.
Maximilian...was he...was he seeing things or was this past Lineage Emperor an Apex Aeonic Lifeform with an aura just as insane as all the others?!
Roan's will couldn't formulate any thought as at this moment, his soul felt like it had ground to a halt from utter incredulity!
He and many others found themselves unable to even discuss as they truly never expected the True Emperor of Quintessence to call forth a force that would make an Inheritance jealous!
And before any of the disbelief could be expressed...
BZZZT!
The skies seethed once more with Hyperversal Extremity Authority.
An authority more insane than any that had come before it.
It was the authority of the Adjudicator of Dissolution as above the Apex Battlefield, space cracked open while a hidden visage stepped out!

In his right hand, a verdant staff was grasped as at its tip, a skull with its sockets inscribed with a deathly green infinity symbol could be seen.
Armaments that were forged just for him.
Relics that came together to forge a Set known as the Raiments of the Quintessential Lich Emperor!
A bony helm of this set stably adorned the visage of none other than Alexander like a crown as it blazed with horrifying green flames.
All of this was stunning, but nothing was more so stunning than his aura and the fact that from him, an aura of a fully converged Absolute Dynamis of Extremity could be felt.
Not an Absolute Seed that had yet to bud, but a genuine Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!
At his appearance, the far-away Ahpuch that the forces of the Avernus Clan had gathered near rose as his body throbbed with grandeur.
His heart beat loudly like a drum as if it was telling him...his destiny had arrived.

Before any surprise and alarm could be expressed, the motioning hand of the True Emperor of Quintessence was not done as behind his stellar force of 200, dazzling lights of titanic stature began to bloom.
The figures of Regal Beasts began to unfold by the dozens as even with their massive size, there were dozens of them who were led by none other than a titanic Draconic Elephantine Ender of Extremity!

All around him, the images of Beasts that seemed like massive celestial creatures only born in ancient times proliferated as their forms varied a great deal, taking on statures of Qilins, Phoenixes, Serpents, Crows, Dragons, or a myriad of combinations of such creatures with even more Beasts!

They didn't bellow out or roar to show their power as their eyes held interminable brilliance, gazing around at everything coldly and with precision as even average Apex Aeonic Lifeforms watching in the distance felt their blood run cold.
Their numbers and sizes filled the sparse battlefield as a count had 300 Enders of Extremity pulsing with Extremity Foundations and a dazzling aura of the Apex Aeonic Lifeform stage.
Wondrous dread and power unveiled itself as the myriad of watching gazes each held their own thoughts, each one observing a different part of the unveiled forces.
Roan could not believe the scene before him.
The figures of Oriona and Aurelia felt utterly unreachable as even though it was hard to believe, he could somewhat go through the phases and bring himself to accept it.
But when he looked at the other Apex Aeonic Lifeforms he knew very well to be weaker than him just days ago, and their auras were many times more potent than him right now...he couldn't accept it!
This was...until his eyes fully concentrated from his shock as he blinked when his gaze came to land on a figure he recognized very well.
A being with broken meridians.
A being that had failed Apexification.
Maximilian...was he...was he seeing things or was this past Lineage Emperor an Apex Aeonic Lifeform with an aura just as insane as all the others?!
Roan's will couldn't formulate any thought as at this moment, his soul felt like it had ground to a halt from utter incredulity!
He and many others found themselves unable to even discuss as they truly never expected the True Emperor of Quintessence to call forth a force that would make an Inheritance jealous!
And before any of the disbelief could be expressed...
BZZZT!
The skies seethed once more with Hyperversal Extremity Authority.
An authority more insane than any that had come before it.
It was the authority of the Adjudicator of Dissolution as above the Apex Battlefield, space cracked open while a hidden visage stepped out!

chapters.title: Chapter 2545 A Cleaving Blade of Destiny! I
paragraphs: The time neared!
This was the only reason why the figure of an astonishing existence now seeped out from the cracks of space and stared at the glorious Apex Battlefield below.
Both sides were filled to the brim with Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, each one more astonishing than the last as it showed an utterly deadly battle was about to unfold.

The form of Svetlana stepping out of the cracks of space was veiled with dense Hyperversal Extremity Authority that her figure could barely be discerned of its curves and blessings, some existences being too frail to stare at her for too long as they gazed away!
She appeared with a veil over her head as those who could barely withstand the authority of Extremity surrounding her may have been able to tell that her eyes...held traces of sadness!

The attention of the myriad of watchers became divided from peering at the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms the True Emperor of Quintessence had called out and the visage of the Adjudicator of Dissolution as her will began to emanate out across this region.

{Our Seven Havens are staying in a precarious balance with our strongest forces holding truly terrifying enemies at bay. Every single force we add over the years contributes to this balance as every life is of utmost importance.}

Her words were filled with both regality and a sense of disapproval as she gazed towards Noah's visage, towards Vladic, and towards the vast number of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms on the tense Battlefield below as she continued!

{What I hate the most is precious lives and forces of the Havens of Extremity being reaped for no reason, and even worse if they are reaped for sport. Today, every side here has chosen to ignore the larger picture and involve the lives of powerful future defenders of these Havens in a senseless war or Annihilation. It gives me no joy to preside over such an event...and yet here we are.}
Power and sadness went hand in hand in her words.
It caused the burning sensation of war and conflict to feel stifled just a little.
It caused the surroundings to feel empty.
It felt desolate.
It felt sad.
And her words weren't done as she continued.

{Here we are in a field of battle where even Hyperversal Extremities who know full well of the situation we are in contributed to. And the rest would go so far as to recline on their comfy thrones getting ready to watch this senseless war for amusement. Such a scene...paints a grim future for the Seven Aeonic Havens of Extremity!}
She admonished the war about to occur, those involved, those who contributed to it, and those watching!
And even further...

{What I am most disappointed in is myself for allowing this future to develop the way it has as after this war...even the smallest violation of the Investiture of Extremity will be personally handled by me with scrutiny! So enjoy this War you will watch with amusement and strive for your future when the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification fully unfolds, because from now on, my stare will pervasively glance at every single thing!}
With the end of her words, her fair hidden hand rose and snapped.
And an instant after...
BZZZT!
The transparent barrier separating the two sides began to glare with dazzling light as it actually...began to dissolve.
The appointed time had come.
And yet it was so sudden that many were left flabbergasted as the barrier very quickly began to dissolve, the Legions on the side of the Noblesse beginning to buzz with power.
{At this point, the inclusion of any foreign influences in this War has been closed off.}
The voice of the Adjudicator of Dissolution thundered out amidst the shocking progression.
{The war being fought is against the Lernean Lineage and the Noblesse Lineage. The victor holds the right of Annihilation over the defeated and their supporters!}
BOOOM!
Her last sentence caused many wills to rouse as it felt like it was directed towards certain inheritances and a Clan!
And yet once more, those watching couldn't properly react quickly enough.
Because in the next instant...
"My people!"
The voice of the True Emperor of Quintessence thundered out.
His body shone with pristine brilliance as at this moment, a dazzling multicolored throne rose below him that he grandly sat down on.
As if indicating that he...would not even need to lift a finger himself for the fight to come.
The moment he sat on the grand throne, a symphony began to play.
THUMP!
Booming drums and sonorous strokes of sounds emanated out as they seemed to usher forth the call for war, his voice continuing to ring around.

"Today, we fight to defend ourselves from the threat of annihilation from a faction that doesn't truly understand us. Today...we fight to establish the grandeur and identity of our Infinite Hyperversal Haven!"
BOOM!
He sat on the throne grandly as tendrils of Absolute Dynamis of Extremity rose on his skin and caused him to give off terrifying majesty.
His eyes seemed like spinning singularities of infinity as those watching and listening to him realized they were holding in their cycling of essence across their Aspects of Existence!

"We shall establish the grandeur of our Infinite Hyperversal Haven to the extent that no Inheritance nor Haven would dare to turn their swords against us, and those who do...their fate shall be nothing other than destruction."
Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
A concept that others hadn't heard before.
But the way that the True Emperor of Quintessence was speaking about it...it was akin to him giving a proclamation of a faction along the same lines of an Inheritance or Clan!
It was a shocking assertion.
It was an impossible goal.

And yet the True Emperor of Quintessence sitting upon his throne paid no heed as he spoke out coldly while watching the fading barrier, the momentum of the conflict entirely on their side as Vladic nor any other commander opposing them was able to say any word.
"Throw out the first strike that shall carve out the majesty of our Infinite Hyperversal Haven, my Son."

chapters.title: Chapter 2546 A Cleaving Blade of Destiny! II
paragraphs: His word beckoned forth an existence to make a move.
His son.
Those who heard this scanned their wills to see who would move as from the masses, the radiant golden visage of none other than Henry Osmont stepped forward.
He was adorned in the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia Set as above him lay an innocently bouncing blue slime.
His power was among the highest of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms as he grasped the massive golden Greataxe in his hands and stepped forward!
His son...was an Apex Aeonic Lifeform whose power could rival Grand Elders of Inheritances?

This was the only thought that passed through their heads before a moment later, the visage of Henry Osmont appeared at the forefront of the forces of the Infinite Hyperversal Planes, the moment that the barrier completely disappeared...his hand swung down and carried forth imposing momentum.
It felt heavy.
It felt full of responsibility and a weight that very few beings could bear!
And yet he carried this weight as he called out with his swing.
"Destiny Cleaving."
A greataxe thundered down.
With it came the cleaving of all destiny as wondrously...the might of an Absolute Seed of Extremity came with it!
What!
This single word blazed in the minds of all.
That couldn't be the grandeur of another Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, right?
How many beings on the side of the True Emperor of Quintessence would that make who held such a pristine authority?!
Just...what was this?!
SHIIING!
A golden radiance of destiny overflowed.
And in the skies above, a massive halcyon Axe of destiny eclipsing the whole battlefield formed and thundered down towards the masses!

The very will of the being ushering forth this massive cleaving of destiny seemed to somberly permeate throughout, his eyes clear and filled with clarity as before him, a panel of fantastical details was reflected.
{Name}:: Henry Osmont's Absolute Vitalistic Clone of Extremity
{Realm}:: Third Haven of Destiny
{Lineage}:: Quintessential Hyperversal Emperor(Destined Hyperversal Emperor)
{Titles}:: True Emperor of Destiny, Son of Destiny, Little Henry, One Who Looks to Scale an Impossible Wall...
{Destiny Hyperversal Mana Value}:: 1,299
{Destiny Hyperversal Vitality Value}:: 1,299
{Destiny Hyperversal Soul Value}:: 1,999
{Destiny Hyperversal Defense Value}:: 1,299
{Destiny Hyperversal Damage Value}:: 1,999
{Hyperversal Destiny}:: .3
{Hyperversal Mastery}:: .3
{Absolute Hyperversal Authority Resistance}:: 1%
{Dynamis of Extremity}:: Destined (Absolute), Arcadian(Aeonic)
{Boundaries of Extremity}:: Destiny, Fate, Karma, Fortune, Moirai, Kismet, Quintessence, Wisdom, Blood,
Manadynamics...
He had absorbed the Crimson Extremity Panacea to obtain an even more pristine Extremity Foundation- the Unrecorded Aeonic Destined Hyperversal Extremity Foundation!

With such an outrageous foundation as the foothold, the concepts of Destiny, Fortune, Karma, Moirai, Kismet, Wisdom, Pathfinder, Nexus Emperor, and Quintessence that he had already dabbled in and understood to an extent...were capable of being taken and forming an Absolute Seed of Extremity.
He didn't impose any grand names as he simply called it what he wished for it to be.
Destined.
And so, he used one of the features of the Destined Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
Destiny Cleaving.
An ability that could be used in a myriad of ways- whether through the Aeonic Annals of Extremity or directly as he used it now as in this instance, he utilized it in an extremely offensive fashion.

It was the action of severing the destinies of his targets as the Authority of his Dynamis went so far as to sever their potential, their Foundations, and the very Aspects of Existence that contributed to their destiny if they couldn't stop this authority!
He applied it as an area of effect attack.
He had it descend on the Legions before him!
HO!
The bodies of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Avernus Clan and Singularity Overseers pulsed with grandeur as the lights of hundreds of Dynamis of Extremity rose from every single being.

The figures of the Noblesse Apex Aeonic Lifeforms moved and came close together as their bodies shone with brilliance- dense waves of the VOID erupting out as they overlapped on each other and tried their best to extend to the Legions of Reverend Emperors that were brought into this battle!
Their hearts felt tight at the grandeur of descent of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!
Henry saw the vast sights occurring before him as he closed his eyes.
And the massive golden Greataxe in the skies thundered down and dispersed its authority upon the masses!
It cleaved Destiny!
The Lifeforms from the Singularity Overseers and Avernus Clan would feel the weight of the Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, but they wouldn't perish from it.
But the Noblesse...
The cries of two Noblesse Apex Aeonic Lifeforms rang out as they were on the fringes of the Layers protection they all cast with Commander Vladic at the center.
With his eyes closed, Henry felt his authority surge into their bodies as they cut up everything that contributed to their grand destiny.
Their Foundations.
Their Aspects of Existence.
They were all cleaved as like broken kites, they fell from the skies silently!
Their cleaved fate surged out and grandly rushed towards Henry, but this wasn't all.
If among the Apex Aeonic Noblesse, two could not be protected...what of the masses of Reverend Emperors that the Noblesse called out to form Legions?
The answer was presented in an ecstatic scene.
The myriad of Legions stretched across the aids of the Noblesse were covered by the brief flash of golden light, and then...every single one slumped to the ground.
Destiny pervaded and proliferated all around as Henry felt the souls of all he had cleaved apart the destinies of, what was their streaming out and rushing towards him to become his as he sighed!
They all had their own dreams and fates. They all had their own destinies and hopes to live for millions of years.
And he had reaped away all of this from thousands as this...this was a War!

Along with their Destinies, the effects of the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia Set activated as numerous of deaths among the thousands that died had triggered the {Explosion of Loot} that granted 1,000% more Loot, hundreds of prompts cascading past his closed eyes!

chapters.title: Chapter 2547 The Dead Are Not Done With You! I
paragraphs: When he opened his eyes again, the Apex Battlefield had greatly changed.
Only Apex Aeonic Lifeforms remained.

The gazes of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Avernus Clan and Singularity Overseers were bright as they withstood the weight of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity together, their commanders already making plans!
Ahpuch's visage didn't even cast any defensive skill as he stood tall in the crimson silver skies with a smile.
As for Commander Vladic...the void faded to reveal his figure as his face was ashen when he looked around him!
Had he not utilized the combined strength of the Noblesse Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, he would have just become the first Commander in history to fall in the first strike.
But when he looked at the utterly devastating state of the Legions of his people lying lifeless...his heart burned with immense pain and hate!
His gaze was that of utter malice as he gazed at the single being who had made this move, seeing him hold his Greataxe on his chest as if to pay respects for all that he had instantly killed.
Above him, the Blue Slime pulsed with tendrils of light and jumped from his head as it was about to move.
The force of 200 Apex Aeonic Lifeforms behind him also buzzed with tendrils of light as it seemed they were about to move!
And at such a junction...
"Do not despair for the dead."
The voice of the terrifying Entity floating beside the multicolored throne of the True Emperor of Quintessence thundered out after a shocking first move.
Adorned in verdant obsidian bone Armaments, his movements caught the eyes of the most powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms standing opposite to them as he continued!

"As the First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, I shall etch many lessons of death onto your souls. I will first teach you not to despair for the dead because the dead...are not done with you yet."
HOONG!
As he spoke, the staff in his hands began to shine- Alexander King making his first move at this moment!
But the enemies opposing them were existences that had lived and fought for a great number of years.
The first move was given away...but that was it.
SHIING!

With shocking crimson brilliance, the faraway figure of Ahpuch that had been in the center of the Avernus Clan Elders instantly appeared past the area of the dissolved barrier while he shone with the grandeur of Destruction, his target being none other than Alexander!
The being who had proclaimed himself as the First Commander of Infinite Hyperversal Haven!
Towards the appearance of Ahpuch, Alexander didn't even bat an eye.
His serene gaze remained on the lifeless bodies strewn on the opposing Battlefield as he uttered out.
"Undead...Rise!"
A grand symphony began to pick up pace and became more pronounced.
A symphony of death and destruction!
It was carried forth by the Thanatos Absolute Dynamis of Extremity as it washed out like a tide towards the dead in the distance!
As for Ahpuch's figure...
WAP!
The brilliant visage of Caterina Aurelia Dismukes appeared as her body radiated the grandeur of the Thesauros Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
"Hey big guy, remember me?"
Her figure blazed with brilliance as it thundered forward, but she wasn't alone.
A milky white rose bloomed as from it, the countenance of Genesis thundered out- his sockets filled with an astounding concentration of light as they shot out stellar beams of utter wonder!
Thereafter, another figure rose up as his body shimmered of countless quasars.
His eyes held a hint of unresolved anger and majesty as the gravity around him became twisted, the Mad Apex Emperor Caesar also coming forward to make a move against the newly appearing Ahpuch!
And it still felt like it wasn't enough against this being as finally...
BOOM!

Space fissured and cracked as the massive figure of a Draconic Elephantine Ender of Extremity appeared in the skies, its golden trunk seeming like a cylindrical haven of apocalypse as it thundered down with at the very minimum 2,000 Natural Apex Damage Values!
Aurelia, Orion, Caesar, and Hyperion.
These four beings moved with harmony to rebuff an immense aura of Destruction as the True Emperor of Quintessence had yet to lift a finger from his throne!
Ahpuch moved, but he didn't move alone.
There were hundreds of terrifying Grand Elder Level Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Avernus Clan and the Singularity Overseers as all of them also made a move.

The Apex Battlefield was akin to a brilliant stellar field of blooming light as hundreds of authorities of Dynamis of Extremity were called out, the eyes of the Elders from the Avernus Clan cold and decisive as they moved in groups of ten while calling out.
"Planar Domain of Destruction."
"Planar Domain of Cataclysm."
"Planar Domain..."

Planar Domains of Dynamis of Extremity began to unfold en masse as reality itself was being twisted, dozens of Elders appeared before the army of the True Emperor of Quintessence as they fought with power and synchrony!

The Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of the Singularity Overseers weren't far behind them as Zeitgeist clasped his hands, a heavy force of Devouring erupting out as around him, bestial Roars echoed out as the Tamed Apex Astral Leviathans bellowed out while moving like mountains.

It was a horrifying counterattack that pitted the very concepts of Extremity the two sides grasped, the impact no doubt being something that would produce casualties as all sides surged forward with power!
On the side of the True Emperor of Quintessence, the Son of Destiny rose his Greataxe again as along with him...
RAA!
A gallant existence with a golden beak turned into a stream of light that surged forward, its eruption only matched by a form shrouded in darkness drawing out his Katana and calling out coldly.
"Planar Severing."

Kazuhiko's voice carried weight and excitement as he moved, the skies above his head also changing colors at this moment and becoming painted with a cerulean hue as the countenance of a certain Blue Slime expanded massively- a unique aura of Devouring far different from what the Elders of the Singularity Overseers released emanating from it as it was ready to absorb any authorities thrown its way!
The scene was completely chaotic with too many moving pieces.
But some pieces were more influential and crucial than others.

But he was given free rein as due to this...
A verdant obsidian light began to shine.
An aura of death began to rise.

And the lifeless bodies in the distance...terrifying waves of deathly authority pulsed from them as their very Recorded Histories were being changed, monstrous anomalies knowing nothing but death about to unfold!

chapters.title: Chapter 2548 The Dead Are Not Done With You! II
paragraphs: One had to have a truly special pair of eyes to capture and understand the horror about to unfold.

Due to the Convergence of so many powerful factions in the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution, there were actually a great number of beings who could pierce through the veils of secrecy and easily gaze upon the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!
There were many...and then there was Ayame.
Ayame of Infinite Extremity!

She stood from her throne as she wasn't the only one, the figures of Erikson and Atlas being the same as their gazes were locked onto the confounding authority of life and death radiating from the existence beside Noah- the one who had termed himself the First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven!

Ayame's gaze was locked onto this authority of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity and how it had begun to suffuse and build up in the surroundings, but more so how it flowed into the lifeless bodies of the Legions the Son of the True Emperor of Quintessence had struck down with a single strike.
Her pupils constricted as her gaze saw an entirely different scene.
One must not forget that in the Initiation Step of Extremity Sanctification, only three beings had attained genuine Crimson Extremity Panaceas.
One of those beings was Ayame!
The other two beings attained shocking Hyperversal Extremity Foundations, so one could only assume how grand of a change she had undergone.
But among her many changes, her perceptiveness, freedom, and control of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity became utterly obscene.
Her eyes could see the locked and ended Records of the dead Reverend Emperors and the 2 Apex Aeonic Noblesse that had fallen.
Locked Records.
Records of beings whose lives had come to an end!

She saw the authority of the First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven flow into these Locked Records as an instant after...it began re-writing them in a taboo fashion as it utterly altered these Records and Unlocked them once more!
"Do not despair for the dead..." She stared at this blankly as she found herself repeating the words he had said.

How could she not when she stared at the impossible task of the Records of thousands of existences being altered right before her eyes- something that would need pristine concentration and heavy Soul Values to alter in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, and yet it occurred simultaneously for thousands as thereafter...
THUMP!
Their lifeless bodies began to pulse with deathly essence as their Altered Records burned even more fiercely than when they were alive.
And from them...she saw a process of ascension as their new archives were utterly horrific to gaze at.

Their bodies pulsed with verdant obsidian tendrils of light as their skin and musculature receded, a bony crystalline exterior being seen as each one of these rising Entities had their own peculiarities- but they were skeletal in nature!
And from their birth, Ayame was able to peer at the archives that they were giving off.
From the bodies of the Reverend Emperors, a single Record repeated itself.
{The Prince Tier Thanatos Vassal, Death Knight, has been born.}
{The Prince Tier Thanatos Vassal, Death Knight, has been born...}

Their Altered Records were similar even though their forms varied, their backbone remaining skeletal in nature as their sockets began to shine with grand verdant obsidian flames that caused the hue of the skies to match it.
Ayame stared at all of the different variations of the Prince Tier Thanatos Vassals with wonder until her eyes came to lock onto the already altering bodies of the 2 Apex Aeonic Noblesse.
These were even more obscene as the Noblesse humanoid forms expanded rapidly, dense verdant black smoke covering the region they were in as from them, massive figures rose!
One held a serrated bony skeletal body of a creature reminiscent to a dragon form, expansive bone wings spreading out left and right as its record unfolded before Ayame's eyes.
{The King Tier Thanatos Vassal, Void Dracolich, has been born.}
Void Dracolich!

From its crystalline obsidian green bones, liquified death dripped freely as its draconic jaws rose up to the crimson silver skies and opened to release a billowing mist of death that covered the whole region!
A mist of authority that Ayame knew had to be the Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that brought this creature to be.

Its power was unimaginably higher in this altered Record compared to the History of the Noblesse that had died, Ayame fully understanding the words that the First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven had uttered as she heard Erikson speak the last words that reverberated out with a grim expression!
"The dead are not done with you..."
WAA!

An existence who could alter the records of perished beings and utilize them appeared before their eyes as even though it wasn't something revolutionary or new, the way he did it was utterly obscene and full of impossibilities!
Ayame's piercing eyes were one of the few verifying this as she saw the record of the last Apex Noblesse that fell flash brightly.
{The King Tier Thanatos Vassal, Chaos Nightwalker, has been born.}

A second King Tier Thanatos Vassal rose as this one held a titanic humanoid bony form, his visage releasing a deathly glacial chill around him as he looked like a mummified Emperor shining with white and green light.

The region around him very quickly had its existence frozen as glacial tendrils of light began to proliferate, its deathly cold sockets lighting up with verdant obsidian flames that Ayame was briefly lost in!
And at such a moment, the flames burned brightly as they turned towards her direction.

It was a change that instantly caused her guard to rise as the verdant obsidian flames felt like they were staring straight at her, and it wasn't the Thanatos Vassal that was gazing at her...but their Master!
Their Master who radiated dense Absolute Dynamis of Extremity besides the True Emperor of Quintessence!

And through the Records of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, Ayame heard a single word from the Will within the verdant obsidian flames as thereafter, her entry and stare were restricted from any more information.
'Nosy.'
