chapters.title: Chapter 2549 The Dead Are Not Done With You! III
paragraphs: Nosy!
Ayame fell back on her seat in surprise as she was flabbergasted when this single word thundered in her mind.
Who was she? What Inheritance did she belong to? What pristine Extremity Foundation did she now hold? What terrifying access did she have into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity?

For her to be seen by another soul while peering through the Records of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, and then subsequently blocked by them...this should only be something a Hyperversal Extremity was capable of- or an existence with an extremely domineering Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that couldn't easily be grasped by an Apex Aeonic Lifeform!
And yet...
ROAAR!

Her thoughts were brought to a stop as the deathly energies in the Apex Battlefield reached the peak, the Void Dracolich roaring out and instantly rising in the air with a power that terrified normal Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, while the Chaos Nightwalker began to rise with chilling waves of essence with a slightly more terrifying aura!

They were followed by droves of Prince Tier Thanatos Vassals that took on the forms of a myriad of Undead- all of them moving in sequence and like a billowing wave of death as they swarmed the forces of Singularity Overseers and Avernus Clan from behind!
{Name}:: Thanatos Vassal Death Knight (Prince Tier)
{Realm}:: Second Haven of Thanatos
{Lineage}:: Quintessential Undead Thanatos Vassal
{Titles}:: Slave of Thanatos, Death Seeker...
{Apex Thanatos Mana Value}:: 100
{Apex Thanatos Vitality Value}:: 100
{Apex Thanatos Soul Value}:: 100
{Apex Thanatos Defense Value}:: 100
{Apex Thanatos Damage Value}:: 100
{Dynamis of Extremity}:: Thanatos(Absolute)- Limited Access
{Boundaries of Extremity}:: Death, Necromancy, Quintessence...
The stats of the thousands of what used to be Reverend Emperors showed themselves before Noah as they showed a terrifying potential and possibility.
When the Thanatos Absolute Dynamis of Extremity was converged past 50%, the stats of rising Quintessential Undead Thanatos Vassals was at a minimum of 10 Apex Thanatos Soul Values!
Now that Noah had taken Thanatos to full converge and held yet another dazzling Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity in his soul, this power was shown to be even more obscene!
And this...was the transformation of existences that weren't Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
The Altered Records of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms produced an {Apex Thanatos Mana Value}:: 999
even more terrifying result!
{Name}:: Thanatos Vassal Void Dracolich (King Tier)
{Realm}:: Third Haven of Thanatos
{Lineage}:: Quintessential Undead Thanatos Vassal
{Titles}:: Draco, Slave of Thanatos, Death Seeker...
{Apex Thanatos Mana Value}:: 999
{Apex Thanatos Vitality Value}:: 999
{Apex Thanatos Soul Value}:: 999
{Apex Thanatos Defense Value}:: 999
{Apex Thanatos Damage Value}:: 999
{Dynamis of Extremity}:: Thanatos(Absolute)- Limited Access
{Boundaries of Extremity}:: Death, Necromancy, Quintessence...
A violation of common sense and nature.
The stats of the dead Apex Noblesse were utterly transformed and made into a terrifying Entity that nearly gave off the intense aura of a Grand Elder of an Inheritance.

With their limited access to the Thanatos Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, they very well represented this terror and power as they instantly moved and brought down tendrils of death from behind enemy lines!
It caused chaos to instantly spread, Noah- nay, Alexander King wasn't done.
Quintessential Undead Rise was the first taste.

What was truly terrifying had yet to come as at this moment, he saw the billowing waves of strength that the existence who was stopped by Aurelia, Orion, Caesar, and Hyperion expressed as his terrifying waves of Destruction were pushing all 4 back!
For such a being, Alexander's staff shone as he called out calmly.
"Quintessential Thanatos Embodiment."
BZZZT!
The crimson silver skies darkened.
Verdant black clouds and tendrils of grandeur began to seethe and gather as above Alexander's terrifying visage, a stellar doorway made of bones instantly bloomed and radiated terror!

And the instant it formed, a skeletal hand pulsing with terrifying power erupted out and formed into a fist- a force bursting out to instantly shatter the door of bones as deathly mist covered everything!
And from this deathly mist...
{Ka Ka Ka!}
A deathly cackling could be heard.
It was a cackling of a lich that reveled in death and destruction.
The deathly mist dispersed to reveal a figure shrouded in a billowing black robe that covered a crystalline skeletal humanoid form with withered flesh tightly wound on stellar bones.

On the back of this skeletal figure, an expansive aurora of verdant black wings expanded out gloriously as above his skeletal head, an Obsidian flaming crown rotated with mad power while releasing tendrils of grandeur in the surroundings!

Its sockets were pure verdant flames of life as they contrasted beautifully with the aura of death he released, the cackling coming as he moved his jaws up and down as they seemed to show happiness at having finally returned.
Returned.
It meant he had been here before as this was none other than a manifestation of an Arch Lich that the True Emperor of Quintessence had utilized before!
Under a different name now. And yet holding even more grandeur.
Its flaming sockets gazed at the battlefield as its jaws formed into a cruel smile, the power that it released being something that shone among the brightest on this Battlefield!
{Name}:: Quintessential Thanatos Embodiment(Thanatos Haven Lich Ra'Zan)
{Realm}:: Fourth Haven of Thanatos
{Lineage}:: Quintessential Thanatos Embodiment
{Titles}:: The Arch Lich, Haven Lich, Ka Ka Ka!...
{Apex Thanatos Mana Value}:: 9,999
{Apex Thanatos Vitality Value}:: 9,999
{Apex Thanatos Soul Value}:: 9,999
{Apex Thanatos Defense Value}:: 9,999
{Apex Thanatos Damage Value}:: 9,999
{Dynamis of Extremity}:: Thanatos(Absolute)
{Boundaries of Extremity}:: Death, Necromancy, Quintessence...
Thanatos Haven Lich Ra'Zan.
He came to be once more as his burning sockets transformed into a cruel smile that caused the swarming Elders of the Singularity Overseers and Avernus Clan to feel a chill and a sense of danger!
A billowing aura of death surged around him as he raised his skeletal hands up- a crystalline bone staff forming within them while he called out.
{Rise, my children!}
A call was made as behind it, gates of hell seemingly began to open as Legions of Undead were waiting behind them....
The Avernus Clan was a terrifying behemoth that had lived for too many eons.
Those that were a part of this force...were the brightest and most astute entities as if they weren't, they were forcefully forged to be this way!
This was why amidst the unfolding chaotic battle, there were portions of the Wills of the Avernus Clan Elders engaging in this battle resonating and communicating with each other.

They all joined together in a unique domain accessible only by their wills as it manifested as a forum of a roundtable surrounded by thrones, with the manifested figures of the prominent Avernus Clan Elders sitting on these thrones as they discussed the battle at hand and made judgments rapidly- barely a fraction of a nanosecond passing between their discussions!

"Ahpuch, can you handle the monstrosity that this First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven has called out and its minions? It exudes the authority of the Absolute Dynamis of Extremity even more than the Death Minions risen behind us."
A voice from one of the thrones rose towards the visage of Ahpuch who had an expression of utmost happiness at this moment.
He nodded as he looked at the over a dozen Commanding Avernus Elders in this manifested space around him.
The strongest of the Battalion of 200 released on this Apex Battlefield!

Each of them held approximate Apex Aeonic Soul Values ranging from 8,000-18,000 as he...exceeded them all in this aspect! The rest of the 200 apart from these Commanding Avernus Elders had an approximate average of 2,000-4,000 Apex Aeonic Soul Values as there was a vast discrepancy between power that was determined by many factors!

"I'll take care of both this Lich and the Master that called him forth. Will you all be able to handle everything else? This is a War that the Avernus Clan cannot lose, or our souls will not be let off even in death!"

The Wills of the Elders knew this very well as they nodded, a woman with burning black flames on her head taking on a leading role and nodding while they all scrutinized the battle and made judgments quickly.
"Very well, if you see anyone being overpowered, lend aid right away and work together to grind down the enemies, and...oh for fucks sake!"
Her words had to change mid-way as they saw the authority of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity gather around the First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven again.
"He's calling out more of his Undead Minions...since we don't know what their might will be, try to stop him if you can!"
They quickly conveyed and moved as their bodies on the Apex Battlefield heard ecstatic words.
{Chthonian Sinners of Thanatos}.
Four words.
They called forth the advent of even more death and destruction!

Now that Noah had taken Thanatos to full converge and held yet another dazzling Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity in his soul, this power was shown to be even more obscene!
And this...was the transformation of existences that weren't Apex Aeonic Lifeforms.
The Altered Records of the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms produced an {Apex Thanatos Mana Value}:: 999
even more terrifying result!
{Name}:: Thanatos Vassal Void Dracolich (King Tier)
{Realm}:: Third Haven of Thanatos
{Lineage}:: Quintessential Undead Thanatos Vassal
{Titles}:: Draco, Slave of Thanatos, Death Seeker...
{Apex Thanatos Mana Value}:: 999
{Apex Thanatos Vitality Value}:: 999
{Apex Thanatos Soul Value}:: 999
{Apex Thanatos Defense Value}:: 999
{Apex Thanatos Damage Value}:: 999
{Dynamis of Extremity}:: Thanatos(Absolute)- Limited Access
{Boundaries of Extremity}:: Death, Necromancy, Quintessence...
A violation of common sense and nature.
The stats of the dead Apex Noblesse were utterly transformed and made into a terrifying Entity that nearly gave off the intense aura of a Grand Elder of an Inheritance.

With their limited access to the Thanatos Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, they very well represented this terror and power as they instantly moved and brought down tendrils of death from behind enemy lines!
It caused chaos to instantly spread, Noah- nay, Alexander King wasn't done.
Quintessential Undead Rise was the first taste.

What was truly terrifying had yet to come as at this moment, he saw the billowing waves of strength that the existence who was stopped by Aurelia, Orion, Caesar, and Hyperion expressed as his terrifying waves of Destruction were pushing all 4 back!
For such a being, Alexander's staff shone as he called out calmly.
"Quintessential Thanatos Embodiment."
BZZZT!
The crimson silver skies darkened.
Verdant black clouds and tendrils of grandeur began to seethe and gather as above Alexander's terrifying visage, a stellar doorway made of bones instantly bloomed and radiated terror!

And the instant it formed, a skeletal hand pulsing with terrifying power erupted out and formed into a fist- a force bursting out to instantly shatter the door of bones as deathly mist covered everything!
And from this deathly mist...
{Ka Ka Ka!}
A deathly cackling could be heard.
It was a cackling of a lich that reveled in death and destruction.
The deathly mist dispersed to reveal a figure shrouded in a billowing black robe that covered a crystalline skeletal humanoid form with withered flesh tightly wound on stellar bones.

On the back of this skeletal figure, an expansive aurora of verdant black wings expanded out gloriously as above his skeletal head, an Obsidian flaming crown rotated with mad power while releasing tendrils of grandeur in the surroundings!

Its sockets were pure verdant flames of life as they contrasted beautifully with the aura of death he released, the cackling coming as he moved his jaws up and down as they seemed to show happiness at having finally returned.
Returned.
It meant he had been here before as this was none other than a manifestation of an Arch Lich that the True Emperor of Quintessence had utilized before!
Under a different name now.
And yet holding even more grandeur.
Its flaming sockets gazed at the battlefield as its jaws formed into a cruel smile, the power that it released being something that shone among the brightest on this Battlefield!
{Name}:: Quintessential Thanatos Embodiment(Thanatos Haven Lich Ra'Zan)
{Realm}:: Fourth Haven of Thanatos
{Lineage}:: Quintessential Thanatos Embodiment
{Titles}:: The Arch Lich, Haven Lich, Ka Ka Ka!...
{Apex Thanatos Mana Value}:: 9,999
{Apex Thanatos Vitality Value}:: 9,999
{Apex Thanatos Soul Value}:: 9,999
{Apex Thanatos Defense Value}:: 9,999
{Apex Thanatos Damage Value}:: 9,999
{Dynamis of Extremity}:: Thanatos(Absolute)
{Boundaries of Extremity}:: Death, Necromancy, Quintessence...
Thanatos Haven Lich Ra'Zan.
He came to be once more as his burning sockets transformed into a cruel smile that caused the swarming Elders of the Singularity Overseers and Avernus Clan to feel a chill and a sense of danger!
A billowing aura of death surged around him as he raised his skeletal hands up- a crystalline bone staff forming within them while he called out.
{Rise, my children!}
A call was made as behind it, gates of hell seemingly began to open as Legions of Undead were waiting behind them....
The Avernus Clan was a terrifying behemoth that had lived for too many eons.
Those that were a part of this force...were the brightest and most astute entities as if they weren't, they were forcefully forged to be this way!
This was why amidst the unfolding chaotic battle, there were portions of the Wills of the Avernus Clan Elders engaging in this battle resonating and communicating with each other.

They all joined together in a unique domain accessible only by their wills as it manifested as a forum of a roundtable surrounded by thrones, with the manifested figures of the prominent Avernus Clan Elders sitting on these thrones as they discussed the battle at hand and made judgments rapidly- barely a fraction of a nanosecond passing between their discussions!
"Ahpuch, can you handle the monstrosity that this First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven has called out and its minions?
It exudes the authority of the Absolute Dynamis of Extremity even more than the Death Minions risen behind us."
A voice from one of the thrones rose towards the visage of Ahpuch who had an expression of utmost happiness at this moment.
He nodded as he looked at the over a dozen Commanding Avernus Elders in this manifested space around him.
The strongest of the Battalion of 200 released on this Apex Battlefield!
Each of them held approximate Apex Aeonic Soul Values ranging from 8,000-18,000 as he...exceeded them all in this aspect!

The rest of the 200 apart from these Commanding Avernus Elders had an approximate average of 2,000-4,000 Apex Aeonic Soul Values as there was a vast discrepancy between power that was determined by many factors!
"I'll take care of both this Lich and the Master that called him forth.
Will you all be able to handle everything else?
This is a War that the Avernus Clan cannot lose, or our souls will not be let off even in death!"

The Wills of the Elders knew this very well as they nodded, a woman with burning black flames on her head taking on a leading role and nodding while they all scrutinized the battle and made judgments quickly.
"Very well, if you see anyone being overpowered, lend aid right away and work together to grind down the enemies, and...oh for fucks sake!"
Her words had to change mid-way as they saw the authority of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity gather around the First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven again.
"He's calling out more of his Undead Minions...since we don't know what their might will be, try to stop him if you can!"
They quickly conveyed and moved as their bodies on the Apex Battlefield heard ecstatic words.
{Chthonian Sinners of Thanatos}.
Four words.
They called forth the advent of even more death and destruction!

chapters.title: Chapter 2550 Madness! I
paragraphs: The Thanatos Haven Lich Ra'Zan.
He was the Quintessential Thanatos Embodiment of the Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that held 21 Boundaries within it!
He could exist from the moment the Dynamis was Recorded as now that he was out, even death could never truly reclaim him unless the Thanatos Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity was destroyed.
'Death.'
BZZT!
The bright verdant flames in his sockets blazed as this idea that was at his very core buzzed with wonder!
With it ringing in his deathly will, he gazed at the battlefield before him as what he saw was very different from what others saw.
His vision showed the myriad of beings represented as brilliant illusory hearts of differing sizes and intensity!
These hearts were filled with life, concepts, and everything that defined these beings.
The Avernus Clan Elders had their vast majority of forces showing illusory hearts half the size of the Haven Lich himself.
About a dozen of them almost neared the same size as his heart by about 80%!
This proportion remained the same for the 300 forces of the Singularity Overseers, where only about 10 out of the 300 Apex Singularity Overseer Elders commanded strength similar to him!
The massive Apex Astral Leviathans they stood on were barely above the Prince Tier Thanatos Vassal level that could be conjured by his Master from the lowest Dead Record.
Ra'Zan read the field of battle and scanned all of this in an instant as behind him, he also saw the forces called out by his Master.

The 300 radiant Enders of Extremity were great accomplishments as their illusory hearts under his gaze seemed the same as the Apex Elder on the enemy side, their power singularly being 4,000 Apex Aeonic Soul Values as some Enders like the Draconic Elephantine Ender trying to hold off the strongest enemy here held a bit more Values than the other Enders!

As for the 200 Vassals that followed his Master, their Values could be set at a minimum of 1,000 due to their own Foundations and the effects of the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia they adorned as beings like the Son of Destiny, Aurelia, Orion, and Caesar went towards or slightly exceeded the 2,000 Apex Aeonic Soul Value benchmark.

The Haven Lich Ra'Zan could see all of this with a glance as the Vassals of his Master would have to move in groups of two or three in order to survive against their enemies, with the Enders of Nature capable of moving by themselves to withstand the enemy Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
His Master existed to balance out this discrepancy as death would soon begin to proliferate and the number of their forces would rise.
Then there was him.
The Haven Lich!
His purpose here...
THUMP!
He felt his illusory dead heart beat with astonishing life as he came to gaze upon the strongest enemy combatant here.
He knew the Record of this being from his Master.
Ahpuch.
His illusory beating heart...was the largest on this Battlefield!
Larger than even the beating heart of his Master as this being held a much greater edge in the concepts that made his Heart.
But this didn't alarm the Haven Lich.
Because to him, it didn't matter if the enemy had greater Values.
So long as they fell prey to the sweet release of death...their values would mean nothing!

His Master had just cast {Chthonian Sinners of Thanatos}- another boon of the Thanatos Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that Ra'Zan stemmed from as another hindrance against this enemy, the dense aura of death becoming ever concentrated as at the same time- the illusory heart of Ahpuch blazed as this being also made a grand move!
Ra'Zan knew the children that would come from {Chthonian Sinners of Thanatos} as surely, they would be a sufficient deterrent against this enemy.
But Ra'Zan thought about himself as the unimaginable flow of deathly essence coursing through him and the endless essence flowing from his Master.
He could draw everything from his Master as resources were not an issue for him.
His Master.
The True Emperor of Quintessence!
His Master concentrated on many things apart from death that he didn't really need to.
Ra'Zan knew this innately as he had appeared when his Master beckoned throughout his reign, but he didn't stay out for long.
He wanted to let his Master know that he didn't need to focus on anything else.
He wanted to let his Master know that if he just concentrated on Death...all of his problems would be solved!
'Ka Ka Ka! Why am I thinking so much? I only need to let death flow through me!'
BZZT!
He grasped the crystalline bone staff in his hands.
Tendrils of verdant and black light overflowed as his raging verdant flames dimmed!
The bone crown spinning atop his skull flashed with brilliance as within the body of the Haven Lich Ra'Zan, an illusory Thanatos Perennial Yggdrasils of Extremity becoming ever real!
He was embodying it as at this moment, he let the death he was used to so much flow freely into the concepts that made this Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity.

He saw how they were intricately connected as his authority surged at their very stable center as the deathly authority at his core guided all of these 21 concepts to converge at the very center of the illusory Yggdrasil of Extremity as in the next moment...he breathed only death with the Methodology belonging to his master. And thereafter...
CRACK!
Something bloomed at the very center.
It was akin to a Singularity being born as for Ra'Zan, it was another Heart.
A Vessel of Life and Death!

With it, Ra'Zan took reign and resonated all 21 Concepts that made Thanatos to a terrifying degree- more so than his Master currently did as the Thanatos Perennial Yggdrasils of Extremity solidified in his body!
He wanted to let his Master know. And so he let his actions speak for themselves.
'Ka Ka Ka! Yes...this is it. This is death!'
Ra'Zan bellowed out in his mind as he felt his Values break past 10,000 and begin to climb upwards.

He grasped Recorded Histories of Deaths in the very Aeonic Annals of Extremity and drew them to himself as his visage began to grow larger and more dominating, his flaming sockets coming to focus on Ahpuch and the many enemies before it as his skeletal staff waved forward.
'Here is a peek of death and madness...a reflection of my mind as I lay inactive all this time!'

chapters.title: Chapter 2551 Madness! II
paragraphs: {The Quintessential Thanatos Embodiment- Thanatos Haven Lich Ra'Zan, has spurred a Mutation in the center of the Quintessential Absolute Thanatos Dynamis of Extremity!}

{Thanatos Haven Lich Ra'Zan is circulating the core concept of his existence across the Quintessential AbsoluteThanatos Dynamis of Extremity, giving birth to the Thanatos Vessel of Life and Death that culminates all of his achievements.}
{The feature of Quintessential Thanatos Embodiment has independently undergone Quintessential advancement!}
{Many more possibilities and tools are now accessible in the hands of the Thanatos Haven Lich Ra'Zan.}
The prompts cascaded one after another before Noah's eyes as he smiled.
And he could only smile as this was something he had caught glimpses of!
Now, he wanted to see just how stupendous it could grow to be.
Ahpuch.
This was the name he proclaimed for himself when he was born.
A name that meant death, disaster, and destruction.
And in the region he was currently in, there was a dense amount of death and destruction!
Within this atmosphere and the enemy Lifeforms rising beside the True Emperor of Quintessence, Ahpuch could feel the chains of the unreachable 17th Boundary Layer of Destruction loosening!
It told him that so long as he destroyed everything here...there was a chance.
And this was a chance he wouldn't miss.

He gazed at the massive form of a Draconic Elephantine Ender, and three Apex Aeonic Lifeforms that were bright in their own right, one of them being among those he had half-heartedly chased earlier as he saw they would lead him to a grander path.
A meeting of the moment this Apex War unfolded and the visage of the True Emperor of Quintessence!
Now, they stood before him against him as they made grand moves.
Now he...would make his own grand move and show them how far out of their depths they were.
That the one to face him had yet to step up!
That when he merely moved toward them, they would be forced to move back!
He took a step forward.
And...
HOONG!
Amidst the destruction, a terrifying authority of nothingness shot forth from him like an expanding bubble.
It was none other than Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
The moment it erupted from him, the four beings standing before his path had their gazes change as their bodies glimmered with defensive brilliance and forcefully moved back.
And how could they not? Their very Souls screamed danger from being enveloped by the authority outside of space, time, and reality itself!
"Fight."
His voice rose out across the battlefield for the first time as it thundered with brilliance.
Fight.
Was he telling the battalions of the Apex Aeonic Elders behind him this?
He took another step, and the area of effect of the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority became ever grander and vaster as the four beings standing before him were pushed further back!
The visage of Aurelia had an enraged and distasteful expression while Hyperion and the others were somber.
"Fight!"
Ahpuch called out again, this time with even more ferocity as he took a large stride forward!

The enemies before him were pushed back past a certain dazzling multicolored throne and the figures of the self-proclaimed First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven, as well as the Undead Entity he had called out.
They were the only ones that didn't move a single step backwards as Ahpuch's eyes shone with brilliance.
His current armaments burned into crimson flames as the authority of Destruction transformed into a heavy armor that covered all parts of his body apart from his head.
His hair now burned crimson and black as his eyes shone like burning suns.

The immense aura of Destruction burned brightly around him as with the periphery of the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority about to spill into the Armies of the True Emperor of Quintessence, he called out for the third time.
"Fight!"
Before his word even ended, the visage of Alexander King raised his skull staff and pointed out.
And from it, a similar eruption of nothingness erupted in a grand show of glory!
It was another being who could use Vacuous Hyperversal Authority- or at least had access to it as Ahpuch could tell its form was a bit different!

A circular domain of nothingness tinged with destruction barreled down as another domain of nothingness tinged with brilliance erupted out to stop it, a shocking clash erupting out as reality began to break down!
BZZZT!
The domains didn't even touch.

Just nearing each other caused the erasure of reality between them as this junction of space seemed like a massive fissure erupted- the crimson silver skies above being parted and seething out while the earth below that had begun to be covered by the verdant obsidian mist of death did the same.
It felt like the battlefield was divided into two halves at such a moment as the masses of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms stood up with their mouths snapping open.
They couldn't sit still for this.
They couldn't not focus and observe this grandeur!
"Vacuous Hyperversal Authority..."
The Priestess Persephone uttered out in a far corner away from the battlefield as she wasn't the only one.
Many eyes watched the clash of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority unleashed by two beings as how frequently seen was such an authority?
How important were the personages that held it?

A clash of this authority alone divided the battlefield in half as two central forces that shone like burning suns gazed at each other, the terrifying First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven adorned in his bone Armaments spoke out with majesty.
"Fight, you say...but this will not be a fight. This will only be a trampling."
WAA!
The voice was filled with confidence as why was this? The enemy was powerful. The Apex Elders were veterans of the battlefield with a myriad of Dynamis of Extremity under their banner!
So what gave the forces of the True Emperor of Quintessence so much confidence?
SHIING!

On the side of the True Emperor of Quintessence calmly sitting on his throne, 7 points in space had long since ruptured into massive obsidian portals as at this point, blazing auras in titanic forms began to step out.
And before anyone else could make a move, a raspy voice that had its own portals formed cackled as its voice sought to dominate the battlefield!
{Death.}
WAA!
{There shall only be death.}
The voice was raspy as the Haven Lich Ra'Zan moved.
A lich controlled a myriad of things to do with death, but did this only mean summoning legions of undead?
The answer was a resounding no.
Death came in many forms.

And the Thanatos Haven Lich Ra'Zan sought to show these uncultured beings just how many forms death could take as his staff began to wave amidst the clash of the Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities, his voice ringing out multiple times over!
{Haven Curse of Corruption.}
{Unrecorded Plague of the End.}
{Aura of Fear.}
{Sea of Agony.}
One after another!

Utterly debilitating abilities bloomed as a billowing smoke of death began to surge out like waves as at this moment, the two buzzing domains of the Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities were canceled out as the waves of death thundered down upon the masses like an endless sea!

A clash of this authority alone divided the battlefield in half as two central forces that shone like burning suns gazed at each other, the terrifying First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven adorned in his bone Armaments spoke out with majesty.
"Fight, you say...but this will not be a fight.
This will only be a trampling."
WAA!
The voice was filled with confidence as why was this?
The enemy was powerful.
The Apex Elders were veterans of the battlefield with a myriad of Dynamis of Extremity under their banner!
So what gave the forces of the True Emperor of Quintessence so much confidence?
SHIING!

On the side of the True Emperor of Quintessence calmly sitting on his throne, 7 points in space had long since ruptured into massive obsidian portals as at this point, blazing auras in titanic forms began to step out.
And before anyone else could make a move, a raspy voice that had its own portals formed cackled as its voice sought to dominate the battlefield!
{Death.}
WAA!
{There shall only be death.}
The voice was raspy as the Haven Lich Ra'Zan moved.
A lich controlled a myriad of things to do with death, but did this only mean summoning legions of undead?
The answer was a resounding no.
Death came in many forms.

And the Thanatos Haven Lich Ra'Zan sought to show these uncultured beings just how many forms death could take as his staff began to wave amidst the clash of the Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities, his voice ringing out multiple times over!
{Haven Curse of Corruption.}
{Unrecorded Plague of the End.}
{Aura of Fear.}
{Sea of Agony.}
One after another!

Utterly debilitating abilities bloomed as a billowing smoke of death began to surge out like waves as at this moment, the two buzzing domains of the Vacuous Hyperversal Authorities were canceled out as the waves of death thundered down upon the masses like an endless sea!

chapters.title: Chapter 2552 Madness! III
paragraphs: The shocking scenes of the Apex Battlefield flowed like films on an illusory screen as multiple areas were focused on and seen with utmost clarity- the clashing of Dynamis of Extremity and Boundaries felt as if the watchers were right there in the midst of the battle.

The illusory screen showing the scene of the clash between the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority of Ahpuch and Alexander had taken center point, while the Haven Lich Ra'Zan who had begun to release waves of deathly authority over the whole Battlefield took another major focus on his own screen!
As for those watching...
{The battle has begun for a little while now. Can you see what the outcome would be?}
The voice of an aged Hyperversal Extremity thundered out.
He was adorned in a light red and white robe that held the burning symbol of infinity behind it, a horn rising on his forehead that looked quite similar to the one of the woman sitting before him.

Around the illusory screens they were viewing, a blazing flames seethed as molten mountains and burning suns were spread out all around, all of them pulsing with tremendous Authority of heat that was directed and focused on the single figure of Ayame's Main Body!

She was adorned in a light white gown as her expression was hardened, tremendous heat flowing over her skin as multiple Boundaries were forcefully being cycled through her body to try and achieve nothing else other than the Convergence of enough Boundaries to form an Absolute Seed of Extremity.
Her Grandfather stood behind her as with the aid of a being like him who held too many Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, it was only an inevitability!

What she was doing now was the same as many other powerful Scions- sending their Aeonic Soul Clones to observe the changes of the Extremity Vein of Dissolution to watch the Apex War unfolding while their main bodies accepted the support of their Clan or Inheritance to undergo a thorough advancement in power.
At this moment, Ayame's Grandfather had asked her the very hard question of whether she could already see the outcome of this battle!
Sensing a bit of hesitation from her, the Hyperversal Extremity with a brooding aura that burned vigorously among any Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities laughed and spoke lightly.

{Little Ayame, do not let the veiled records of a single being break your confidence. You can see the strands of all reality and read them through the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. So now...I want you to provide me with a thorough analysis of the battle. Of all the pieces involved.}
WAA!
The words roused Ayame out of her stupor as she nodded.
She could read and see many things about reality as after gazing at the many moving pieces, she began.

"In any battle with Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, victory is truly decided by the strongest commander leading a side. So long as their Boundary Layers are higher, their closer ties to Extremity will ensure that they oppress the enemy commander as their authority will also spill over to their soldiers. In this case, this Apex War's winner should be Ahpuch as he holds multiple Boundaries at the 16th Layer, holds Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, and very likely had his own Absolute Seed Extremity forged!"
Ayame spoke calmly as she felt her Grandfather smile behind her, and she continued.

"But...this Apex War is different. The enemy Ahpuch and the forces backing him are facing...my eyes tell me that he shouldn't have exceeded the 13th Boundary Layer. And yet, the Commander wields an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as well, and multiple people on his side also wield Absolute Dynamis of Extremity. This acts to balance the scales somewhat, but then...there comes the effectiveness and uniqueness of one Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that was shown on the side of the True Emperor of Quintessence."
Her words came out rapidly as her Grandfather's deep voice rang out behind her.

{Nice catch. Yes...from the Records he did not hide, he termed it the Thanatos Absolute Dynamis of Extremity. This is likely not a normal Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, but one that has the Convergence of at least 20 concepts. Something that only pristinely talented Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who have achieved the 17th Layer and are on the cusp of Extremity can ever fathom to achieve...
something that you can more easily do as a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity.}

As the two of them spoke, their eyes came to focus on the visage of Alexander King and the Haven Lich Ra'Zan, as well as the 7 cracks in the skies that showed off another eruption of this Thanatos Absolute Dynamis of Extremity was about to unfold!

"Now, the outcome of the battle has become centered on the pieces connected to this unique Absolute Dynamis of Extremity. I could barely grasp the Recorded History of the First Commander to be Alexander King as the Entity he called out should be known as a Haven Lich. Their abilities will cause the favor of this War to tip towards them if Ahpuch and the truly powerful Elder Apex Aeonic Lifeforms do not stop their abilities from spreading..."
As she spoke, they observed the dense authority of death cast by the Haven Lich to descend on a wide area.

It washed over the visage of Ahpuch and then spread onto the 200 Avernus Clan Elders, going even further to also land on the 300 Singularity Overseer Elders as their bodies lit up with their own defensive authorities to resist it!
When reading the deathly authority with the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, Ayame's eyes felt troubled as she continued.

"The authority is concentrated as plagues and curses that lower and restrict the authority of their targets. This Haven Lich should have spent a lot of its Soul Values to cast such wide ranging debuff abilities, and yet..."
KA KA KA!

They heard the cackling laugh through the screen as this Lich continued to wave its staff badly, illusory totems cackling just like it erupting out by the hundreds as they went to settle above the heads of anyone who couldn't resist the authority of the Absolute Dynamis of Extremity it held!

The Wills and souls of the affected Avernus and Singularity Overseer Elders then faced constant mental attack abilities imposing feelings of inferiority and madness, their eyes becoming somber as they released their own authority to be rid of this negative effect!
Their essence flowed slower as they faced horrific deathly plaques and curses, and the activation of their abilities could at times fizzle and not unfold.

"The authorities the Haven Lich is releasing are working to lower the capabilities of their enemy forces, while there are also the Prince Tier and King Tier Thanatos Vassals I saw before making their moves..."

As she spoke, Ayame focused on another screen that showed the Void Dracolich releasing a Poison Breath towards the Apex Astral Leviathans carrying Elder Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, the Chaos Nightwalker motioning with his hands as massive glacial sword formed in the skies and also rained down death!
Meanwhile, the Legions of Prince Tier Thanatos Vassal moved like Undead waves of a sea as they tried to drown much more powerful Elder Lifeforms by simply overpowering them with numbers!
{Yes.} Her Grandfather nodded behind her as he accepted her analysis so far.

{The ability to control the battlefield is extremely crucial, and so far, the side of the True Emperor of Quintessence has taken the reins of control, even if the other side has more powerful Lifeforms. And since they didn't stop another capability of this distinctive Thanatos Dynamis of Extremity being expressed...}
As he spoke, he centered on the 7 points of light that came to be after Alexander King called out {Chthonian Sinners of Thanatos}.

From the cracks in space, heavy auras of Entities slightly exceeding the power of common Grand Elders erupted out as a mere glance of their bodies showed grotesque-looking Lifeforms of massive size rush out with mad intent for battle!
It caused everything to seem utterly chaotic as their appearance made the whole battlefield descend into even more chaos and madness.
This wasn't to mention that behind the Haven Lich Ra'Zan, portals multiplied and bloomed as Legions of Prince Tier Thanatos Vassals began to surge out like endless tides!

{The Authority of Death and Destruction...is a distinctive one as something at this magnitude has only been exhibited by the Hyperversal Extremity of Necromancy in the Haven of Penumbra. To have a Rising Junior express its authority like this already...}

chapters.title: Chapter 2553 Madness! IV
paragraphs: A Rising Junior expressing the authority of Death so proficiently!
The eyes of Ayame's Grandfather shone brightly as Hyperversal Extremity Authority continued to flow from him and into Ayame.
{Continue.}
He beckoned for Ayame to continue her analysis as she focused whole gazing at the constantly changing battlefield.

"The different forces have fractured into their own battles, and now...it seems more casualties are about to appear- this result brought about by the wide ranging debuff abilities of the Haven Lich and the soldiers of the True Emperor of Quintessence not letting opportunity go to waste..."

As she spoke, her eyes came to focus on a screen that showed Commander Vladic and his Noblesse Apex Aeonic Lifeforms surrounded by cackling illusory skulls as they rotated their Dynamis of Extremity to hold back its effects, their figures trying to stay close to the Legions of Singularity Overseers with their Apex Astral Leviathans as at this time, an Apex Aeonic Noblesse erupted with power to prevent the deathly authorities of the Haven Lich from reaching him!
He breathed heavily as the moment he thought he could catch his breath...
CRUNCH!
A cerulean blue light flashed.

Over a thousand Apex Aeonic Damage Values flashed as a viscous blue slimy light instantly chomped onto half of his whole body, his Aspects of Existence buzzing and experiencing a disconnect as in shock, his soul was destroyed right after!

Half of his body was missing as on the side, a blue slime chewed with a giddy light! The lifeless body began to fall from the skies at this time when a moment later, the verdant black mist of death that had spread across the battlefield wrapped around it.
The authority that Alexander King had released!

It seemed to be ever present on the battlefield as from the dead body of the Noblesse, deathly energies erupted out as a roar followed next, the skeletal form of another Void Dracolich rising from it as a third King Tier Thanatos Vassal was born!
On the side, Commander Vladic and others were ashen as before they could even react...
RAA!
A cry boomed out beside them as a lustrous golden penguin used its flippers to swing a golden Greataxe down!
"Death, and more death."
Ayame spoke as she looked at the scenes before her.

"The more time passes and the more deaths that occur, the more favorable this War becomes for Osmont. Even if they are more powerful, they will get drowned by the Legions of Undead that hold no fear of death, and these massive creatures I could only find records of as Enders who seem to not fear death either. Currently, the ball is in Ahpuch's court if he wishes to reverse the dominance of his enemy before it is too late. The answer to this lies in him using his edge as someone who had achieved the 16th Boundary Layer, if he doesn't- oh?"
Ayame's words came to a halt.
They focused on the screen showing Ahpuch as he gazed at the unfolding battle with a smile.
And he then spoke.
"The more death and destruction there is, the more powerful I am too, you know?"
He spoke while bringing his right hand before his chest as if he wanted to grasp his beating heart, his eyes closing as he uttered out.
{Domain Expansion- Interminable Destruction}
THUMP!
A beat of a heart was heard.
And the whole battlefield changed!
In a matter of an instant, the vast Apex Battlefield and even close to the edges of it where the Wills of watching existences were hidden- an astonishing domain was laid down!
It covered everything in an instant.
"Domain Expansion," Ayame uttered with a somber expression as Ahpuch had finally made a genuine move.

"Something achievable commonly at the 17th Boundary Layer, but some Concepts can attain it earlier if they are unique enough. It allows one to add the might of a Dynamis of Extremity onto an existing Boundary Concept and expand it to an alarming degree, granting a domain of Absolute Control where one can instantly display their power across it. Even the surrounding reality will bend and conform to the truth of the imposed Dynamis and Concept..."
As she spoke, the scene before them greatly changed as massive crimson pillars of flames manifested across the Apex Battlefield a moment after the Interminable Destruction domain was expanded!
Interminable! This was the Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that Ahpuch grasped. And Destruction was his core concept as his Domain Expansion was Interminable Destruction!
Endless Destruction.
So long as one was within it...
BOOM!

The dense appearing crimson pillars of flames pulsed as they released hellish torrential storms of destruction that washed over the Prince Tier Thanatos Vassals- their skeletal structure facing over a thousand Apex Damage Values as their bones cracked and melted under the banner of Destruction!
ROAR!

The two Void Dracolich bellowed out as a dozen crimson pillars of Destruction appeared around each of them, the torrential waves of power they released ripping apart their wings as it seemed soon enough, they would face Destruction.

And the 300 Enders as well as the 200 Battalion of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms adorned in golden Armament that truly seemed like Quasi-Extremity Relics faced their first setbacks as their bodies were forced to go on the defensive for the first time.
Golden grandeur pulsed from them as a vast majority were knocked back, their barriers destroyed as their Vitality Values took a hit!
And this was only the first wave of torrential flames of Destruction from the {Domain Expansion- Interminable Destruction}.
When the next one came...
"Ahpuch has finally made a correct move and placed his enemies in a predicament, if Alexander King or his summoned Haven Lich do not pull out something to-...!"
Her eyes opened wide.
Amidst the burning pillars of Destruction and wide range torrential flames of a not yet fully established domain, the cackling of the Haven Lich could be heard.
{Did I not say there would only be death?}
BZZT!
His aura soared.
The flaming bone crown atop him spun fervently as he commandeered his Master's {Quintessential Undead Rise}
From the ashes of bones of the dead Prince Tier Thanatos Vassals and King Tier Thanatos Vassals, the lush black light expanded in concentration as what was destroyed reformed again.
And this time, the deathly energies were doubled as instead of a single Thanatos Vassal rising...two could be seen from a single spot!
Two reforming Void Dracolich became 4.
Over ten thousand more Prince Tier Thanatos Vassals last appeared as the Battlefield became even more chaotic!
At the same time, 7 massive points of light emerged and made their presence known.

One was a particularly frightening one as while shaped like a circular plane of Existence- an Entity whose body was made up of pulsing crimson black meat vibrating with tendrils of the Absolute Thanatos Dynamis of Extremity moved.

Its circular meaty visage held no eyes, with one seeing a single structure forming from one end to another as it was...a mouth. On its backside, a burning symbol reading {GLUTTONY} could be seen as it radiated terror!

The mouth on the front side suddenly opened in a devilish grin to reveal horribly sharp teeth and an endless abyss, this single summoned creature out of Seven new ones beginning to inhale as shockingly...the crimson flaming pillars nearby began to be sucked towards its abyssal jaws endlessly.
The battle was constantly changing.
Ayame and many others watched it and analyzed every move made as just when it seemed the dominance of the battle would shift from one side to another, magnificent changes bloomed!

But there were still the injured forces of the True Emperor of Quintessence that may very well start seeing some deaths due to the Interminable Destruction Domain laid out by Ahpuch in the next moment when it released another one of its torrential waves of Destruction.
At such a moment, a being stood up from the backside of a Draconian Phoenix as a white coat billowed gloriously in the wind.
His voice was barely discerned amidst the chaotic war, but it buzzed out nonetheless!
{All Aspect Hyperversal Heal}.
A lush blue light of life and grandeur emerged amidst all the death.
And the troops of the True Emperor of Quintessence...were enveloped by such a thick aura of life that some weaker Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were blinded!

The mouth on the front side suddenly opened in a devilish grin to reveal horribly sharp teeth and an endless abyss, this single summoned creature out of Seven new ones beginning to inhale as shockingly...the crimson flaming pillars nearby began to be sucked towards its abyssal jaws endlessly.
The battle was constantly changing.
Ayame and many others watched it and analyzed every move made as just when it seemed the dominance of the battle would shift from one side to another, magnificent changes bloomed!

But there were still the injured forces of the True Emperor of Quintessence that may very well start seeing some deaths due to the Interminable Destruction Domain laid out by Ahpuch in the next moment when it released another one of its torrential waves of Destruction.
At such a moment, a being stood up from the backside of a Draconian Phoenix as a white coat billowed gloriously in the wind.
His voice was barely discerned amidst the chaotic war, but it buzzed out nonetheless!
{All Aspect Hyperversal Heal}.
A lush blue light of life and grandeur emerged amidst all the death.
And the troops of the True Emperor of Quintessence...were enveloped by such a thick aura of life that some weaker Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were blinded!

chapters.title: Chapter 2554 Demon! I
paragraphs: What was his purpose?
When the blue planet was undergoing an Apocalypse, Dr. Hall thought it was to rescue lives.
When he came in contact with the True Emperor of Quintessence, he once more sought his purpose.
He didn't know if he truly found it yet, but something would always remain true.
He was a doctor.
And he saved lives.
THUMP!
He felt his beating heart churning essence like an engine as Boundaries and a Dynamis of Extremity coursed through him!
{All Aspect Hyperversal Heal}.
His voice was light, yet its grandeur and what it called forth was instantly applied to all beings deemed as Allies- wondrous prompts rising up before him.
{All Allies have restored 100% in all Aspects.}
Not just Vitality Values, but even soul values were recovered along with any deficient Aspects. But it went further than that.
{300% of the Maximum Vitality Values of the target will also be generated as Reserve Vitality Values for the next hour.}
Brilliance unfolded before his eyes, but this wasn't it. This wasn't enough for what his very soul knew was the true nature of all things.
So he continued.
{Hyperversal Grace of Inarius.}
His Soul Values depleted greatly!
Brilliant verdant light now unfolded and bathed over the masses as the Domain Expansion of Ahpuch became ever-solidified.
And...
{Under the Grace of Inarius, the attachment of Death Reversal has been applied to all Allies once for the next hour.}

{When Death Reversal is triggered, the emptied Vitality Values will be returned to the maximum as 500% of the Maximum Vitality Values will also be added as Reserve Vitality Values, with All Aspects of the target experiencing a 200% rise for 10 seconds after Death Reversal.}
Yes.

This was the route he sought, even though it was nowhere near complete. His research in Essensology, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, and many more concepts had brought him here, but he knew he could go further!

His piercing eyes watched as the Hyperversal Grace of Inarius settled above the heads of himself and all Allies as illusory flaming green wings of light, the aura of overabundance of lifeforce waving out as it seemed to trigger the existence who had laid out a terrifying Domain.
He gazed at the visage of Alexander King pulsing with grandeur as well as the Haven Lich cackling beside him as he bellowed out.
"Just as you can the Legions behind me...I can also target those you hold dear."
WAA!
His eyes pulsed with destruction as waves of power unfurled.
{Dance of Destruction}.
BZZT!

The hundreds of crimson pillars of destruction across the expanded domain blazed and expanded. They then began to move across space like stanchions of destruction, a few dozen being devoured by the Chthonian Sinner of Thanatos labeled as {GLUTTONY}, but the rest of them danced wildly as they released torrential waves of power with thousands of Apex Damage Values!

They ignored the Avernus and Singularity Overseer Elders along with the Noblesse as the lyrics would surely reap the lives of the people of the True Emperor of Quintessence- finally having some beings die on his side as the dominance of the battle would tilt yet again.
Or so it should have been.
The torrential waves of Destruction swept through the forces of the True Emperor of Quintessence as the might of an existence who had reached the 16th Boundary Layer was shown.
He delivered an excess of 8,000 Apex Damage Values not to a single target...but to hundreds of targets simultaneously!
Such a move was enough to wipe out hundreds of common Grand Elders of an Inheritance as the result...
"Huh?"
Was not the mass demise and destruction they expected.
The illusory verdant flaming wings above the heads of the Endeds and beings adorned in golden Armaments flashed.
A cry of Phoenix erupted out as pillars of verdant flames rose from their bodies, their life forces just as exuberant as ever!
The Interminable Destruction Domain settled back with its crimson pillars becoming stationary again, but all were shocked to see absolutely no damage or deaths done to the other side!
And instead, they seemed more organized than ever as at this moment, a light of destiny erupted out.
As if it was saying that it was time.
"Gather!"
The cry of the Son of Destiny erupted out.

Henry Osmont called out as a myriad of Vassals adorned in Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia Set came behind him, their bodies still surrounded by flaming verdant pillars of light as the boosts of the Hyperversal Grace of Inarius settled in since {Death Reversal} was triggered!

They were currently at their most powerful as their stats had gained a 200% boost for the next few seconds due to the Grace of Inarius, and the Son of Destiny called for them to gather and use this moment to the fullest.
Others lined up behind Aurelia, Orion, Caesar, and many Lernaeans came to group behind Maximilian!
Each of them were connected to thin strings of destiny that placed them where they needed to be as while their bodies shone with auras of intense life and grandeur, Henry's voice rang out again.
"Be ready to initiate the last set effects when prompted."
The last set effect.
The Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia Set had many boons, with the boon for adorning all 6 equipment still being born on the last day after Aurelia augmented all of them.
They could now use it freely as it was just as restrictive as it was mighty!

{When 6 Set Items are equipped, any enemy killed grants +1,000 Quintessential Loot Experience Points that can be utilized towards the progression of Boundaries up to the 13th Boundary Layer. A Quintessential Banner of Loot will also form above you as it adds +750 Quintessential Hyperversal Loot Damage Values to all attacks and abilities you release. Once every minute, you can release the Rage of Loot Seeker's Smite that thunders out as an area of effect ability capable of dealing 2,000 Quintessential Hyperversal Loot Damage Values, with any targeted enemies perishing from it having a 50% Chance to Trigger the Explosion of Loot effect...}

chapters.title: Chapter 2555 Demon! II
paragraphs: The eyes of the Son of Destiny flashed.
He saw the terrifying Avernus and Singularity Overseer Elders, as well as the few Apex Aeonic Noblesse struggling to survive amidst this battle.
And his body glimmered with brilliance as he sent commands with destiny.
His Greataxe thundered down as behind him, Kazuhiko, Athena, Eowyn, Ophelia, and many others swung their Greataxes down at the same time!
They triggered the Rage of the Loot Seeker's Smite as above them, the sound of thunder echoed as tendrils of golden lightning formed like a churning sea.
They threw it out simultaneously.

A single Smite should have held a few thousand Quintessential Hyperversal Loot Damage Values, and yet tens of them formed together all once as it seemed like a golden storm formed from above that pulsed with tens of thousands of Damage Values, and it rained down on the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms on the other side of the battlefield like a butcher's knife!
"OOOH!"

The Apex Aeonic Lifeforms felt a level of unprecedented danger as before any could react, the golden thundering Smite struck down in one region and carved a path as shockingly, Blood and gore erupted out.

The Rage of Loot Seeker's Smite carved out a path of mass death as for the first time, the massive Apex Astral Leviathans and the Singularity Overseer Elders standing atop them faced casualties, over 15 perishing at this moment!
On the side of the Avernus Clan Elders, 4 were in the proximity of this region as they were drowned in the tens of thousands of Damage Values raining down simultaneously.
But this wasn't all.
Just as quickly as the first one had formed and thundered out...
ROAAR!
The thundering cry of another cluster of Smites appeared as after the group led by Henry utilized their, the group led by Aurelia swung down their axes in sequence as well.
Before the battlefield could even absorb what had happened!
"Gather!"

Domains of Boundaries were shredded under the tendrils of Quintessential Hyperversal Loot Damage Values, the group led by Orion following Aurelia as one after another, clusters of heavy Damage Values cleaved across the battlefield in a shocking turn of events.

Barely a few lives were reaped after the Legions of Reverend Emperors fell to the cleaving of destiny early on with very few Apex Aeonic Lifeforms perishing, and yet now...dozens began to perish as death and destruction ran rampant!
And amidst all of this death...
KA KA KA!

The cackling of a Haven Lich could be heard as the dismembered bodies of Apex Astral Leviathans, Singularity Overseer Elders, and the few perishing Avernus Clan Elders floated in space while the verdant obsidian smoke of Thanatos filled them.

At the same time, the visage of Alexander King began to move as he stared at the figure of Ahpuch whose eyes currently burned with a destructive light of surprise at the clusters of heavy Damage Values being released by the forces of his enemy.
"Domain Expansion?"
His voice was cold and filled with dominance as he moved to enact what he had read in the Unrecorded Histories not too long ago.
"What is a mere Domain Expansion under the light of Loot?"
A light of clear gold light erupted from him as it was vastly different from the verdant obsidian light of death he had been releasing this whole time.
It was...
"Another Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!?"
Clamor seethed in the faraway regions of those watching as in disbelief, they saw this First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven erupt out with yet another Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!
Was it so easy to forge these pristine authorities now?
Could anyone just sit and do it as they wished?!
Their cries weren't answered as instead, the heavy voice of Alexander King thundered out.
{Hyperversal Plundering}.
A clear gold light erupted out as it carried the character of another Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
Noah knew this Dynamis very well as its light was no less powerful than the Thanatos Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!
Being one of the last few things he forged before the Apex War began, it was the Lotra Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!
Lotra.
A single word, and yet it represented plundering, loot, or the most precious spoils!
One of its features was Hyperversal Plundering.

An ability that allowed Noah to plunder anything the authority of Lotra covered, whether that be a Person, Reality, or Concept. He could even Loot the Recorded Histories of defeated enemies whose lives were under his hands!
And what he plundered...could be turned into Hyperversal Lotra Caches filled with the most pristine Loot, or it could be made his.
What he plundered could be made his!
At this moment, he designated the Domain Expansion- Interminable Destruction as the target of Hyperversal Plundering.
The light of gold bathed everything as the skies that rained down golden tendrils of Smites from his Vassals became tainted entirely gold.
And from above...an illusory golden hand whose skin seemed to be made of bejeweled crystalline light manifested.
A golden hand whose fingers that were outstretched began to close and come together at this moment as if it was plucking something from the earth!
And the crimson light released by Ahpuch's Domain Expansion began to be twisted.

The myriad of crimson pillars of light instantly lost their grandeur as if they had been plucked from the space they were anchored in, the authority of the Interminable Absolute Dynamis of Extremity wrapping around this domain not being able to stop the authority of the Lotra Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity as the results of {Hyperversal Plundering} were fully carried out!
{The Manifested Domain Expansion- Interminable Destruction, has been plundered.}
{The Concepts and Pathway to form the Interminable Absolute Seed of Extremity have been Recorded.}
{The Authority of Domain Expansion has been Recorded.}
An astonishing result was obtained.
Boundless waves of information coursed within Noah's mind in an instant as on the Apex Battlefield, the visage of Ahpuch with eyes changing from astonishment to shock could be seen.

The displayed Domain Expansion he had called out entirely disappeared under the actions of a single being as Ahpuch's head was raised towards the skies, watching as a golden hand disappeared into oblivion just as quickly as it had come!
And then, he and many others heard two words that caused their minds to buzz in disbelief.
The words came from the appearance of Alexander King whose left hand came to land on his chest as he felt the beat of his Heart.
The Heart.
It turned out to be the instigator of this wondrous capability as at this moment, words that shouldn't come out of his mouth echoed and resounded out across the battlefield.
"Domain Expansion."

chapters.title: Chapter 2556 Demon! III
paragraphs: {Domain Expansion}:: When sufficient strides have been taken towards Extremity, the resonance of one's Soul with advanced Boundary Layers gives way to the expansion of the Domains of Boundaries and Dynamis to an unfathomable level. For the cost of 80% of your current Soul Values coursing through and putting a strain on your Heart as the Domain Engine, the domain of a Dynamis can be further expanded by adding the definition of a concept to it- or vice versa. It is a closer interplay between concepts and Dynamis as one gets closer to Extremity, with the resulting domain allowing your Will to be expressed anywhere within it instantly for 1 minute. The expanded Domain allows you to use all skills and abilities of the chosen Dynamis and Concept of Extremity at no cost of Soul Values or any other resources, with your Will remaining anchored onto the expanded Domain to the extent that so long as it is not destroyed, your soul cannot entirely perish to any attacks. The true power and extent of the cast Domain Expansion truly depend on the Dynamis and Concept of Extremity put together as something with great resonance can give birth to a domain that will cause one's enemies to only despair...
80% of one's Soul Values to cast. It was a heavy cost, and the truly powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms paid this cost in order to win difficult battles.
And in exchange, one didn't have to worry about the cost of any resources relating to the Dynamis and Concept of Extremity they utilized to make this domain!
They could dish out waves of their Damage Values as Ahpuch had begun to do just this.
He released torrential storms of destruction that should have reaped the lives of Noah's Vassals were it not for the existence adorned in a white coat giving off an aura of abundant life.
But this wasn't an issue for Ahpuch as he could easily call forth the storms of destruction again since for the next minute...it didn't have a cost.
But before this could be done, an illusory bejeweled golden hand descended from the skies and...canceled his domain.
When Ahpuch tried to connect and call upon it again, he felt that he couldn't even enact it again at this time as it was truly canceled out.
Canceled!
An expanded domain could be canceled?!
This question buzzed in the minds of many as many Apex Aeonic Lifeforms learned of this possibility today.
But what was even more obscene was that after a certain being had canceled his expanded domain, he spoke out words he should in no way be capable of.
"Domain Expansion."
"Infinity...Thanatos."
BOOOM!
{Domain Expansion- Infinity Thanatos}!
The Quintessential Absolute Thanatos Dynamis of Extremity, and it went further on to be defined with a ridiculous concept of Extremity.
Infinity.
What exactly would the result of such a thing be?
Extremity Marcellus' eyes flashed sharply the moment the words of {Domain Expansion} were uttered by Alexander King.
{Did you all see what he did?}
He asked in a calm fashion as the Wills of Genesis Hyperversal Extremities around the feathery thrones on the marbled floor of this domain gazed forward with a light of marvel.

{He forcefully took the Record of Domain Expansion as an instant later, he expressed it with his own soul. Authority like this...should be feasible with Unique Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that Hyperversal Extremities can forge. What he is doing now is just...}
The words of the Genesis Hyperversal Extremity were left unsaid as Marcellus nodded.
His aged face seemed to have lost a few wrinkles as he spoke out words that caused immense silence to descend in the surroundings.
{Now, had our Apex Aeonic Elders been on this Battlefield...what would be their fates?}
A question that couldn't be answered.
A question that the Genesis Institute of Extremity could at least say they escaped the consequences of, but other beings could not do the same!
Across the folds of space.
In the lands of the Planeswalkers, within an isolated domain.

Devouring and Kabul watched the screens showing the events of the Apex Battlefield with cold eyes as to their right, the manifested Will of another Hyperversal Extremity of the Singularity Overseers could be seen.

{Are we still treating this as a minor and insignificant scuffle? We officially used the name of our Inheritance and a portion of our forces meant for the Culmination Step here. Some have begun to die as the dominance that should be seen on the battlefield...none of it is with them.}
WAA!
The voice was sharp and ferocious as it was inquiring and already placing a lot of the blame on Devouring!
{Devouring...I hope you realize that you will be the one to fully answer for everything if 300 Elders and Apex Astral Leviathans begin to be butchered.}
Elders. Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
They weren't just dredges as they made a notable portion of the potency of their Inheritance- and they couldn't just watch them be butchered!
At this juncture, Devouring snorted with a thrum of power as he replied.
{Keep watch. If they do not reverse the flow of battle and take the lead, we shall make a move.}
{We?} The eyes of the Hyperversal Will besides Devouring and Kabul scoffed at the inclusion as it continued.
{Interference means going against an Adjudicator. What makes you think I would do such a thing to cover up for your mistakes?}
Yes!
Any outside interventions after an Apex War had begun were not allowed as for them to do this, it would mean they were directly going against the presiding judge of this War!
Someone who had already made her stance and standing clear before the War even began.
At the words of the Hyperversal Extremity beside him, Devouring smiled as his eyes continued to scour the battlefield for someone specific.

{My mistakes? I think you mean our mistakes. And whether it be victory or defeat...did the Singularity Overseer Overlord not express his dislike towards the oh so great Adjudicator of Dissolution? This error can simply be turned into an opportunity to finally start the steps of correcting the mistake of her promotion as an Adjudicator.}
