For the cost of 80% of your current Soul Values coursing through and putting a strain on your Heart as the Domain Engine, the domain of a Dynamis can be further expanded by adding the definition of a concept to it- or vice versa.
It is a closer interplay between concepts and Dynamis as one gets closer to Extremity, with the resulting domain allowing your Will to be expressed anywhere within it instantly for 1 minute.

The expanded Domain allows you to use all skills and abilities of the chosen Dynamis and Concept of Extremity at no cost of Soul Values or any other resources, with your Will remaining anchored onto the expanded Domain to the extent that so long as it is not destroyed, your soul cannot entirely perish to any attacks.

The true power and extent of the cast Domain Expansion truly depend on the Dynamis and Concept of Extremity put together as something with great resonance can give birth to a domain that will cause one's enemies to only despair...
80% of one's Soul Values to cast.
It was a heavy cost, and the truly powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms paid this cost in order to win difficult battles.
And in exchange, one didn't have to worry about the cost of any resources relating to the Dynamis and Concept of Extremity they utilized to make this domain!
They could dish out waves of their Damage Values as Ahpuch had begun to do just this.
He released torrential storms of destruction that should have reaped the lives of Noah's Vassals were it not for the existence adorned in a white coat giving off an aura of abundant life.
But this wasn't an issue for Ahpuch as he could easily call forth the storms of destruction again since for the next minute...it didn't have a cost.
But before this could be done, an illusory bejeweled golden hand descended from the skies and...canceled his domain.
When Ahpuch tried to connect and call upon it again, he felt that he couldn't even enact it again at this time as it was truly canceled out.
Canceled!
An expanded domain could be canceled?!
This question buzzed in the minds of many as many Apex Aeonic Lifeforms learned of this possibility today.
But what was even more obscene was that after a certain being had canceled his expanded domain, he spoke out words he should in no way be capable of.
"Domain Expansion."
"Infinity...Thanatos."
BOOOM!
{Domain Expansion- Infinity Thanatos}!
The Quintessential Absolute Thanatos Dynamis of Extremity, and it went further on to be defined with a ridiculous concept of Extremity.
Infinity.
What exactly would the result of such a thing be?
Extremity Marcellus' eyes flashed sharply the moment the words of {Domain Expansion} were uttered by Alexander King.
{Did you all see what he did?}
He asked in a calm fashion as the Wills of Genesis Hyperversal Extremities around the feathery thrones on the marbled floor of this domain gazed forward with a light of marvel.
{He forcefully took the Record of Domain Expansion as an instant later, he expressed it with his own soul.
Authority like this...should be feasible with Unique Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that Hyperversal Extremities can forge.
What he is doing now is just...}
The words of the Genesis Hyperversal Extremity were left unsaid as Marcellus nodded.
His aged face seemed to have lost a few wrinkles as he spoke out words that caused immense silence to descend in the surroundings.
{Now, had our Apex Aeonic Elders been on this Battlefield...what would be their fates?}
A question that couldn't be answered.
A question that the Genesis Institute of Extremity could at least say they escaped the consequences of, but other beings could not do the same!
Across the folds of space.
In the lands of the Planeswalkers, within an isolated domain.

Devouring and Kabul watched the screens showing the events of the Apex Battlefield with cold eyes as to their right, the manifested Will of another Hyperversal Extremity of the Singularity Overseers could be seen.
{Are we still treating this as a minor and insignificant scuffle?
We officially used the name of our Inheritance and a portion of our forces meant for the Culmination Step here.
Some have begun to die as the dominance that should be seen on the battlefield...none of it is with them.}
WAA!
The voice was sharp and ferocious as it was inquiring and already placing a lot of the blame on Devouring!
{Devouring...I hope you realize that you will be the one to fully answer for everything if 300 Elders and Apex Astral Leviathans begin to be butchered.}
Elders.
Apex Aeonic Lifeforms!
They weren't just dredges as they made a notable portion of the potency of their Inheritance- and they couldn't just watch them be butchered!
At this juncture, Devouring snorted with a thrum of power as he replied.
{Keep watch.
If they do not reverse the flow of battle and take the lead, we shall make a move.}
{We?} The eyes of the Hyperversal Will besides Devouring and Kabul scoffed at the inclusion as it continued.
{Interference means going against an Adjudicator.
What makes you think I would do such a thing to cover up for your mistakes?}
Yes!
Any outside interventions after an Apex War had begun were not allowed as for them to do this, it would mean they were directly going against the presiding judge of this War!
Someone who had already made her stance and standing clear before the War even began.
At the words of the Hyperversal Extremity beside him, Devouring smiled as his eyes continued to scour the battlefield for someone specific.
{My mistakes?
I think you mean our mistakes.
And whether it be victory or defeat...did the Singularity Overseer Overlord not express his dislike towards the oh so great Adjudicator of Dissolution?
This error can simply be turned into an opportunity to finally start the steps of correcting the mistake of her promotion as an Adjudicator.}

chapters.title: Chapter 2557 Demon! IV
paragraphs: Dangerous words emanated from Devouring as the Hyperversal Extremity beside him was silent, but he could feel her deadly glare!
{You do not have to do anything, I will let the Singularity Overseer Overlord know myself if the Apex War turns any more unfavorable.}
Devouring had made a choice as he stuck to it.
But all this time, his gaze continued to search for the being who contained one of the reasons why he was here.
The being with the Innate Pellucid Extremity Foundation from the Quasarian Lineage!

She was the solution to him attaining Extremity in another Source of Chaos quickly as once he held Ruin in his grasp as well...he would be extremely distinguished among Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremities!
But he had only seen the face of the father of this target.

His eyes flashed as they honed in on Caesar who was coincidentally among those releasing golden tendrils of light that tore apart Apex Astral Leviathans and the Singularity Overseer Elders standing atop them.
'If reality dissolves to an unsalvageable state...you shall be first.'
His priorities remained in order.
And he watched the marvel that was the Domain Expansion unfold from an unknown being who seemed to brim with power!
Infinity Thanatos.
The moment three words ended, the earth in this region was painted black as the skies turned a deadly shade of green.
The obsidian earth felt extremely real as if an endlessly dark abyss had appeared- this abyss roaring out as if it were a raging sea as from it...a dense number of Thanatos Vassals began to rise.

From the verdant skies, a cry erupted out as the beak of a massive skeletal creature pointed out, the rest of its body following close at hand as the mythical Undead form of an austere beast showed itself off!
{Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassal- Infinite Nine-Flame Phoenix}
After Prince and King Tier Thanatos Vassal, an Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassal appeared at this moment as even though it was a first, it wouldn't be the last!

Its expansive skeletal wings spread out and cast a shadow over dozens of the Apex Astral Leviathans that felt their Origins tremble, the liquefied green skies it came from pulsing as more monstrosities began to descend.
{Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassal- Orc Fiend Devourer}
{Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassal- Abyss Vampyre Defiler}...
One after another, some descended from the green skies while others endlessly rose from the Obsidian earth!

The most potent ones were Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassal as dozens of King Tier Thanatos Vassals rose from the abyssal obsidian earth of the Infinity Thanatos Domain, their rise being followed by massive bony mountains rising up as each one releasing billowing waves of death!
And the Thanatos Vassals that were already on the Battlefield before the Domain Expansion was cast...
ROAAR!
They bellowed out grandly as the bodies of the Void Dracolich could be seen cracking- multiple new heads beginning to sprout from their bodies as their aura became even more ferocious.
They experienced an elevation in ranking as from King Tier Thanatos Vassal...
{Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassal- Dracolich of the End}
Droves of Thanatos Vassals flooded from above and below along with massive mountains of bones while any Thanatos Vassals already present experienced a thorough elevation.

The cackling of a Haven Lich could be heard in the distance as even more oppressive might was felt from it, the Seven Chthonian Sinners of Thanatos that had yet to fully show their grandeur also becoming surrounded by even more deathly auras as their presence alone utterly dominated the battlefield!
This...was just the first few nanoseconds of the activation of the Domain Expansion- Infinity Thanatos.
From the earth and skies, Undead continued to surge out endlessly as it seemed in no time, they would drown the whole battlefield with their presence!
The scene was astonishing.
This was especially so due to the power that the Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassal expressed and their sheer number- since there were already dozens of them making an appearance so far!
{Name}:: Infinite Nine-Flame Phoenix (Emperor Tier)
{Realm}:: Fourth Haven of Thanatos
{Lineage}:: Quintessential Undead Thanatos Vassal
{Titles}:: Undead Nirvana, Slave of Thanatos, Death Seeker...
{Apex Thanatos Mana Value}:: 6,999
{Apex Thanatos Vitality Value}:: 6,999
{Apex Thanatos Soul Value}:: 6,999
{Apex Thanatos Defense Value}:: 6,999
{Apex Thanatos Damage Value}:: 6,999...
Their numerical stats alone exceeded the hundreds of Apex Aeonic Elders here, and were only slightly less if not matching the most potent Elder Commanders here.

They brought with them endless death and destruction as at thus moment, the mountains of bones that had risen from the skies and the earth pulsed before their tops shockingly erupted with viscous beams of poisonous verdant black liquified authority- authority that connected from one bone mountain to another as any enemies on its path...

The eyes of the True Emperor of Quintessence seated on the throne could see the ridiculously deadly Damage Values Per second for any poor Apex Aeonic Lifeform that was caught on the path of the rising Thanatos Mountains!

From the over a dozen bone mountains to materialized from the earth and skies, more than 50 Apex Aeonic Elders did not get out of the way in time even with their souls warning them of danger as they died before they could escape the periphery of the cylindrical pillars of erupting liqufied authority!

The Apex Aeonic Noblesse who had barely been surviving this whole time...their numbers were shaved down by 90% as only the sorry figure of Commander Vladic could be seen hurriedly and with fear tumbling from a mountain of bones, the Noblesse who survived with him being caught in the eruption as their bones rained down with his sorry figure that gazed around in utter horror.

The Unrecorded History had shown a version of events occurring, and even with the interference and changes brought about by the True Emperor of Quintessence, the future seemed intent on playing out as it should be.
Vladic stood on a mountain of bones as he didn't know which came from his Lineage, or which were simply a part of the terrifying domain of death.

He gazed around him to see mountains of bones and death as the Scions- nay the Elders of an Inheritance and a Clan were grouping together to withstand swathes of Undead as in a short period of time, they perished!
They died as an instant later, their bodies underwent a transformation as they become part of the very armies that killed them.
"This..."
Vladic was nearly numb to this astonishing scene as his soul trembled- feeling the aura of a certain horror near him at this moment.
His head rose to gaze up to see one of the main main attractions of this War coming his way.
Before this being...Commander Vladic felt utterly insignificant!

chapters.title: Chapter 2558 Demon! V
paragraphs: His blank eyes rose to gaze at the immensity before him.
His bone Armament and the green obsidian light of one Absolute Dynamis of Extremity covered his body, and yet his eyes released a profound golden radiance of another Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!
His presence alone felt as if it didn't need to be here as the Thanatos Vassals swarming over would be more than enough.
And yet here he was.
The enemy commander that Osmont brought forth as his backing.
From the rising Thanatos Vassals, his name and difference had slowly begun ringing out as chants from the countless Legions of atrocities rising in his wake!
King.
King!
King!
It was overwhelming.
It was utterly soul-crushing for the enemies to hear as it felt the tolling of death growing ever closer!
As Vladic gazed towards the coming figure calling forth all of this disaster, he found his lips moving outside the control of his will as he spoke in a raspy voice.
"Do you think they will let you do all this without repercussions? To desecrate my Lineage and the very Lifeforms of Inheritances? You..."
SQUELCH!

With a beckoning of his hand, a deathly verdant black bone spear stabbed out and impaled the figure of Vladic, thousands of Damage Values erupting out in a contained fashion so as to not destroy him right away.
And from then on, an Unrecorded History becoming Recorded was accomplished as the being carrying it out deviated from its occurrence even if just a little.
His words were not the same.

"I had already seen your death even before this War started, with my appearance here now only as an acknowledgment. You were one of the pieces to initiate this war and cause things to be where they are now, and for that- I thank you."
His golden eyes dripping with the Lotra Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity felt as if they could see through everything, Commander Vladic feeling a sense of dread he had never felt before.
"Relish this death."
WAA!
"Because from it, you will rise to become even stronger. This...shall be your recompense and gift for making today's reality occur."
His voice caused Vladic's soul to feel so extremely cold as he felt the essence of death coursing inside of him.
Was he...about to meet Euryale? Join her in death at the hands of the Commander of the being who had killed her?
"You will not be meeting your beloved Euryale."
His heart felt immense dread as the voice of the First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven buzzed in his mind and Records for him alone to hear!
His eyes could barely focus to see a devilish smile as this being's words buzzed in his mind again.
"And it is no Commander killing you...you are dying in the hands of the very same being who crushed Euryale in his hands."
Vladic's eyes expanded wide in stupor.
One and the same being?
He thought of the being seated on the multicolored throne without making a move.
And then this terrifying Apex Aeonic Lifeform before him!
And the dread only became more intense as stared at this fiend...no.
"You...you are no fiend."
BZZT!
As the last vestiges of his life left him, he managed to cry out in his raspy voice.
"Demon. You...are a demon! A Demon that Elder Ahpuch will destroy with surety. A demon that no Inheritance will leave alive! You-GOH!"

Vladic's Will and Soul were utterly torn as even his raspy voice couldn't be heard, and from his visage impaled by bones...a green black smoke bloomed and covered everything about him as a fiery authority of death began to rise from it!
He would not meet Euryale.
He would join the ranks of the endless Legions that would rise under the banner of Alexander King.
Under the banner of the Haven Lich Ra'Zan!
In a single move, the Commander who was the one to initiate this war had fallen.

The one to do all of this gazed up to see the ever-increasing mountains of bones and droves of Undead Thanatos Vassals as he gazed towards a point where more than ten Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassals surrounded the being Commander Vladic had called for in the Unrecorded History he read before and even now.
"Ahpuch."
Noah called out the name of this being as he smiled.
He had perused across many records with the Adumbrative Viewpoint of the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity.
Ahpuch would merely be a blip in the events about to be recorded!
BLINK!

The visage of Alexander King instantly disappeared and moved to float above the raging storm of Destruction that was Ahpuch, bones splintering all around him as Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassals surrounded him!
"Demon..." The word rang out from the mouth of the Priestess Persephone as her white robes and eyes radiated rays of justice.

She and many others had seen the scene of the opponent Commander between the two Lineages naturally involved in this Apex War being killed by the First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven who had called forth a dreadful Domain Expansion that filled the Apex Battlefield with death!

Powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were currently dying left and right as if they survived the sudden eruptions of the pulsing bone mountains, there were the Undead Vassals to survive from thereafter as they swarmed over all opponent living beings.
Priestess Persephone saw this all as she repeated herself for all those around her to hear.
"What is that being but a Demon? To be reaping the lives of powerful future defenders of the Seven Havens like this!"
Her cries echoed out as she purposefully made herself loud.
As if she wanted to spread outcry and hatred towards the other side!
And just as she was about to continue...
"What the hell are you going on about, Crazy Priestess?"
The booming voice of Erikson buzzed out in the distance as he gazed over in distaste.
His left foot rose as his right hand grabbed the slipper from it, lifting this slipper up and pointing it towards the far away Priestess Persephone as he spoke out with grandiosity.

"In a scheduled and decided upon War, a Commander defending himself and utilizing all of his power to take down his enemies suddenly turns into a Demon? You keep running that dumb mouth of yours and I'll be the next one that turns into a demon by teaching you what those nasty lips can say or not say."

A shocking development unfolded even amongst the far away beings watching as tension began to rise, the far away Apex Battlefield filled with constant shocking changes becoming even more heart-shaking to watch!

chapters.title: Chapter 2559 A Path of No Return! I
paragraphs: The Aeonic Soul Clone of a renowned Scion of the Sima Clan pointed a slipper threateningly towards a renowned Scion of the Havenly Church!
"This is a War."
His eyes were sharp as if he could make a move at any moment without fear of the repercussions as he continued.
"If it was the side of Avernus and Singularity Overseer Elders winning the War and killing their enemies, would you call them demons as well? Get that hypocritical shit out of here."
WAA!
His demeanor was so dominating even while adorned in his beach attire as Priestess Persephone could say nothing else but harrumph and bring her gaze back towards the battlefield.

This whole interaction was also only gazed at with a periphery of the Wills of the watchers around this area, with the majority of concentration of their Wills remaining on the shocking events of the battlefield that seemed to be getting filled with a tremendous aura of death.
Above the Apex Battlefield tinged black and green.

In what seemed like a Haven of celestial beings gazing upon the lower earth below, the visage of the Adjudicator of Dissolution watched the unfolding events with a gaze of utmost scrutiny as not too far from her, the clone of the leader of this ongoing conflict continued to absorb the aura of her Hyperversal Extremity Authority.

{Multiple beings with Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, and one who even holds two Unique Absolute Dynamis of Extremity. This is a force that should be coming from a renowned Inheritance or Part of the forces of a Clan, and yet you wield it.}
Her words were clear, and yet they were filled with an inquisitive light as her veiled figure came to land on Noah.
His figure held a hint of mystery and wonder as he gazed down at the events below him.
He shrugged his shoulders as his grand voice emanated out.

"Is it so wrong and out of place for me to possess such a force? Even if it is not renowned, I have just stated before everyone when this battle began about my Infinite Hyperversal Haven. People undervalue me because my name isn't attached to some major Inheritance or Clan. They do not take my words at face value as this is what led to the reality we are currently in."
WAA!

"I warned all Inheritances and the Avernus Clan involving themselves in the War, and yet only the Genesis Institute of Extremity put their biases aside and took a step back. Now...ah, it pains me that I will have to destroy one of the Seven Clans and the Singularity Overseers due to them not being able to take a step back!"
His broad shoulders were filled with power as his last ones seemed to almost be filled with lamentations!
A knowing smile full of power and certainty rose on his lips as his gaze went from the Battlefield below and locked onto the veiled eyes of the Adjudicator of Dissolution.

"They made themselves my clear enemies. The rules of the Apex War of Annihilation dictate that the victor holds the right of Annihilation for those involved in this war. When I finish this portion of the war...I hold the right to wage it on the rest of those who sought my Annihilation."
He spoke in advance as if he already expected certain words from the Adjudicator of Dissolution.
And Svetlana looked at him silently before she spoke up with a level of coldness.

{Must you continue this grudge? Do you know how difficult and deadly for your own forces it will be if you continue to pit yourself against the Avernus Clan and the Singularity Overseers? What you're facing now are the Elders they're raising up. Their true power lies in Hyperversal Extremities and Extremity Armaments that contribute to the defenses of the Seven Havens. They will not wait for you to grow and wage conflict as you grind them down. If you truly point your blade at them, they have the right to fight back and eradicate you and everything you hold dear. So I ask again...
must you continue this grudge?}
Words of reasoning.
The Adjudicator of Dissolution saw the immense and still hidden potential of the power this being before her wielded as she truly wished for it to be directed towards a positive direction!
Yet her veiled eyes flashed the moment she saw this being's smile become even wider.
She realized nothing that she had uttered had reached him.
"Adjudicator of Dissolution, I assure you that even if I take a step back, my enemies will not."
His figure pointed to the war zone below as he continued.

"Even now as this War has reached a precipice, I have an sense it will not end with a simple victory or defeat. I wouldn't be surprised of interventions...I wouldn't be surprised of a Hyperversal Extremity or two making a move and breaking even the rules of this Apex War for the reason of saving their Elders. You see, I am a lover of peace. But when things like that happen...I will not be able to help but retaliate!"
BOOM!
His words were explosive as the Adjudicator of Dissolution blazed with an astonishing authority thereafter.
She didn't reply.
She couldn't reply as the words he had said...could not be refuted! The thought had instantly risen the moment the flow of the battle tipped towards the side of Osmont.

If the Apex War was tipping towards the defeat of the forces of the Avernus Clan and the Singularity Overseers...would the Hyperversal Extremities that had authorized things here truly stay still? Could they answer to their factions as to why they lost a portion of their forces entirely even before the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification began?
The Adjudicator of Dissolution knew the answer very well!
{For this, I have made a warning. For this...I am prepared for.}
At her words, Noah smiled.
His eyes glimmered with a stellar light as he had truly spent too much time with the Adumbrative Viewpoint of the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity.
He seemed to see many things others couldn't as he wondered...did the Adjudicator of Dissolution truly have things in her grasp as she believed?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2560 A Path of No Return! II
paragraphs: Truthfully, Noah himself did not know much about the Unrecorded Histories of Hyperversal Extremities as rarely did he coke across their Histories when utilizing Adumbrative Viewpoint.

And when he did, the information was very little as the level of secrecy Hyperversal Extremities held was too profound for what his current Soul Values and access into the Aeonic Annals of Extremity could allow him to view!

But the fact that his Quintessential Hyperversal Mana Value was substituted for nearly all of Soul Values usage meant he could utilize the authority of the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity with unimaginable frequency.
Hyperversal Extremities with Dynamis like this that could speculate or foresee possible Records existed in large numbers, but they didn't spend their whole days doing so as it wasn't possible!
But with his Infinite Mana, Noah had no trouble doing so.
And since the Unrecorded Histories of Hyperversal Extremities were not easily gazed at, he focused on the powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from their factions.
The Scions watching in the distance.
The Scions hidden in the dark.
The beings who planned and plotted!
Ever so slowly, Noah was able to expand what he knew about them as this Apex War of Annihilation...would only be a stepping-off point for what was to come!
Immense silence was the only thing in the region of nothingness that the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction was in.

He watched the scenes of a solemn Ahpuch who ripped apart Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassals with obscene strength and apocalyptic destruction, and yet even more of such Undead Vassals continued to appear as his authority was ever so slowly being sapped!
It wasn't dredges of weak existences that he was facing.
Each one was equivalent to a Grand Elder of an Inheritance as apart from them...
GUOOH!
The roars of some of the Seven grotesque looking Lifeforms emanated out towards him as the one with a pulsing {GLUTTONY} on his back was the first to surge towards Ahpuch.
More and more followed as even with the frightening power and Destruction he wielded at the 16th Boundary Layer...it may not be enough!
That is unless...he can use this terrifying pressure to break through.

All this time, the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction was not worried about Ahpuch's life as no genius who had accessed Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as an Apex Aeonic Lifeform would be allowed to die- especially one of the Avernus Clan!
Even if Svetlana dared to, he or other Avernus Hyperversal Extremities would not sit still.
But there was the current problem that it wasn't just Ahpuch. There were 200 Avernus Clan Elders on the field as dozens had perished!
At this reality, Destruction let out a sigh as he felt the Will of the Hyperversal Extremity with fiery purple hair and two burning purple horns begin to blaze with light.
{What does the Senate say?}

His Hyperversal Extremity Clone was currently not within the Avernus Domains for a reason as his Records were not supposed to be associated with them. So he had to rely on this baleful Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity beside him to communicate with the other powerhouses of the Avernus Clan!
{There are some disagreements, but it has been authorized for us to use this chance to probe...them.}
WAA!
Them!
Destruction heard this word as he instantly understood what it meant and who it referred to!
{Really? We do not know many things yet-}
{It matters not.} Blazing Hyperversal purple flames rose as the woman beside him waved her hands.

{We can make a move as once we do, we shall be able to judge just which Inheritances or Clans have been influenced. It is as good a chance as any to find out who our adversaries are and who our Allies are. And since we are using this opportunity...we have to be sure the sprouting weeds are rooted out early as this Osmont and his forces have tremendous potential, but their open hostility and disrespect towards the Avernus Clan means they cannot exist. You were granted the task to eliminate the Record of this Osmont and his strongest Commanders by the Senate- if even this fails...you know the consequences.}
Shocking words emanated out as Destruction's eyes turned cold.
He thought carefully and connected to the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as he recalled the scene of Extremity Kabul and Devouring not too long, as well as the power Svetlana wielded!
He was mute for a while before he replied.

{Okay. But if you have contacted the others...let them know not to underestimate the Adjudicator of Dissolution. She may have attained the Zenith of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity with the power I've observed so far.}
BZZT!
Zenith of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity!
A set of terms that may not mean much to Apex Aeonic Lifeforms, but they were extremely crucial for Hyperversal Extremities!
The purple flames beside Destruction blazed as the voice emanating out was sharp.
{Are you sure?}
{60% sure, when I faced her before, the Unrecorded Paths I could take were extremely limited.} Destruction's reply was quick as after a brief silence, the other voice came out with a chilling light.
{Then I shall ask for Emperor Shao to make a move.}
Emperor Shao!
Other beings liked to be adorned with grand titles when spoken about as most held 'Extremity' in their title to distinguish just how far they had come.
But there were some beings who did not need to remind others they had achieved Extremity by placing the distinction in their name.
Some beings simply went by a single name, while others were known widely by one moniker.
Then...there was Emperor Shao!

When the Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction heard this name, he couldn't help but think of another being entirely as he wondered about the future. He thought of the Hyperversal Extremity of Chaos who still hadn't returned to the Seven Havens.
'You should have been here for this...' His gaze was filled with Innumerable light of Destruction as he planned for the future.
His mission was a simple one.
Amidst the chaos to come, his main objective was singular.
The True Emperor of Quintessence.
Noah Osmont!
At a certain point in time, once one had stepped on a certain path, they had to stay on it and follow it to the end.
At this moment, the Avernus Clan remained on the path they had chosen as they were following a fantastical direction!

chapters.title: Chapter 2561 A Path of No Return! III
paragraphs: The Apex Battlefield showed a hellish scene that left many wide-eyed and surprised at the sheer capabilities of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, but there were beings within the Apex Battlefield who didn't even feel like they were a part of it!
Like they didn't even need to be there, with some of them almost being in a sorry state had the abilities of Dr. Hall not befallen them as well.
These beings were the figures of Grand Primeval Elder Silas and the other Shadow Elders, as well as Roan and the few Apex Aeonic Lernaeans who followed him!

They were in the periphery of the battlefield as they watched blankly, a sense of silent fear ever present that the terrifying titanic figures of Emperor and King Tier Thanatos Vassal would at any time turn their burning verdant sockets towards them!

And through the eyes of Primeval Elder Silas and the few Hyperversal Extremity Shadows who had set off and brought the core Apex Aeonic Lifeforms of their Cult of Endless Shadows in the Haven of Dissolution....everything that was occurring was also being shared towards those who remained in the Haven of Penumbra.

Frankly, many of the watching eyes were recording what was currently happening and transmitting it to other locations as for the time before the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification began...there was nothing more exciting and worthy of their time than observing this shocking battle that held Absolute Dynamis of Extremity flying around!
In the Aeonic Haven of Penumbra.

Within the domain surrounded by darkness and shadows, the figure of Extremity Gabriella no longer held a playful smile as she stared at the images of scenes being transmitted from multiple sources that fed into the ranks of the Cult of Endless Shadows.
It showed the unbelievable prowess that had Apex Elders of the Avernus Clan and the Singularity Overseers on the defensive as one by one- they slowly fell!
All by the hands of the forces of a single being.

"You kept me waiting because you were waiting to see the results of the Apex War. What hidden backing I had. Whether the Adjudicator of Dissolution would truly step in to save me as my Lineage was being decimated. You sent less than a dozen Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from your Cult of Endless Shadows to assist as how many thousands do you have? From all of these actions, do you think the Cult of Endless Shadows has shown me any sincerity?"
The voice of the being she was containing in a Shadow Domain within the Shadow Fortress rang out as vibrant Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows pulsed from Gabriella.
She stopped looking at the illusory screens before her and turned towards Noah as her eyes pulsed with countless unknown thoughts, but the most obvious ones were those of scrutiny and caution!
Cautioning this being before him that no matter how magnificent he was, the one standing before him was still a Hyperversal Extremity!
Extremity Gabriella portrayed this emotion clearly as Noah shook his head with a sigh.

"I know I'm supposed to feel some sort of reverence and watch myself under the allure of a Hyperversal Extremity, but the vast majority of the ones I've met so far have just been so...disappointing. I do not see the greatness and majesty you all should portray as in fact, the vast majority of you just seem...so little."
WAA!
Arcs of interminable shadows instantly erupted as the surroundings seethed, Noah's face seeming like a lonely boat in a tumultuous sea as he didn't even bat an eye!
He instead rose up and placed his hands behind his back as his body became suffused with the glorious multicolored light of Quintessence.
He glimmered of stellar and celestial luster as he gazed at a Hyperversal Extremity calmly amidst Hyperversal Authority pulsing around him.

"I came here because of an Oath. I have fulfilled my end of the bargain as any more delays in this oath, and will call forth the Adjudicator that acted as the witness. I take your actions as representative of the Cult of Endless Shadows as even with your recent malfeasance, I shall be the bigger being and leave the door open for cooperation."
As he spoke, he took steps towards Extremity Gabriella without fear as he continued!

"I warned the Avernus Clan and the Singularity Overseers but they did not listen. You can now see me butchering their Elders in high resolution as...what is the Cult of Endless Shadows compared to something like the Avernus Clan? If I dare to make myself an enemy of one of the Seven Clans, do you truly think I would fear a Hyperversal Extremity of an Inheritance like this? You need to look past your pride and magnificent achievements and not gaze at me like some junior who is playing tricks or making outlandish claims. When I receive a gaze like that, I tend to return it right back. "
WAA!
"Now, what shall it be?"
Silence reigned as the grandeur of Quintessence bathed Noah's Clone.
He stared at a Hyperversal Extremity head-on as the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows began to die down and fade around him!
Extremity Gabriella stared forward wordlessly towards this entity as this whole time, this pristine existence did not say a word...
Who was he?
What magnificent Lineage did he come from? What grand Inheritance was he a part of?
He was Ahpuch- a genius of the Avernus Clan who moved directly under a Hyperversal Extremity!
Very few beings would ever be taken as Direct Disciples of a Hyperversal Extremity- their path already outlined as they only had to follow it.
Ahpuch had followed it.
He attained Vacuous Hyperversal Authority just like his Master.
He crossed the Boundaries of Destruction just like his Master.
And just like his Master...he would attain Hyperversal Extremity Authority as the enemies he faced now would only be fuel towards his path!
This was but a given.
BOOOOM!

Luminous crimson locusts of destruction rotated around him as they ground down the bones of Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassal every moment, cylindrical flames of Destruction erupting from them ever so often as his surroundings were only filled with chaos.
He had been destroying these Undead Entities with Soul Values a bit more than a fourth of what he held as this whole time, he preserved his power.
He used the reality of the destruction around him to regenerate the lost Soul Values as it felt like after forever...
His soul cried out as the capability of {Domain Expansion} he couldn't call out this whole time had finally returned and could be employed again.
This capability took a great toll to call out as it drained over half of one's Soul Value, with Ahpuch paying a heavy price to regenerate enough to finally be able to call out to it again!
And this time, he wouldn't allow it to be taken away as his enemy with much lesser soul values...would in no way be able to do something as magnificent as that again!
And so for the second time, just as he saw the face of the First Commander appear behind a bellowing Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassal, Ahpuch called out grandly.
"Domain Expansion...Interminable Destruction!"

You sent less than a dozen Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from your Cult of Endless Shadows to assist as how many thousands do you have?
From all of these actions, do you think the Cult of Endless Shadows has shown me any sincerity?"
The voice of the being she was containing in a Shadow Domain within the Shadow Fortress rang out as vibrant Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows pulsed from Gabriella.
She stopped looking at the illusory screens before her and turned towards Noah as her eyes pulsed with countless unknown thoughts, but the most obvious ones were those of scrutiny and caution!
Cautioning this being before him that no matter how magnificent he was, the one standing before him was still a Hyperversal Extremity!
Extremity Gabriella portrayed this emotion clearly as Noah shook his head with a sigh.
"I know I'm supposed to feel some sort of reverence and watch myself under the allure of a Hyperversal Extremity, but the vast majority of the ones I've met so far have just been so...disappointing.
I do not see the greatness and majesty you all should portray as in fact, the vast majority of you just seem...so little."
WAA!
Arcs of interminable shadows instantly erupted as the surroundings seethed, Noah's face seeming like a lonely boat in a tumultuous sea as he didn't even bat an eye!
He instead rose up and placed his hands behind his back as his body became suffused with the glorious multicolored light of Quintessence.
He glimmered of stellar and celestial luster as he gazed at a Hyperversal Extremity calmly amidst Hyperversal Authority pulsing around him.
"I came here because of an Oath.
I have fulfilled my end of the bargain as any more delays in this oath, and will call forth the Adjudicator that acted as the witness.
I take your actions as representative of the Cult of Endless Shadows as even with your recent malfeasance, I shall be the bigger being and leave the door open for cooperation."
As he spoke, he took steps towards Extremity Gabriella without fear as he continued!
"I warned the Avernus Clan and the Singularity Overseers but they did not listen.
You can now see me butchering their Elders in high resolution as...what is the Cult of Endless Shadows compared to something like the Avernus Clan?
If I dare to make myself an enemy of one of the Seven Clans, do you truly think I would fear a Hyperversal Extremity of an Inheritance like this?
You need to look past your pride and magnificent achievements and not gaze at me like some junior who is playing tricks or making outlandish claims.
When I receive a gaze like that, I tend to return it right back.
WAA!
"Now, what shall it be?"
Silence reigned as the grandeur of Quintessence bathed Noah's Clone.
He stared at a Hyperversal Extremity head-on as the Hyperversal Extremity Authority of Shadows began to die down and fade around him!
Extremity Gabriella stared forward wordlessly towards this entity as this whole time, this pristine existence did not say a word...
Who was he?
What magnificent Lineage did he come from?
What grand Inheritance was he a part of?
He was Ahpuch- a genius of the Avernus Clan who moved directly under a Hyperversal Extremity!
Very few beings would ever be taken as Direct Disciples of a Hyperversal Extremity- their path already outlined as they only had to follow it.
Ahpuch had followed it.
He attained Vacuous Hyperversal Authority just like his Master.
He crossed the Boundaries of Destruction just like his Master.
And just like his Master...he would attain Hyperversal Extremity Authority as the enemies he faced now would only be fuel towards his path!
This was but a given.
BOOOOM!

Luminous crimson locusts of destruction rotated around him as they ground down the bones of Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassal every moment, cylindrical flames of Destruction erupting from them ever so often as his surroundings were only filled with chaos.
He had been destroying these Undead Entities with Soul Values a bit more than a fourth of what he held as this whole time, he preserved his power.
He used the reality of the destruction around him to regenerate the lost Soul Values as it felt like after forever...
His soul cried out as the capability of {Domain Expansion} he couldn't call out this whole time had finally returned and could be employed again.
This capability took a great toll to call out as it drained over half of one's Soul Value, with Ahpuch paying a heavy price to regenerate enough to finally be able to call out to it again!
And this time, he wouldn't allow it to be taken away as his enemy with much lesser soul values...would in no way be able to do something as magnificent as that again!
And so for the second time, just as he saw the face of the First Commander appear behind a bellowing Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassal, Ahpuch called out grandly.
"Domain Expansion...Interminable Destruction!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2562 A Path of No Return! IV
paragraphs: Ahpuch called out this terrifying ability again as with it, he could senselessly call out waves of Destruction without a strain on his soul!

His enemy should in no way be able to afford the toll of erasing this domain like he did before, with Ahpuch's Absolute Dynamis of Extremity tightly wrapping around the erupting Domain Expansion as he wanted this to be the end of this War.
He would erase the countless Undead Entities running rampant and focus most of his Wrath on the caster!

The visage of the First Commander and the cackling Haven Lich was in his sights as Ahpuch felt the crimson flames of Destruction begin to proliferate out, dazzling Crimson pillars beginning to manifest and even battle for superiority with the mountains of bones as it seemed two Expanded Domains were about to be overlapped.
The stronger of the two would come out on top as Ahpuch was ready to lay his cards on the line!
He utilized the 9 Cycles of Destruction Modus Operandi as he felt all his 16 Boundaries of Destruction.
And he got ready to unleash it as...
'Huh?'
His perceptive eyes caught the visage of the First Commander who was looking towards his direction while shaking his head as if he was looking at a fool.
At the same time, the First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven raised his crystalline skull staff and nudged upwards as if he was telling Ahpuch to look up!
A foreboding sensation pulsed and raced within Ahpuch as his eyes and will turned up.
'Surely not...'
In the dazzling verdant skies that were about to be overlapped with the crimson Interminable Destruction Domain Expansion, a gem-encrusted illusory golden hand formed again.
A hand similar to before and with just as much brilliance!
When he saw it again, Ahpuch's mind buzzed.

The most powerful Avernus Clan Elders who were giving orders and trying to mitigate as much damage as possible with the swarming Undead, Enders, and those adorned in the Quintessential Loot Seeker's Regalia Sets had their faces turn extremely sour as they had thought they would have some leeway to recover and go on the offensive if Ahpuch's domain could cover the battlefield again!
And yet reality seemed to hold an entirely different path in mind.
As he gazed at it, Ahpuch's thoughts were grave ones as he thought coldly.
'Fucking how?'
There were rules and common sense, and this applied even to existences reaching the 16th,17th, and ultimately the 18th Boundary Layer!
Domain Expansion was an ultimate move that drained one's reserves of Resources.
Forcefully nullifying a Domain Expansion...should cost even more to accomplish!
If the enemy Ahpuch faced was stronger than him and had reached a greater Boundary Layer, maybe it would be understandable.
But it was someone that Ahpuch felt at most had achieved the 13th Boundary Layer!
Someone weaker than him!
So how...
How was what he was currently seeing possible?!
BZZZ
The golden hand plucked.
And the Interminable Destruction Domain that was just laid out trembled before ridiculously...it began to disappear before it could even fully set!

Ahpuch was silent as he watched the jeweled hand begin to disappear just as quickly as it came, the Infinity Thanatos Domain in the surroundings only becoming more potent as even more droves of Thanatos Vassals rose.

As much as he hated to admit it, Ahpuch knew he was defeated in multiple areas against this being before him. And even though he didn't like this situation...he didn't turn fearful or ever begin to worry about his life as it was never in question.
After all, he was an Apex Aeonic Lifeform with an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity and had also attained Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
He knew sooner or later, there would be an intervention.
And since the battlefield was getting increasingly chaotic, he knew exactly where to be before the intervention by his Master or others came.
BZZZT!

His body pulsed and released tendrils of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, the area around him beginning to melt away as a massive crack of nothingness appeared- a crack that seemingly held an endless pocket of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority!
Ahpuch slowly disappeared into it as he gazed with might and challenge towards the visage of the First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven.
As if to tell him...come if you dare!
{The Manifested Domain Expansion- Interminable Destruction, has been plundered for the second time.}
{The Recorded History of Domain Expansion has been entirely erased from the Plundered Target.}
{The Authority of Domain Expansion has been elevated.}
His soul experienced a wondrous euphoria.
As Legions of Different Tiers of Thanatos Vassals ran rampant, his enemy actually laid out his Domain Expansion once more under a very wrong assumption!
An assumption of logic and reasoning that he then applied to him.
The moment Ahpuch applied logic and reason to Noah, he lost!
No matter his greater power. No matter the more advanced Boundary Layers.

Lotra's wonder showed itself once more as befitting a Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, the second time that Ahpuch's Domain Expansion was plundered, it was actually forever erased from his Recorded History as Noah's own Domain Expansion was made even grander!
In the surroundings, the massive bone mountains radiated a deathly crystalline sheen as the vertical cylindrical pillars erupting from their peaks began to change.
They became mobile as fantastically, they turned into multiple rivers of poisonous deathly light that now sought enemies from the earth and skies!
The Thanatos Vassals already on the field had their bones becoming larger and even stronger as they burned with furious flames.
All of this was just a part of the benefits as at this moment, the last set of prompts relating to the effects of {Hyperversal Plundering} cast for the second time unfolded.
The reason for his soul feeling euphoria.
{14 Boundary Layers of Destruction have begun to be deduced.}
{The Plundering of the Soul of the current target will allow for the deduction of more advanced Boundary Layers.}
Traversing across the Boundary Layers towards Extremity was immensely hard.
With Lotra...Noah wanted to make it easy!
His eyes eagerly stared at the crack of nothingness and the pocket of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority that Ahpuch had carved out.
He thought he had entered a domain where he was the strongest in.

A domain for him to continue testing out Destruction against Noah as the only paths he saw were either him breaking to the 17th Boundary Layer, or the interference of Hyperversal Extremities to stop this War as no Apex Aeonic Lifeform with a hold of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority would ever be allowed to perish!
'Let me show you another pathway...'
Noah's eyes released a blinding radiance as his visage of Alexander King stepped towards the crack of nothingness.
Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassals followed him as on the Apex Battlefield, the Haven Lich Ra'Zan would be the one to finish off the struggles of the rest of the enemies!

chapters.title: Chapter 2563 Emperor Shao!
paragraphs: In the Aeonic Haven of Oceanus.
There was no earth or sky.
All around...there was only an endless stellar blue sea that filled everything.
Cerulean beauty and wonder was stretched throughout as in a small corner of this vast Haven known as Oceanus, there was a Plane of Existence that shone with a milky white hue.
The entire Plane was utterly empty and void of life except for a single being within it, and yet outside of it in the endless cerulean sea, millions of multicolored sea Beasts swam peacefully!

The single existence within this milky white plane was currently in a seated position as around him, streams of potent Hyperversal Extremity swirled with wonder, the auras of over 20 Absolute Dynamis of Extremity at the very minimum swimming around him as one never knew how many more were hidden within.
He was adorned in a simple white robe, his facial features handsome, but not exceedingly so as his extremely light caramel skin radiated purity and wonder.
His dark hair brilliantly stood with a light fade on the sides as he seemed like a distinguished man barely in his prime!
His pupils were constantly spinning with multicolored light as if a whole stellar system moved within, and a small sword lay on his lap that he was stroking calmly.
He was a man of many names, but the vast majority knew him as Emperor Shao.
At this moment, he stopped stroking the sword on his lap as his head turned to gaze towards a certain direction.
Thereafter, the over 20 auras of Absolute Dynamis of Extremity head turned to gaze towards a certain direction.
Thereafter, the over 20 auras of Absolute Dynamis of Extremity faded while his vibrant force of life became many times less than what was originally being given off!
Not too long after, the blaring aura of another Hyperversal Extremity bloomed as from the skies, purple flames that transformed into the figure of an exquisite woman formed.

Everything about her blazed purple with heat and regality as her fair figure descended onto the milky white plane of Existence gracefully, her gaze slightly somber as she approached the seated figure of Emperor Shao with a hint of caution.
Emperor Shao gazed towards this being calmly before he went back to stroking the sword on his lap, his voice ringing out first.
{Ariana of the Avernus Clan. Are you here representing yourself or your Clan?}
Each of his words were filled with a profound sense of power and dominance as Extremity Ariana floated far away from him while she replied.
{I come representing the Avernus Clan. We are redeeming one of the two remaining favors.}
WAA!

Her words were straightforward and to the point as she pulled out a radiant Extremity Relic with the word {AVERNUS} etched on it, Emperor Shao nodding at her words as he spoke while putting the sword on his lap away.
{You know the drill.}

Extremity Ariana nodded at his words as from her, multiple bubbles of light flew out- each one occupied with memories accumulated from many beings as well as intelligence reports gathered from all of these memories!
As she handed them off, she began to speak.

{The request this time deals with an Apex War in the Haven of Dissolution. We have to move soon to end the war without allowing our Elders to suffer too many casualties, and since we're doing so- we have agreed to use this opportunity to see which of the Inheritances and Clans have fallen under the influence of 'Them'. There is the possibility that the Adjudicator of Dissolution has reached the Zenith of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity as due to her and the difficulty of this venture, we seek your services to ensure utmost success.}
The way she spoke towards him was uniquely indicative of the power that Emperor Shao held, with Extremity Ariana not even being able to put on any airs as she spoke!
Emperor Shao absorbed the droves of recollections placed before him as this was his first condition before agreeing to any request.
He had to gain all the background knowledge on it, who was involved, and what their goals were!
If he didn't have all of this information and more, he wouldn't make a move.

In the bundle of information he received, there was the history of what ushered forth this Apex War, who the Commanders on each side were, what their levels of power and Recorded Histories were, and who they were connected to!
As he perused through everything, Emperor Shao's stare sharpened as he asked lightly.
{Is there any more information on this Noah Osmont? His Origins, any history that doesn't date back to just a few days?}
Extremity Ariana blinked at the questions as she shook her head while continuing her pulsing purple flames!

{The recollections of his movements within Dissolution and the Initiation Step are all included. This is all that was able to be gathered on him. But Emperor Shao, he is a minor part that will be taken care of by Destruction. We just need Svetlana to be reigned in while we save our forces and 'they' reveal themselves, and our Hyperversal Extremities will do the rest.}
Her words were sound, and yet when Emperor Shao heard them, he shook his head while gazing at Extremity Ariana with evident disappointment!
A stare that Extremity Ariana saw clearly as she continued to reign herself while Emperor Shao spoke.

{Your biggest obstacle this whole time has been this Osmont. One of your goals in this is to save the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from your Clan and Singularity Overseers...you will fail in this as they should all be dead soon if they aren't already.}
WAA!

{You aren't worried too much about this Direct Disciple Ahpuch as saving him would be the easiest? This is also a wrong thought; it is likely he is also about to die. You all should have begun your ...!
Milky white light of purity and power burst out grandly as shocking words were carried with them!

chapters.title: Chapter 2564 Corpse Explosion!
paragraphs: {What are you...-} The words of Emperor Shao caused Extremity Ariana to turn somber as she had just begun when she was cut off, Emperor Shao raising his hand for her to stop as he continued!

{This is all for your redeemed favor- my services have already begun. If you want to ensure success as per your request, you need to follow every single thing I say. Pass this along to the others as well. Otherwise do not blame me if things do not go accordingly.}
His white-robed figure rose as he radiated immense grandeur that even other Hyperversal Extremities would pale in comparison to!

{You all have made many mistakes in this whole venture, but the biggest one is treating this unknown being who seems to only have Records of a few days in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, and yet he has embroiled a Clan and a major Inheritance in a war as he has placed himself center of the Extremity Sanctification. Your goal to kill him by sending out Destruction...will also likely fail.}
BOOM!
Like a thunderclap of reality, his words came down.

Extremity Ariana looked at him incredulously as the spinning pupils of Emperor Shao flashed, a majestic light blooming with them as an moment later, a second figure that looked just like him appeared...
and subsequently disappeared an instant later as it shot out towards the horizon!

{My clone will make its way towards Dissolution as the moment it arrives, you all can begin. If you want to save whatever remains of your forces in this War, especially this Ahpuch you all put a level of importance in- then make a move before I even get there. The number of Hyperversal Extremities you and your Allies were putting forth in this...you will need to double it at the very least. And have those coming later wait to move under my command}

One command after another flew as if one looked at the two Hyperversal Extremities, they would think that one extremely powerful Lifeform was giving commands to another as it didn't seem like the two of them were on the same playing field at all.
Extremity Ariana was confounded as she wanted to say this was excessive and over the top. That it would require too many of their hidden forces to move as the exposure would be too much.
But...she held it all back as she knew Emperor Shao's identity.
The Undefeated Extremity.
The Extremity of War.
The Extremity of Conquest.
These were just some of his titles.
He had never led them wrong in their last two requests as if he believed this was how they should move, she would pass this word along!

Her will had already passed along all commands as tendrils of authority leaked from her and flowed towards Emperor Shao- establishing a connection to a communication channel filled with the Wills of specifically chosen beings as all of them could communicate seamlessly- no matter where they were in the Seven Havens!
The countenance of Emperor Shao held a pondering look as he gazed up.
Past the milky white Plane he was in, he gazed into the endless cerulean sea.
As if he could see the very Records of everything there, he shook his head with a complex expression that seemed to hold a sense of appreciation and curiosity at the same time!

{Your objective of eliminating this Osmont who is pitting himself against your Avernus Clan is unlikely to succeed at this moment it seems. Very few traces of Records of him can be found in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as he has likely structured an authority capable of masking himself. Killing him carries the same level of difficulty as killing a Hyperversal Extremity as one will have to get a hold of his body directly and see whether his Recorded History will be obtained through his body. Without scorching everything about him in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, he will never truly die.}
A pristine assessment was given by a truly peculiar existence towards a being he had yet to meet!
On the True Throne of Quintessence in the center of the Apex Battlefield.

Noah's figure was surrounded by tendrils of light as even though he didn't make any moves personally, he constantly monitored everything as the Oraculum Absolute Dynamis of Extremity pulsed around him powerfully!
Everything was flowing in a somewhat expected path as he had arrived at the edge of his victory.
At the peak where a few moves were all that were required for a magnificent conclusion!
And yet an moment later, he felt droves of his Quintessential Hyperversal Mana Value burn along with a portion of his Soul Values as {Adumbrative Viewpoint} was passively activated.
The ability stemming from the Oraculum Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that could be triggered passively when any unfavorable or important Unrecorded History pertaining to Noah or his people unfolded!
Within the depths of his soul, Innumerable Records flowed.
A golden book rose as its pages fluttered!
A heavy record then began to unfold as Noah's eyes flashed, his soul buzzing with brilliance as a moment later, his Will buzzed in the minds of all his forces.
In the mind of his Son and the Squadron he led.
In the minds of Aurelia, Orion, and even the Enders led by a roaring Draconic Elephantine beast!
In the mind of the Chthonian Sinners of Thanatos who didn't really get a chance to shine and the Haven Lich Ra'Zan.
"Wrap it up."
BZZT!
Three words.
But they sufficiently conveyed the will of the True Emperor of Quintessence!
The bodies of Henry and all others began to suffuse with astonishing brilliance as all their Soul Values were drained to unleash everything they held, while the Haven Lich Ra'Zan...

Its skeletal figure was enshrouded in a deathly light as an aurora of verdant black wings expanded behind its back, the flames within its sockets dancing as it released the bone staff in its right hand.
The bony skeletal hands beside it then came together as their digits intertwined in front of its bony chest, a surge of authority erupting at this moment as two words emanated from the Haven Lich!
Words directed towards the corpses within the battlefield.
Words directed to the Prince, King, and Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassals!

Words granting the Ultimate Form of death for even the Thanatos Vassals as their authority even caused the myriad of bony mountains to crack and splinter as if they were ready for their last eruption.
The Haven Lich Ra'Zan called out...
{Corpse Explosion}.
The voice rang out at the same time as in the skies, out of nowhere and with utmost brilliance- multiple Hyperversal Extremity Authorities blazed with glorious horror!

sentences.text: {What are you...-} The words of Emperor Shao caused Extremity Ariana to turn somber as she had just begun when she was cut off, Emperor Shao raising his hand for her to stop as he continued!
{This is all for your redeemed favor- my services have already begun.
If you want to ensure success as per your request, you need to follow every single thing I say.
Pass this along to the others as well.
Otherwise do not blame me if things do not go accordingly.}
His white-robed figure rose as he radiated immense grandeur that even other Hyperversal Extremities would pale in comparison to!

{You all have made many mistakes in this whole venture, but the biggest one is treating this unknown being who seems to only have Records of a few days in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, and yet he has embroiled a Clan and a major Inheritance in a war as he has placed himself center of the Extremity Sanctification.
Your goal to kill him by sending out Destruction...will also likely fail.}
BOOM!
Like a thunderclap of reality, his words came down.

Extremity Ariana looked at him incredulously as the spinning pupils of Emperor Shao flashed, a majestic light blooming with them as an moment later, a second figure that looked just like him appeared...
and subsequently disappeared an instant later as it shot out towards the horizon!
{My clone will make its way towards Dissolution as the moment it arrives, you all can begin.
If you want to save whatever remains of your forces in this War, especially this Ahpuch you all put a level of importance in- then make a move before I even get there.

The Extremity of Conquest.
These were just some of his titles.
He had never led them wrong in their last two requests as if he believed this was how they should move, she would pass this word along!

chapters.title: Chapter 2565 A Flicker of Brilliance! I
paragraphs: Moments before an utterly irrevocable History played out.
In an isolated Domain, a marbled golden floor could be seen forming the earth as the skies were tinged stellar white.
Within this domain, the aura of two beings could be felt as one was a Hyperversal Extremity, and the other...radiated Quintessence!
"I was looking forward to seeing how the Hyperversal Extremities of the Genesis Institute of Extremity came to an entirely different potion...but why isolate us from all the others?"
Noah's voice rang out as when he had sent this Will forward, it had initially been brought into a space with the auras of multiple Hyperversal Extremities.
Yet now, they were in a separate domain by themselves as the Hyperversal Extremity before Noah smiled while replying.
{Some things need fewer audiences. Especially what I have to say.}
"Oh?"
Noah's brows rose at the words of Extremity Marcellus as this being's eyes seemed to hold endless light.
His aged visage seemed like an ancient being full of Vitality and contained power as he spoke in a somewhat pondering tone.

{Your curiosity as to why the forces of the Genesis Institute of Extremity pulled out at the last moment can be satiated very simply. It was partly because I had learned about you much more than others...it was because you were Scouted as a possible Candidate.}

Cryptic words rang out as they came with many questions, Noah's Will about to delve into what exactly this being meant by him being apparently scouted as a candidate- none of this information appearing from the myriad of pages he read in the past day!
He was about to.
But this was when his eyes became sharp as his Main Body relieved a flow of heavy information from Adumbrative Viewpoint.
This was when...
BZZZT!

The cries of multiple Hyperversal Extremity Authorities cried out gloriously and with wild abandon as before him, the figure of Extremity Marcellus sighed while his body began to suffice with white gold light!
{They truly chose this path in the end...}
The white gold light radiating from him caused a grandiose change as on his face, a mask that was half white and half gold appeared as on the right side, the numerals {III} could be seen gloriously.
And just as this mask and change appeared, the aura that Extremity Marcellus portrayed completely faded as it felt like he wasn't even there.
His voice came out again, but this time it seemed to be a mixture of voices of young and old as one wouldn't be able to make out his identity at all!
{I shall be back. Be careful for the next few moments.}
WAA!
Even his body proportions had changed to become a slender and tall male visage as the moment he finished speaking, his figure disappeared!
{Corpse Explosion}!

The words were enough to cause an immense force of terror to rise within the minds of the already dwindling enemies, with the remaining Avernus Clan Elders and Singularity Overseers grouping together and pulsing with defensive reality altering skills to survive what was coming.
Ever so briefly, their souls flashed with happiness as they felt the auras of Hyperversal Extremities blare above them.

The thought that finally, they wouldn't be stuck in this horrid domain of death and Undead as their masters and Protectors of their Clan and Inheritance wouldn't allow them to continue being killed in this insignificant war!
And this moment was when the effects of {Corpse Explosion} activated.
The effect of this ability from the Haven Lich Ra'Zan was quite simple.

For the sacrifice of the chosen Quintessential Undead Thanatos Vassals to forever return to the embrace of death, their bodies would release one last final radiance of Damage Values that were equivalent to 3x their Vitality Values!
Simple.
And yet extremely deadly!
The distance covered was vast per Thanatos Vassals as there were already thousands of Prince Tier Thanatos Vassals and a few hundred King and Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassals.
Their bones pulsed and radiated instability as an instant later, they were akin to collapsed singularities that pulled into themselves...before exploding out with a horrific force of nature.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOOOM!
The sounds of explosions danced wildly as it soon became a maddening symphony, turning into a wave of verdant obsidian light that expanded to eradicate all enemies on the battlefield!
The leading Avernus and Singularity Overseer Commanders turned ashen as their souls released their most protective abilities and wondrous planar domains..
And yet when the waves of explosive light passed over them..
The statistical values that only the True Emperor of Quintessence could see flashed as their Planar Domains were shredded along with their bodies!
All of this unfolded just as the terrifying auras of Hyperversal Extremities unfolded above.
{You!}
An angry voice erupted out at the unexpected actions taken as many perceptive eyes were made to watch in real time as dozens of Apex Aeonic Elders were forever swallowed by death!
As if the one who had taken these actions knew they were coming!
The voice that rang out carried with it authority that pressed towards the Apex Battlefield at amazingly fast speeds.
At the same moment in time, in the center of the battlefield that held the crack of nothingness leading to an isolated pocket of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
"Chaos must have started out there."
Outside the scope of time and space, Ahpuch's voice rang out calmly as he observed the approaching figure of Alexander King.
He had felt traces of Hyperversal Extremity Authority from the traces of his will he left behind as he knew everything was about to be over!
He saw the figure of Alexander King being completely unphased by the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority around him as it seemed there were two geniuses who grasped the same authority among his enemies.

"I'm inquisitive about the secret behind you and the Emperor you serve attaining the capability to use Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, and how you forged multiple Absolute Dynamis of Extremity. If you are forthcoming enough...I will ask my Master to save you to live another da-"
BZZT!
As he was speaking, he amazingly felt dozens of Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassal becoming painted with a cherry colored light of an Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that had yet to be shown!
And their bodies were already shaking with instability as the voice of Alexander came out to cut off Ahpuch.
"Even outside the scope of space and time...I still do not have time to waste on the likes of you!"
WAA!
