chapters.title: Chapter 2566 A Flicker of Brilliance! II
paragraphs: Even outside the scope of time, he wouldn't waste any time on Ahpuch!
These words caused this Direct Disciple to burn with rage and power as he didn't expect this being to not even bat an eye at the appearance of Hyperversal Extremities.
Did he already expect death, and this was why he was rushing without care?!

The answer didn't matter as Ahpuch radiated the power of multiple 16 Boundary Layers and the Interminable Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, his figure also pulling out the lifesaving measure his Master had granted him for use only in the most dire situations!
Something an Elder Scion like him with so many achievements would always carry.
SHIING!
A one time use Quasi-Extremity Relic of utmost Rarity.
It looked like an illusory white wing that released an influx of light- it was a Relic known as The Embrace of the Widowed Fairy Queen!
It could absorb up to ten times the Vitality Values of the user in terms of Damage Values as with his power, Ahpuch expected to be able to contain over 200,000 Apex Aeonic Damage Values!
The Embrace of the Widowed Fairy Queen flashed as a brilliant wing of protection appeared above his head, a pure white light of fortification covering him.
This should be enough as within the next moments, his Master would arrive as the anomaly before them would have to be studied later!

Waves of Destruction formed into roaring serpentine flaming snakes as they got ready to intertwine and break down the nearing Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassals, but this was when their ballooning instability became worse as a moment later...
BOOM! BOOM!
Their bodies exploded with massive force all around him!

A force that simultaneously threw out over 20,000 Thanatos Damage Values as to his shock, Ahpuch felt the Embrace of the Widowed Fairy Queen waver when over 10 of such explosions shook his surroundings!
At the same time...
{Hyperversal Plundering}.
WAA!

His soul vibrated as he saw the visage of Alexander appear above him, an illusory bejeweled hand that had caused him the most problems appearing for the third time as the target this time...seemed to be directly him!
The fact that the Wills of Hyperversal Extremities were descending was entirely ignored by this being as he seemed intent on Devouring a single thing before him, and that was Ahpuch!
{You!}
The word came with a blazing authority that brought everything to a halt.
The expanding explosive waves of the Corpse Explosion.
The cycling of Boundary Essence and authority in everyone's bodies.
It felt like everything was brought to a halt as just before this Hyperversal Extremity Authority fully descended...
HOONG!
A dazzling black light erupted and nearly blinded the wills of those watching.
A black light.
It carried utmost majesty and authority with it as the moment it appeared, the multiple descending Hyperversal Wills had their advancement stopped!
This black light bloomed as the visage of the Adjudicator of Dissolution appeared in three skies, her body radiating this brilliant light even as the skies were darkening and turning murky!
She was akin to a flicker of a blinding brilliance that no others could match as her will pervasively overpowered all the defending wills.
Her veiled figure expressed immense disappointment and anger as in the skies, she gazed at 5 Hyperversal Extremities veiling themselves tightly with authority appearing.
They appeared to interfere with the Apex War of Annihilation as she stood against them all fearlessly, with her might seeming indomitable as if she could take them all on.
She was the Adjudicator of Dissolution!
SHIING!

Her body began to cry out with unfolding authority as it seemed she was about to establish her might and show all those here that the rules could not be so easily broken, but an instant later...a crack in space bloomed as from it, a massive milky white gold finger descended.
A single finger!

And yet it carried with it obscene Hyperversal Extremity Authority as the veiled figure of Svetlana revealed a trace of shock, all of her authority being released forced to focus on this descending finger as if she didn't fully deal with it, it would utterly eviscerate everything below.

This single move forcefully grabbed all of her attention as the 5 Hyperversal Extremities moved in sequence the moment it appeared- seemingly knowing it would come as their authorities bypassed the Adjudicator of Dissolution.
Two moved with veiled crimson radiance as they surged towards the isolated pocket of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority where Ahpuch and the First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven were.
The three other Hyperversal Extremities continued to extend their authority towards the Apex Battlefield as they reached out to the remaining Avernus Clan Elders and Singularity Overseers!

This sudden progression of events was utterly shocking as it caused all beings to rise in shock and cry out, the scene of the Adjudicator of Dissolution being occupied by an immensely powerful dominance of an Unknown Hyperversal Extremity while 5 other Hyperversal Extremities appeared to interfere with the battle being imprinted in all minds.
Noah watched all of this occur as he remained seated on his throne.
Reality was never fair.
He didn't expect to have a fair fight by any account, and so he prepared!
His Vassals all had clones representing them here as they couldn't be traced even in death. And he himself was unkillable as he could leave at any time!
He just did all this because he wanted to expose these grand Clans and Inheritances for what they ultimately were.
Beings that moved with their own goals and ideals- ideals they would achieve no matter what rules lay before them.

He depended on his own power to get past even the interference of these beings as the two Hyperversal Extremities- one of them undoubtedly being Destruction, would at most arrive to find Ahpuch halfway through being Plundered!
And the vast majority of Avernus and Singularity Overseer Elders were nearly torn to pieces under the grandeur of his forces.
So let them interfere.
Because in all this, it seemed he would get to see a reality play out that revealed much more of the Seven Havens!
Events were playing out extremely quickly as just as it seemed the interference of the veiled Avernus and Singularity Overseer Extremities would succeed...
SHAA!
The auras of multiple more Hyperversal Extremity Authorities bloomed.

One bloomed right before the crack of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as it was a humanoid visage adorned in a white robe, their face covered by a half-white and half-gold conceal that carried the inscription {III}!
This Entity stood against the coming figures of Extremities veiled in a Crimson light as tendrils of a Unique Absolute Dynamis of Extremity erupted from him.
Before the grandeur of the three other Hyperversal Extremities who were going towards the Battlefield, 3 more beings adorned in half-white and half-gold masks appeared to stop their advancement!
Their masks were inscribed with the numerals {II}!
Their appearance was an unbelievable sight as nobody truly understood what was going on at this moment!
Above the Apex Battlefield.
Emperor Shao released his dominance in the form of a single illusory finger that forced the Adjudicator of Dissolution's attention on only this.
This was how potent he was.
Powerful enough to alone rival an Adjudicator of Dissolution!
As he saw the scene unfolding below, he sighed while his voice rang out only for him to hear.
{The ones who barely leave traces across History, the beings exceeding the bounds of Lineages and Factions and act independently to maintain the order of the Seven Havens...}
{You wasted one of the last few favors collected from me for this? To probe and see which Inheritances have fallen under their influence? How useless.}
His words were callous as they thought of a recollection in the past.

Memories of beings in the same half gold half white masks that entirely erased their identities and existence appearing before him as they offered inclusion into their secretive organization that spanned across the most potent factions within the Seven Havens.
He had denied them then, and he would even deny them now if they were to manifest before him once again!
This was not his path.
And now, he could be considered to be moving against them even though he was only keeping up his end of the bargain after the Avernus Clan paid heavy costs to gather favors from him!
Fate could be so fickle.

Emperor Shao shook his head as seeing the advancements of the battlefield, it correlated with the reality that the Avernus and Singularity Overseer Hyperversal Extremities would lose if they only sent forth this number of pieces.
It was why he had told them to double it at the very least as after these 5 were deployed, his Will stretched out to 10 other Hyperversal Wills that Extremity Ariana had connected him to.
They tried to conceal their identities within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, but Emperor Shao could easily tell who they were the instant he connected to their Hyperversal Wills!
Extremities from the Havenly Church, the Caecilii Clan, and surprisingly- even some Extremities from the Plum Sword of Extremity were among the reserves waiting for the commands of Emperor Shao.
It showed off the machinations and alliances formed behind the scenes as Emperor Shao paid attention to all of them before his Will commandingly spread out!

The fact that the Wills of Hyperversal Extremities were descending was entirely ignored by this being as he seemed intent on Devouring a single thing before him, and that was Ahpuch!
{You!}
The word came with a blazing authority that brought everything to a halt.
The expanding explosive waves of the Corpse Explosion.
The cycling of Boundary Essence and authority in everyone's bodies.
It felt like everything was brought to a halt as just before this Hyperversal Extremity Authority fully descended...
HOONG!
A dazzling black light erupted and nearly blinded the wills of those watching.
A black light.
It carried utmost majesty and authority with it as the moment it appeared, the multiple descending Hyperversal Wills had their advancement stopped!
This black light bloomed as the visage of the Adjudicator of Dissolution appeared in three skies, her body radiating this brilliant light even as the skies were darkening and turning murky!
She was akin to a flicker of a blinding brilliance that no others could match as her will pervasively overpowered all the defending wills.
Her veiled figure expressed immense disappointment and anger as in the skies, she gazed at 5 Hyperversal Extremities veiling themselves tightly with authority appearing.
They appeared to interfere with the Apex War of Annihilation as she stood against them all fearlessly, with her might seeming indomitable as if she could take them all on.
She was the Adjudicator of Dissolution!
SHIING!

Her body began to cry out with unfolding authority as it seemed she was about to establish her might and show all those here that the rules could not be so easily broken, but an instant later...a crack in space bloomed as from it, a massive milky white gold finger descended.
A single finger!

And yet it carried with it obscene Hyperversal Extremity Authority as the veiled figure of Svetlana revealed a trace of shock, all of her authority being released forced to focus on this descending finger as if she didn't fully deal with it, it would utterly eviscerate everything below.

This single move forcefully grabbed all of her attention as the 5 Hyperversal Extremities moved in sequence the moment it appeared- seemingly knowing it would come as their authorities bypassed the Adjudicator of Dissolution.
Two moved with veiled crimson radiance as they surged towards the isolated pocket of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority where Ahpuch and the First Commander of the Infinite Hyperversal Haven were.
The three other Hyperversal Extremities continued to extend their authority towards the Apex Battlefield as they reached out to the remaining Avernus Clan Elders and Singularity Overseers!

This sudden progression of events was utterly shocking as it caused all beings to rise in shock and cry out, the scene of the Adjudicator of Dissolution being occupied by an immensely powerful dominance of an Unknown Hyperversal Extremity while 5 other Hyperversal Extremities appeared to interfere with the battle being imprinted in all minds.
Noah watched all of this occur as he remained seated on his throne.
Reality was never fair.
He didn't expect to have a fair fight by any account, and so he prepared!
His Vassals all had clones representing them here as they couldn't be traced even in death.
And he himself was unkillable as he could leave at any time!
He just did all this because he wanted to expose these grand Clans and Inheritances for what they ultimately were.
Beings that moved with their own goals and ideals- ideals they would achieve no matter what rules lay before them.

He depended on his own power to get past even the interference of these beings as the two Hyperversal Extremities- one of them undoubtedly being Destruction, would at most arrive to find Ahpuch halfway through being Plundered!
And the vast majority of Avernus and Singularity Overseer Elders were nearly torn to pieces under the grandeur of his forces.
So let them interfere.
Because in all this, it seemed he would get to see a reality play out that revealed much more of the Seven Havens!
Events were playing out extremely quickly as just as it seemed the interference of the veiled Avernus and Singularity Overseer Extremities would succeed...
SHAA!
The auras of multiple more Hyperversal Extremity Authorities bloomed.

One bloomed right before the crack of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority as it was a humanoid visage adorned in a white robe, their face covered by a half-white and half-gold conceal that carried the inscription {III}!
This Entity stood against the coming figures of Extremities veiled in a Crimson light as tendrils of a Unique Absolute Dynamis of Extremity erupted from him.
Before the grandeur of the three other Hyperversal Extremities who were going towards the Battlefield, 3 more beings adorned in half-white and half-gold masks appeared to stop their advancement!
Their masks were inscribed with the numerals {II}!
Their appearance was an unbelievable sight as nobody truly understood what was going on at this moment!
Above the Apex Battlefield.
Emperor Shao released his dominance in the form of a single illusory finger that forced the Adjudicator of Dissolution's attention on only this.
This was how potent he was.
Powerful enough to alone rival an Adjudicator of Dissolution!
As he saw the scene unfolding below, he sighed while his voice rang out only for him to hear.
{The ones who barely leave traces across History, the beings exceeding the bounds of Lineages and Factions and act independently to maintain the order of the Seven Havens...}
{You wasted one of the last few favors collected from me for this?
To probe and see which Inheritances have fallen under their influence?
How useless.}
His words were callous as they thought of a recollection in the past.

Memories of beings in the same half gold half white masks that entirely erased their identities and existence appearing before him as they offered inclusion into their secretive organization that spanned across the most potent factions within the Seven Havens.
He had denied them then, and he would even deny them now if they were to manifest before him once again!
This was not his path.
And now, he could be considered to be moving against them even though he was only keeping up his end of the bargain after the Avernus Clan paid heavy costs to gather favors from him!
Fate could be so fickle.

Emperor Shao shook his head as seeing the advancements of the battlefield, it correlated with the reality that the Avernus and Singularity Overseer Hyperversal Extremities would lose if they only sent forth this number of pieces.
It was why he had told them to double it at the very least as after these 5 were deployed, his Will stretched out to 10 other Hyperversal Wills that Extremity Ariana had connected him to.
They tried to conceal their identities within the Aeonic Annals of Extremity, but Emperor Shao could easily tell who they were the instant he connected to their Hyperversal Wills!
Extremities from the Havenly Church, the Caecilii Clan, and surprisingly- even some Extremities from the Plum Sword of Extremity were among the reserves waiting for the commands of Emperor Shao.
It showed off the machinations and alliances formed behind the scenes as Emperor Shao paid attention to all of them before his Will commandingly spread out!

chapters.title: Chapter 2567 The Incursion of Dissolution! I
paragraphs: Shock!
This was the emotion that many of the watchers felt as for some, rousing anger exploded forth!

In the far distance, the figure of Erikson rose up with tendrils of grandeur pulsing around him as he stared at the veiled Hyperversal Extremities invading the Apex Battlefield- as well as the unknown Extremities adorned in half gold half white masks whose identities could not be made out.
They were all powerhouses of the Seven Havens as their actions represented the Wills of major factions and powers whenever they moved!
For them to move like this now...
Erikson's soul buzzed as either a somber gaze, he sent out a message.
"Uncle, we cannot sit back as this event unfolds..."
His words traversed into the mind of one of the Sima Clan Extremities in this Haven as the scene he saw was something that breached everything they stood for!
Those with more power very clearly committing wrongs regardless simply because it served their best interests.

Even though it wouldn't make any difference, Erikson had already grabbed his slippers and held them tightly into his hands as if he would jump into the battle himself, but what could a recently advanced Apex Aeonic Lifeform who was merely distorting probability to converge his first Dynamis of Extremity do against the majesty of Hyperversal Extremities?
As his eyes buzzed with brilliance, he received a reply.
{Be at ease, Young Master. I have already made a move.}
The words were unexpected ones as Erikson's eyes flashed with brilliance.
His Uncle had already made a move.

It meant that he was one of the Hyperversal Extremities on the battlefield as Eirkson's heart didn't waver on which side he would have been standing on, his intuition ringing as he came to focus on the figures of the three Extremities wearing masks that had the inscriptions of {II}!

Beside him, the form of Ayame had the same look as her main body in the domain with her Grandfather had already turned to him, only for her to see his body divide in two as another one adorned in a white robe and carrying a white gold mask with an inscription of {III} on it!

{I've told you before that you will be inducted and begin missions after you become an Apex Aeonic Lifeform. You haven't been officiated yet, but you can observe how we move and why we move now. Because reality is not black and white, because the Seven Havens are not perfect Vaults of peace and prosperity as they may seem on the surface.}
WAA!

Her grandfather's face was filled with an age and interminable power at the same time as he adorned the white gold mask on his face, everything about him changing and becoming different as he turned into a man of short stature with a bulky build- where if she hadn't seen this body of his change before her, she wouldn't have known it was him!
Her expression was grim as her grandfather continued.
{It is not yet time for me to move yet, because if the words of Guardian Recorder are true, they have yet to fully reveal themselves.}
Words of mystery and wonder erupted out as some of the prominent Scions saw what was happening and didn't sit still, reaching out to those above them to make a difference.
But it didn't always play out the same way for all.

Besides Erikson and Ayame's Soul Clones, the Soul Clone of Atlas of the Plum Sword of Extremity also reached out to those above him when he saw the shocking scene unfolding and remembering the favor he owed Osmont from the Initiation Step.
He waited for a reply as when he got one...
BZZT!
His body buzzed and stumbled back on the throne he was just sitting on as shock flashed across his face.
Shock that was replaced by outrage as when he turned back on the ever changing battlefield, it turned out that those above him...were on the side of the veiled Extremities attacking!
It was a devastating reality for him to affirm as the Apex Aeonic Lifeforms gazing in the surroundings tried their best to follow what was happening before them.
HOONG!
When Hyperversal Extremities fought, the Havens cried and were torn to pieces.
On this day, the skies of Dissolution fractured as the widespread Hyperversal Extremity Authority bearing down felt as if these very skies were weeping!
The Son of Destiny looked at this scene coldly as even in the face of this might, he was unphased.
"What is written will only come to pass...no matter who tries to interfere with it."

He had already seen a glimpse of destiny through his Destined Absolute Dynamis of Extremity as he gazed at the clashing Hyperversal Extremities around him, his calm demeanor and Noah's unphased form of the True Throne of Quintessence filling those around them with confidence as they weren't broken down in their wills!
{Wilful ignorance of decorum!}
BOOOM!
At this time, the crying skies shuddered as the booming voice of none other than the Adjudicator of Dissolution rang out, her hands pointing up as an instant later...
CRACK!
The skies quite literally shattered.

As if they had been cleaved, a horizontal fracture spread out as the authority of the white gold finger descending was obliterated, with the form of the Adjudicator of Dissolution pointing out again as the other half of the shattered Haven was forcefully pulled down- its immense weight pressing on selected targets here with utmost scrutiny!
{Intentful violation of the Investiture of Extremity!}
Her voice buzzed out again as thereafter, she brought her hands close to her bountiful chest.
Her veiled chest that she pressed on to feel her beating heart as she coldly voiced out.
{Hyperversal Extremity Expansion.}
An utterly dreadful voice seeping of tyranny and grandeur.

An action that caused even some of the veiled Hyperversal Extremities to be shocked as they didn't expect her to call out such a thing here- with so many lives in the distance having the chance of being affected!
But she finished her words with immensity.
{Adjudication!}
WAA!
Hyperversal Extremity Expansion- Adjudication!
For words were uttered, and yet in the next moment, everything turned dark.
As of whatever was lighting up the Aeonic Haven of Dissolution was turned off.
As if reality itself closed its eyes the moment that the Hyperversal Extremity Expansion- Adjudication was called out!

chapters.title: Chapter 2568 The Incursion of Dissolution! II
paragraphs: Immense darkness descended as if reality itself was closing its eyes!
And in this darkness, a white light shone as dazzling round scales rose.
Scales.
Scales that seemed to be there to weigh and judge the weight of the actions of all beings here!
In addition to this, a massive white gavel radiating pure white light appeared above this scale- a gavel that was seemingly there to pass down judgment.
It was the Extremity Expansion of Adjudication!
Without so much as a delay, the white gavel swung down with immense power and pressure as very few could actually wrap their minds on what would happen with the advantage of this Extremity Expansion!
In the pocket of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority.
Over 200,000 Thanatos Damage Values erupted from all around Ahpuch as they shredded apart the one time use Quasi-Extremity Relic- The Embrace of the Widowed Fairy Queen!
The wing disappeared from Ahpuch's visage as he bellowed out with torrential flames of Destruction that absorbed the remaining tens of thousands of Damage Values, but in the midst of these flames...
SAA!

The formed bejeweled hand had come ever closer and appeared right above his head as it actually minimized itself, Ahpuch raging out even more flames as he saw the figure of Alexander appear before him to superimpose itself- his hand reaching out as it overlapped with the bejeweled golden hand that was appearing for the third time!
The Corpse Explosion of Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassals made the way.
The torrential flames around Ahpuch continued to be annihilated by the deathly force of nature until...
TSS!
The bejeweled illusory golden hand entirely became superimposed on the right hand of Alexander King as a tight-fitting glove that came to land on Ahpuch's face.

His glaring eyes of destruction felt blinding brilliance after that as his body surged with Interminable Absolute Dynamis of Extremity, but the authority descending was above it as Lotra roared out with utter fervor!
Hyperversal Plundering.
It could Plunder anything as at this moment, it sought to plunder Ahpuch himself.
His soul.
His very existence!
{Hyperversal Plundering of the target Aspects of Existence has begun!}
{The 13th Boundary Layer of Destruction has been obtained.}
{The 13th Boundary Layer of the Barbarian has been obtained.}
{The 14th Boundary Layer of Destruction has been obtained.}
When Noah had plundered the Domain Expansion of Ahpuch for the second time, he had begun to deduct the first 14 Boundary Layers of Destruction!
Now as he plundered the very spirit of this being, the subsequent Layers were obtained as...
"HOOO!"
Ahpuch bellowed out as he felt like core parts of him were being pulled out.
And his defenses, Vitality Values, and everything were at their absolute lowest as he couldn't resist!
{The 15th Boundary Layer of Destruction has been obtained.}
15th!

The further one went, the more indecent and hard it was to climb across the Boundary Layers as all the boons Noah had obtained were only viable to bring him to the 13th Boundary Layer for his 81 Boundaries coursing in his Meridians!
After Devouring the Fruits of Extremity from his Yggdrasil of Extremity, he had began to make some progress towards the 14th Boundary Layer of Quintessence as he didn't manage to reach it.
And yet now...

The Plundering of a single being had granted him both the 14th and 15th Boundary Layers of Destruction as the moment Noah was able to include this Boundary as part of the concepts that defined him in his Hyperversal Extremity Meridians...80 more concepts would reach this level as well!
The only ordeal here was the inclusion of a different concept to define oneself.
The concept or concepts that one defined himself with were set in stone as the ones with the strongest connection in their meridians!
This was why what one defined himself with was likely the concept to be taken to Extremity.
It was an ordeal for others...but was it really the same for Noah? Could he really not do anything with the 81 Boundaries making up his Meridians?!
BZZT!
His eyes pulsed with tendrils of radiance as the Roars of Ahpuch were ignored, great resistance coming from him as he felt like a core part of himself was about to be stripped away.
The accomplishments of the 16th Boundary Layer!
If this was lost, he would have utterly noth-
BOOOM!
At such a crucial juncture, the Vacuous Hyperversal Authority surrounding them seethed.
{My, I hate whenever that guy is right.}

A voice filled with shocking power erupted out along with an overwhelming Hyperversal Extremity Authority that caused a Singularity to bloom between Ahpuch and Alexander King, Noah's will cold at this development as the moment the Singularity bloomed, a heavy impact erupted that canceled out the dazzling bejeweled golden hand!
{Hyperversal Plundering was forcefully canceled by a type of Hyperversal Extremity Authority.}
{Further Plundering of the target has failed!}
Reality truly was never fair throughout history.
The good lived and died in poverty, while the ruthless and selfish beings enjoyed riches and wealth.

Set rules were violated by those more powerful as they didn't worry about the consequences, with the current reality showing a Hyperversal Extremity actually bypassing the shocking actions of the Adjudicator of Dissolution outside as after she separated Ahpuch and Noah's figure, her Hyperversal Extremity Authority turned into a purple flaming claw that sought to grab Alexander King!
Noah's will gazed at this shocking attack with apathetic eyes his Absolute Dynamis of Extremity raged around him.
And right before the moment of impact...
{Not today.}
Crimson radiance unfolded in front of Noah.

Another Hyperversal Extremity Authority showed itself as in the next instant, a short and stout figure adorned in a white gold mask with the inscription of {III} appeared as his visage seemed filled with limitless brilliance.
Before the figure of Ahpuch, a woman bathed in purple flames appeared as she blazed with scorching brilliance.
Her flames reached out to stabilize a ragged Ahpuch whose eyes bulged with boundless anger and a trace of fear as the two sides looked at each other without a word!
And an instant later...
BOOM!
The figures of the two Hyperversal Extremities moved to confrontation with each other!
It was a sequence of unfathomable chaos as in the midst of all this, Noah counted his gains that were stopped before he attained the grandest prize.
He couldn't plunder the 16th Boundary Layer from his enemy after the interruption of the Hyperversal Extremity, but he still plundered the 15th Boundary Layer of Destruction!
It meant that he could do many more things.
It meant that he could put the Boundary Layers of 10th, 11th, 12th, and 13th Boundaries of Quintessence to use as his power increased another level even amidst this chaos!

chapters.title: Chapter 2569 The Incursion of Dissolution! III
paragraphs: Emperor Shao gazed at the devastating battlefield.
Battles with Hyperversal Extremities were always unique as in their stage, it didn't matter too much in terms of statistical values when accounting for who was stronger.
A lot of the time, it was the concepts that one took to Extremity that were determinants of power- and whether one could win against another!
Of course, unique concepts taken to Extremity also greatly altered one's Soul and granted them a tremendous Hyperversal Extremity Authority that would make other beings feel weak in their knees.

The concept of Adjudication...was something all 7 Adjudicators of the Seven Havens held as one of the tools under their belt- something they were granted when they were elected to the position of Adjudicator!
{Why would one ever seek this thankless job?}
His body was covered by profound layers of authority in the hidden folding of space as he looked at the Extremity Expansion that Svetlana had released.

Truly powerful Extremity Expansions released a domain that rejected any other Extremity Expansion from being expanded in that region, with Adjudication being one of the concepts that was especially deadly as it made Adjudicators at their peak of power at Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity!
Even with this as a boon, Emperor Shao never saw the appeal of becoming an Adjudicator.

{A glorified position that if you take seriously, you only make enemies that make plans to hunt you. If you turn the other way, a stream of Extremity Treasures flow to your side as you forge connections across the Seven Havens.}
It could be seen which path Svetlana had taken by the actions today as there were many hidden pieces here today!

One was the fact that somehow, the Avernus Clan and others had found out or theorized that the Adjudicator of Dissolution was influenced by the faction behind the Extremities adorned in white gold masks, and they already planned to smoke out just how far the reach of these beings extended past an Adjudicator!

This Apex War just became a perfect chance to do so as many audiences from multiple factions were here, and they would achieve their goals of saving their disciples as the ruse behind it if any were caught or questioned.

And the consequences of this incursion into Dissolution today would be the names of multiple factions having been verified or suspected of having their Extremities connected to the veiled organization moving for their own gains...these suspected factions would face scrutiny and begin to be ostracized ever so slowly!
Isolation, growing conflicts, more enemies than Allies, until ultimately...a faction begins to dissolve as its core powerhouses are picked off one after another.
The Seven Clans had been established for eons, but a few had changed names over the vast Recorded History.
The Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity were numerous, but some behemoths had risen and fallen in the past!
Because the Seven Havens were never short of conflict and opposing goals.
And the beings that stood at the peak of power...constantly played games of life and death that granted the winner even more pieces of Extremity!
{But this isn't the way to go.} Emperor Shao shook his head and sighed.
He didn't block the expansion of Svetlana's Extremity Expansion as with its emergence, he moved multiple pieces into the Battlefield for them to achieve their secondary aims.

One was into the pocket of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority where a supposed genius Avernus Scion was under the threat of death, and the other was the remnants of the Avernus and Singularity Overseers on the battlefield being whisked away from the deathly authority spreading across the battlefield!
It was a calculated move that also caused more of the selective existences on white gold masks to come out as they achieved their goal of probing, but this would come at a cost.
The Extremity Expansion of Adjudication was not something to take lightly, especially when cast from a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity!

Someone was bound to feel some pain as Emperor Shao would only make a move to clash against it when their goals were accomplished, using it as the chance to have them pull out their forces entirely away from Dissolution after that.
{Let's see, who shall be the unfortunate piece...}

His eyes spun endlessly with grandeur as even though others couldn't see anything in the Extremity Expansion below them, his eyes covered by layers of Unique Absolute Dynamis of Extremity saw too many things.

And at this moment, they flashed to see one of the attacking Extremities covered by a Crimson light forcefully be shifted across space as they appeared on one of the two massive golden scales meant to judge others!
The veiled Extremity was none other than Destruction as the voice of Svetlana thundered out.
{Did you think this meager disguise would mask you? When I gave you a warning not too long ago?!}
The thundered out as shockingly, the massive golden gavel above the two scales swung down.
As of the decision on the Extremity on the scales was already decided!

Thereafter, shockingly potent Hyperversal Extremity Authority converged on all sides of the Scale Destruction was on as the further down the gavel swung, the deadlier the power would be exerted as escaping this would not be something done lightly!
The figure of The Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction swayed with a gloomy light as shocking brilliance erupted from him to withstand someone he already knew he wasn't a match for!
Uniquely, he would be one of those who paid a heavy cost for this incursion...

Zeitgeist had half of his body eradicated as his soul barely hung by a thread, a few dozen Singularity Overseers around him having used their Astral Leviathans as sacrifices to save themselves as the laughing of a Lich could still be heard in this darkness that gave them a sense of fear!

At such a critical junction, he felt the warm aura of his Master actually appear as the Hyperversal Extremity of Devouring passed over this region- his authority descending to wrap around the remaining Singularity Overseers as they disappeared from the battlefield.

Amidst the cover of darkness of Adjudication, he moved and swiped any Avernus Scions he also came across as the battlefield was rapidly being cleared- with those who had made critical moves today beginning to achieve their aims!

Their plans came at the expense of ruining the golden path of the True Emperor of Quintessence as he was also covered by the immense darkness of the Extremity Expansion of Adjudication, his gaze luminous as his will sent out multiple commands!

chapters.title: Chapter 2570 The Incursion of Dissolution! IV
paragraphs: {The Eleventh Boundary Layer of Quintessence}:: The strength of the True Emperor of Quintessence is not set in stone as it can be interchangeable within his Aspects of Existence. This Layer allows you to alter three statistical Values- being able to move up to 75% of your Vitality and Defense Values to become a part of your Soul Values, or vice versa. Do not be restricted by the bounds of logic of others on what your strength can or cannot do, instead, let them experience a new reality through your own hands!

{The Twelfth Boundary Layer of Quintessence}:: Quintessence disdains being restricted to the Crimson Consummate Tier as it opens a pathway to an ever greater type of ranking that will stand to make a concept truly grasping Extremity. With enough authority, it is now possible to bypass the Crimson Consummate Tier of a Boundary and achieve the Quintessential Zenith Tier. Boundaries of such ranking far exceed others as their difficulty in achieving Extremity is even greater, but when an existence achieves Extremity with Quintessential Zenith Tier Concepts, his standing as a Hyperversal Extremity can't help but stand at the very Zenith!

{The Thirteenth Boundary Layer of Quintessence}:: Just as your values are interchangeable, the concepts that you define yourself with are even more so. At the cost of 50% of your current Soul Values, you can change one of the 81 Concepts that define you within the Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians. The defined concepts taken out of your Meridians retain their Boundary Layers as they cannot be placed back as defining concepts thereafter- a limitation that can easily be resolved when Quintessence becomes ever closer to Extremity. A truly Quintessential being is changeable and adapts to the ever-changing landscape, always seeking more definitions for themselves!
Yes!
Quintessence always showed the path forward as Noah could truly put the means of the 13th Boundary Layer of Quintessence to use at this moment!

There were also the grand achievements of being able to alter his statistical values that he already utilized before this battle began to be skewed as much as possible with his Soul Value- and there was also the wonder that was the ranking past Crimson Consummate Tier.
Quintessential Zenith!
It was an arduous task to overcome, but it was merely an inevitability for Noah.

At this very moment, his Will expressed through Alexander watched as a clash unfolded between two Hyperversal Extremities, the figure of Ahpuch seemingly getting further away from him as if he had more strength, he could have overpowered this being even before any Hyperversal Extremity appeared to save him!
And so, strength he would attain.
His will buzzed as the shocking reality of two Extremities fighting with their Hyperversal Extremity Authority was tuned out.
His commands then thundered out within his mind.
'Replace the Boundaries of the Sword and Essensology with Destruction and Infinity'
Destruction was deduced and reforged under Noah's Quintessential Banner- Ahpuch's understanding being entirely plundered and reforged under Noah up to the 15th Boundary Layer!
With its inclusion as a defined concept in his Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians, it would allow all the other 80 Boundaries to also climb towards this highest 15th Layer.
This would include Quintessence.
This would include Infinity!
This would include the Boundaries that made up his Dynamis of Extremity.
Whenever Boundaries went ever closer to Extremity, their Dynamis would become even more powerful as he could look forward to the fantastical upgrades of their features!
His strength would grow by another level as if was ever in front of an enemy that he could plunder the Boundary Layers and very existence, he would ensure that everything was plundered.

It was uncertain if he would get the chance with Ahpuch again with Hyperversal Extremities appearing- but however this war concluded and its consequences thereafter...there were still an Innumerable number of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms from the Seven Havens that were converging on Dissolution.
Some were Direct Disciples of Hyperversal Extremities like Ahpuch.
Others exceeded him in strength as they were already at the 17th Boundary Layer!
These would be his nutrients in addition to the boons that were yet to be uncovered in the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification.
As these thoughts passed and his Foundation buzzed at new changes, the reality around him also changed as the power of Hyperversal Extremities was shown.
{Haha, my purpose isn't here to fight, you old dredge!}

Blinding purple flames in the form of Hyperversal Authority erupted and formed into blooming flowers of singularities, the veiled woman standing before Ahpuch placing her hands on his weakened and rage full figure as this Direct Disciple disappeared!
The Hyperversal Extremity moved quickly as she didn't grant even the possibilities of second chances.

She seemed to know the difference in power between her and this being before her as she didn't erupt in a life and death battle, her authority forming into an incandescent wall as she quickly began her retreat the moment her aims were achieved!
It was precise, quick, and some might say that it even showed traces of cowardice.
But this being had thought of the larger picture and what they were here to do as she decisively made her moves!
The short and stout figure with the white gold mask was radiating a crimson gold aurora of light that caused the purple flames to fade the moment they neared, his gaze piercing as he didn't chase.
He knew that the moment he did so, this genius behind him would be targeted by another Hyperversal Extremity as his actions would be for naught!

{The one you follow was targeted by the veiled Destruction as he is being taken care of by the Adjudicator. Since our goal is to currently protect, we are restricted somewhat, and I know this may be a disappointing result for what you all envisioned in this War.}
The short and stout Hyperversal Extremity spoke lightly as the purple flames faded, Noah not saying anything at this moment as he watched this being turn around and face him.
Was he just the tiniest bit disappointed? Yes. But he had attained booms that took others millions or billions of years in the span of minutes!
The 14th and 15th Boundary Layers alone were enough to make this war a tremendous success as it didn't just mean getting a single Boundary to the 15th Layer for him.
It meant getting 81 Boundaries to the 15th Layer!
A ridiculous reality that any beings who learned of it would cry out unfairness!
And then, there was the fact that Haven Lich Ra'Zan and his Vassals had eradicated over 80% of all the forces of the Avernus Clan and the Singularity Overseers.
The prompts for all of their Loot...they were enough for him to browse through for hours!
As he took on the gaze of the Hyperversal Extremity before him, Noah's voice came out calmly as Alexander King.
"This war is far from over. It is an Apex War of Annihilation as at this very moment...the Infinite Hyperversal Haven has not achieved the complete Annihilation of all of its participants!"
WAA!
His words carried a terrific Will that caused this Extremity before him who was seeking a type of Infinity to state with Innumerable thoughts.
"When the Avernus Clan and Singularity Overseers are reduced to nothing but rubble and bones like the Noblesse, then...they have our authorization to deem this War done."

Alexander's skeletal Armaments shone with a profound luster as he waved his staff, the few remaining Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassals crying out with bony jaws as outside of this pocket of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority, shocking events continued to unfold!
Events that were flowing in a certain direction because of one person's commands as his appearance changed many possible paths today!
One of these paths was a particular Hyperversal Extremity.

Even though his Direct Disciple was saved, Destruction himself had landed in a dangerous dilemma as he was coercively placed on the Scales of Adjudication while the Gavel of Adjudication continued to press down!

chapters.title: Chapter 2571 That Sword!
paragraphs: In the hidden folds of space near the Apex Battlefield.
The visage of Ahpuch was spat out of purple flames with an ashen gaze as the figure of Extremity Ariana appeared soon after, her gaze ferocious as she spoke.
{Did you manage to track all the Extremities that made a move?}
The question was not for Ahpuch, but towards a communication channel that held the will of another Hyperversal Extremity who had not even appeared on this Battlefield!
And the answer Extremity Ariana received was a special one.

{For the most part. The Genesis Institute seems to be tainted along with an unknown portion of the Sima Clan, Infinite Extremity, Immeasurable Mystery, and two more that I need to verify the signatures to be 100% sure.}
The reason for their actions.
The purpose of their probe!
Extremity Ariana's eyes flashed as she heard these words and she nodded while replying just as quickly.
{Then we can begin pulling out now. Remember, our goal isn't to fight today!}

She allowed this message to flow freely across the multiple Hyperversal Extremities she was working with as when she gazed at the complete darkness before her brought about by the Extremity Expansion of Adjudication, she could see the struggling figure of Destruction as she snorted without feeling too sorry!
Mind you, this was a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.

His authority was raging around him and barely hanging on as the Gavel of Adjudication swung down, but if it was a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity that was placed on the scales...Svetlana would have been able to easily crush them and erase their Recorded History by now!
But...
{Continue to be weak...}
She didn't target any of the Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities as the moment she did so, it would mean that an Adjudicator had actually made a move to kill a Hyperversal Extremity of the Seven Havens!
How grand would such an occasion be?

How fantastical of an opportunity would it be! They could have utilized such a reality to actually shake her seat of an Adjudicator as thereafter, someone they favored would be supported to step up and be elevated to this grand pedestal!

But Svetlana moved carefully as she chose one of their stronger combatants and pressed down Adjudication unto them, this authority seeping directly into the Soul of Hyperversal Extremities as its damage was directly on the Concepts one expanded to Extremity!
This was the type of power awarded to Adjudicators- one that made them powerhouses nobody wished to go against in the Seven Havens.

Because of their granted Hyperversal Extremity Authority that didn't touch one's Vitality Values, but they simply attacked one's records and scorched even Concepts that had achieved Extremity to oblivion.
It was utterly dreadful.
Even Extremity Ariana felt a sense of apprehension when she gazed at it as at this moment, she reached out to the person moving behind the scenes.
{Emperor Shao, can you move to provide an opportunity for retreat? Destruction seems to be in a tight spo-}
OOOOH!

Before her words could even finish, the situation seemed to change dramatically on the Scales of the Expanded Extremity as Destruction cried out in immense shock and anger, his voice chilling and seething as it echoed out!
{You...would actually dare?!}
It was a voice of shock as it realized the length that this Adjudicator was willing to go.
It was because at this moment, The Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction felt the Gavel of Adjudication swinging down targeted none of the Concepts he had achieved Extremity in...but a single one.
The concept he defined himself with.
The concept that became his moniker.
The concept that was his name!
BOOOM!
The Gavel of Adjudication actually had its unstoppable authority attack the very concept of Destruction within him!
{You all seem to think I will not act as you move rampantly...so let me show you.}
Svetlana's voice was cold as even while her figure couldn't be seen, the gavel above seemed to press down with even more gravity as Destruction screamed out!

Destruction's body was bathed in crimson splendor as he roared out maddeningly, but he seemed to be anchored onto the scale he was on as he could not leave- being forced to watch as the Authority of Adjudication seeped into his soul and burn his most prized concept.
It was stably entrenched in Extremity as he had elevated this concept to stand far above any others at the same stage.
Yet now, it seemed to be forcefully burnt from his very soul while the defenses he set up continued to be bypassed!
This was the terror of a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.
Once one made their mind and faced another existence that was also Tier 3...their victory would be a certainty!
{OOH!}
Destruction's roars continued to resound as in the next moment...
All sound was canceled.
In the center of the Extremity Expansion of Adjudication, Svetlana raised her head as her eyes turned sharp.
There, in the midst of all this darkness, a point of light appeared.

It very quickly brightened as its appearance was seen by all, taking on the form of a dazzling white sword that seemed to be formed by tendrils of multiple Unique Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that had at their base terrifying concepts that had achieved Extremity!

The moment this sword appeared, all Hyperversal Extremities present felt as if their souls could be cut the moment it swung- with the weaker ones getting a feeling that it could eradicate everything about them and their history with a swing!
It didn't seem like an illusory sword.
It seemed as if an Armament of Extremity had come to life as an instant later, it swung down.
Blinding endless light radiated from it as shockingly, the moment it swung...the vast and endless domain of Adjudication laid out...was cut.
Cut!

Cleanly, a brilliant slight of light formed in the skies and only expanded from there as from a reality of immense darkness, it seemed like this sword shimmering with endless white light was the only thing that was here!
A single sword of white light...cut through the Extremity Expansion of Adjudication.
The cornerstone of an Adjudicator!
When seeing this scene, the scalps of all Hyperversal Extremities present tingled.
The being behind that sword strike...
It seemed like very few if any of them would be his match as at this moment, complete white brilliance covered everything!

sentences.text: In the hidden folds of space near the Apex Battlefield.
The visage of Ahpuch was spat out of purple flames with an ashen gaze as the figure of Extremity Ariana appeared soon after, her gaze ferocious as she spoke.
{Did you manage to track all the Extremities that made a move?}
The question was not for Ahpuch, but towards a communication channel that held the will of another Hyperversal Extremity who had not even appeared on this Battlefield!
And the answer Extremity Ariana received was a special one.
{For the most part.
The Genesis Institute seems to be tainted along with an unknown portion of the Sima Clan, Infinite Extremity, Immeasurable Mystery, and two more that I need to verify the signatures to be 100% sure.}
The reason for their actions.
The purpose of their probe!
Extremity Ariana's eyes flashed as she heard these words and she nodded while replying just as quickly.
{Then we can begin pulling out now.
Remember, our goal isn't to fight today!}

She allowed this message to flow freely across the multiple Hyperversal Extremities she was working with as when she gazed at the complete darkness before her brought about by the Extremity Expansion of Adjudication, she could see the struggling figure of Destruction as she snorted without feeling too sorry!
Mind you, this was a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.

His authority was raging around him and barely hanging on as the Gavel of Adjudication swung down, but if it was a Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremity that was placed on the scales...Svetlana would have been able to easily crush them and erase their Recorded History by now!
But...
{Continue to be weak...}
She didn't target any of the Tier 2 Hyperversal Extremities as the moment she did so, it would mean that an Adjudicator had actually made a move to kill a Hyperversal Extremity of the Seven Havens!
How grand would such an occasion be?
How fantastical of an opportunity would it be!
They could have utilized such a reality to actually shake her seat of an Adjudicator as thereafter, someone they favored would be supported to step up and be elevated to this grand pedestal!

But Svetlana moved carefully as she chose one of their stronger combatants and pressed down Adjudication unto them, this authority seeping directly into the Soul of Hyperversal Extremities as its damage was directly on the Concepts one expanded to Extremity!
This was the type of power awarded to Adjudicators- one that made them powerhouses nobody wished to go against in the Seven Havens.

Because of their granted Hyperversal Extremity Authority that didn't touch one's Vitality Values, but they simply attacked one's records and scorched even Concepts that had achieved Extremity to oblivion.
It was utterly dreadful.
Even Extremity Ariana felt a sense of apprehension when she gazed at it as at this moment, she reached out to the person moving behind the scenes.
{Emperor Shao, can you move to provide an opportunity for retreat?
Destruction seems to be in a tight spo-}
OOOOH!

Before her words could even finish, the situation seemed to change dramatically on the Scales of the Expanded Extremity as Destruction cried out in immense shock and anger, his voice chilling and seething as it echoed out!
{You...would actually dare?!}
It was a voice of shock as it realized the length that this Adjudicator was willing to go.
It was because at this moment, The Hyperversal Extremity of Destruction felt the Gavel of Adjudication swinging down targeted none of the Concepts he had achieved Extremity in...but a single one.
The concept he defined himself with.
The concept that became his moniker.
The concept that was his name!
BOOOM!
The Gavel of Adjudication actually had its unstoppable authority attack the very concept of Destruction within him!
{You all seem to think I will not act as you move rampantly...so let me show you.}
Svetlana's voice was cold as even while her figure couldn't be seen, the gavel above seemed to press down with even more gravity as Destruction screamed out!

Destruction's body was bathed in crimson splendor as he roared out maddeningly, but he seemed to be anchored onto the scale he was on as he could not leave- being forced to watch as the Authority of Adjudication seeped into his soul and burn his most prized concept.
It was stably entrenched in Extremity as he had elevated this concept to stand far above any others at the same stage.
Yet now, it seemed to be forcefully burnt from his very soul while the defenses he set up continued to be bypassed!
This was the terror of a Zenith Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.
Once one made their mind and faced another existence that was also Tier 3...their victory would be a certainty!
{OOH!}
Destruction's roars continued to resound as in the next moment...
All sound was canceled.
In the center of the Extremity Expansion of Adjudication, Svetlana raised her head as her eyes turned sharp.
There, in the midst of all this darkness, a point of light appeared.

It very quickly brightened as its appearance was seen by all, taking on the form of a dazzling white sword that seemed to be formed by tendrils of multiple Unique Absolute Dynamis of Extremity that had at their base terrifying concepts that had achieved Extremity!

The moment this sword appeared, all Hyperversal Extremities present felt as if their souls could be cut the moment it swung- with the weaker ones getting a feeling that it could eradicate everything about them and their history with a swing!
It didn't seem like an illusory sword.
It seemed as if an Armament of Extremity had come to life as an instant later, it swung down.
Blinding endless light radiated from it as shockingly, the moment it swung...the vast and endless domain of Adjudication laid out...was cut.
Cut!

Cleanly, a brilliant slight of light formed in the skies and only expanded from there as from a reality of immense darkness, it seemed like this sword shimmering with endless white light was the only thing that was here!
A single sword of white light...cut through the Extremity Expansion of Adjudication.
The cornerstone of an Adjudicator!
When seeing this scene, the scalps of all Hyperversal Extremities present tingled.
The being behind that sword strike...
It seemed like very few if any of them would be his match as at this moment, complete white brilliance covered everything!

chapters.title: Chapter 2572 Overpowered At Its Best! I
paragraphs: In this moment of blinding brilliance, Hyperversal Extremities began to make their retreat as barely any senses could be perceived.
Even sound seemed to be cut off, and yet towards the last moments...a hoarse cry could be heard echoing out across the lands!
{17th Layer...17th Layer!}
A voice cried out amidst the blinding whiteness as it was not a joyful one.
It was one of utter shock and pain as if it was a parent witnessing the death of their child.
As if a poor pauper had suddenly gained all the riches in the cosmos only to lose it all a moment later! As if a sentient pig could see the butcher's blade while they were being led to slaughter!
Very few people understood what this cry meant, but those who did were shocked at its significance.

It was the voice of Destruction as it was in so much pain because incredulously, his main authority that granted him his very distinction and standing...Svetlana had used Adjudication to take it from its standing within the grandeur of Extremity to the extent that it came down to the 17th Boundary Layer!
17th!
And it would have been erased entirely if the blinding white sword didn't come.
The cries were full of pain to hear as with this single action, it was hard to say whether Destruction could keep his standing as a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity.
It was hard to say if he would even keep his distinction!

The blinding white brilliance that cut through everything seemed to also reach the pocket of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority that Noah's visage of Alexander and the short and stout white gold masked Extremity were in.
Thus being seemed like he wanted to converse with Alexander a bit more, but the blinding sword strike caused him to make another move as his body began to fade.
As for Noah's will in Alexander...it was entirely focused on within as a Quintessential change was about to take place.
An astonishing feat that utterly rejected nature was the only way that Noah's path could be described.
The closer one went towards Extremity, the more arduous and slower it was!

But it seemed that Noah was becoming even swifter as he had crossed the thresholds of the 10th, 11th, 12th, 13th, 14th, and 15th Boundary Layers far faster than when he scaled the 1st to the 9th Boundary Layer!
But the moment that the 16th Layer was in sight, a Hyperversal Extremity had intervened.
This didn't matter as regardless, Noah had swapped Boundaries and infused Infinity and Destruction into his Meridians.

The effects of this bloomed now as in the body of Alexander, he looked at the gradually disappearing figure white gold masked Hyperversal Extremity before him while his visage turned crystalline and translucent!
{Infinity has been added to the concepts that define you.}
{Destruction has been added to the concepts that define you.}
BZZT!
{The upper Layer of all Boundaries in the Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians has been set to 15!}

Now, the changes of achieving the 15th Boundary Layer of Destruction were being applied as Noah's Quintessential Hyperversal Extremity Meridians activated their function, the 80 other Boundaries within breaking past the 13th Boundary Layer with utter ease!
And one must remember, common existences raised a few boundaries across Layers at a time as they slowly grew in power.

Accomplished Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who held ranges of 10,000-20,000 Apex Soul Values would slowly scale towards 30,000 and 40,000 Values over the years as they further refined their souls with the concepts of Extremity through pristine Circulation Modus Operandi, even adding Dynamis into this as they became more powerful!
Noah took a different route.
Instead of a few Boundaries slowly crossing the layers, 80 Boundaries did so all at once as the explosive rise in power...
Was utterly obscene!
So obscene that his Foundation made his body seem like a celestial treasure, turning crystalline and translucent as the 81 Meridians within could be seen clearly only under Noah's Will!
The Concepts of Extremity within the Meridians were akin to rivers of blood flowing through them, each of them taking a different color as they circulated with profound fervor at this moment!
A Boundary Layer for any of the heightened Boundaries could add a few hundred Values if not more as they became elevated.
Other Boundary Layers unlocked unique features that would only make Noah more broken.
And of course, the Layers of the Decreta, Natural Laws, and Fundamental Natural Laws getting closer to Extremity meant grand transformations for the Infinite Hyperversal Haven as well!
{The 15th Boundary Layer of Quintessence has been achieved.}
{The 15th Boundary Layer of Loot has been achieved.}
{The 15th Boundary Layer of Manadynamics has been achieved.}
{The 15th Boundary Layer of Blood has been achieved.}
{The 15th Boundary Layer of Dreams has been achieved.}
{The 15th Boundary Layer of Infinity has been achieved.}

Every time that one of these shockingly pristine Consummate Boundaries arrived at an even higher stage, his body pulsed and exploded with a shocking aura as either entirely broken abilities were being granted, or heavy increases to Soul Values and other Values were being added!
And in addition to all this...
{All Dynamis of Extremity converged by your concepts are undergoing Quintessential elevation.}
{New Features have been forged in all Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!}
{Prior Features of all Dynamis of Extremity have experienced a Quintessential advancement!}
His body shone with incandescent splendor as he seemed like a reborn celestial creature from the early eons of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!
His Meridians seemed like pathways for all creatures to follow as 81 dazzling concepts flowed within, a great deal of things coming to fruition as some...were much more important than others.
There was one thing that could not be missed.
It flowed pristinely along with the countless other prompts, but Noah brought it up to the forefront as it appeared before his eyes at this moment.

{The Fourteenth Boundary Layer of Quintessence}:: Boundaries are the foundation of your strength, and their Convergence into Dynamis elevates them to another level that allows the representation of what they stand for in unfathomable ways. For the expense of 75% of your current Soul Values, this Layer of Quintessence allows you to take already converged Dynamis of Extremity and be capable of modifying their Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity by adding or removing any concepts, the only thing to be cautious of being the resonance and compatibility of the remaining concepts....

chapters.title: Chapter 2573 Overpowered At Its Best! II
paragraphs: 2573 Overpowered At Its Best! II
The 14th Boundary Layer of Quintessence was simply maddening!
Once a Dynamis of Extremity was forged, it was set in stone.
If one wanted to create something similar but with additional concepts or different concepts, they had to converge a brand new dynamis and examine out its compatibility!
But Quintessence looked at such a reality and chose to give it the middle finger.

It told Noah on its 14th Boundary Layer that he could add and eliminate Concepts from Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity as he wished- the only thing being a high cost as to him, the cost didn't matter!
His Quintessential Hyperversal Mana Value took care of nearly all of his asset costs instead of the required Soul Values.

He would be able to freely add and remove multiple concepts even if the cost was stated to be 75% of his total Soul Values Per concept as the main thing here...was that he could enhance his Absolute Dynamis of Extremity into Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity!
All of these surprises...stemmed from a single Boundary of Quintessence.
What others may consider a dead path because it was simply too grand.
A path that could not be taken to Extremity!
It fell along the same lines as the concept of Infinity.

The Boundary Layers of this concept...were part of the core reason that Noah's visage of Alexander was currently shining with translucent and crystalline light as if his very body was a young Armament of Extremity being forged!
His fantastical changes had only just begun to unfold.

But outside of this, events continued to spill out around the Apex Battlefield as the blinding sword light that cut open Adjudication continued to blind all beings for a few seconds, and when it finally died down...
The scene revealed was one to stare at in wonder and wonder.

Fantastically, the only figure to be seen in the skies was the Adjudicator of Dissolution who currently had tendrils of profound authority raging around her- the auras of other Hyperversal Extremities nowhere to be seen.
It was as if they were never here to begin with!
As if a shocking battle had not just taken place.
The ones veiled with Hyperversal Extremity Authority who attacked were nowhere to be seen, and the ones wearing white gold masks who had appeared were also nowhere to be seen!

The Apex Battlefield below showed rows of Enders of Nature standing fearlessly, valiant Apex Aeonic Lifeforms adorned with white gold Armaments floating in front of them with valor as around them...deathly wheelies ran rampant as a certain lich collected corpses nonchalantly as if nothing else was happening around it.

A few massive Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassals could be seen in the background along with the sorry figures of Primeval Elder Silas, Roan, and other remnants from the Cult of Endless Shadows as they stared around them breathlessly.
The spectators who were blinded by darkness and then light this whole time could finally see again as they drew sharp breaths when the scene became clear!

On the battlefield, the only thing left behind of the Avernus and Singularity Overseer Elders were corpses that a cackling Haven Lich was collecting with glee, all others being whisked away as approximately 15-20% of the forces of powerful Apex Aeonic Lifeforms were saved.
But all others faced a devastating loss as the eyes of many beings couldn't help but focus on the man still seated on the multicolored throne in all this.
He hadn't moved a muscle.
He had grandly sat and watched over everything as even now, his eyes seemed to gaze around their audiences with scrutiny as if he was looking for the attackers that had come and gone from among them!
Far in the distance, the figure of Erikson grandly fell back on his seat as...
"Fucking hell..." He put his slippers back on his feet while rubbing his brows, this whole reality being an utter headache as too many significant things happened.
Ayame's eyes shone brilliantly as beside her, Atlas had a clouded expression as moments later...
"You guys will have to excuse me for a while."
He rose from the vessel of Erikson and disappeared into a burst of Plum petals as too many things seemed to be on his mind!
CAA!
And at this time, a fearsome cry of authority rang out as the figure of the Adjudicator of Dissolution gazed at the masses.
Her piercing eyes seemed to cross across all veils and land on the souls of all beings here as her fearsome voice reverberated out with a hint of clear anger!
[Today, multiple parties from a Clan and Inheritances violated the Investiture of Extremity as they believed their power and standing would mean there would be no consequences!]
WAA!

[You may disguise yourselves and use the darkness as a cover, but you know who you are! You know...since today, I stripped the very defining Concept of Extremity from one of you. Since you do not seem to hold the decorum of a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity, you can back down to Tier 2!]
Her words were utterly callous as the skies seethed at her taunting!
She knew who the culprits were.
The culprits knew exactly what she was talking about.
In the distance, one could almost hear the howls of a maddened Hyperversal Extremity who seemed to be getting held back from appearing due to the taunts of the Adjudicator!
As for the audiences across the myriad of Inheritance and Clans here...
They drew sharp breaths at the words of the Adjudicator.
She had stripped the authority of a Hyperversal Extremity from Tier 3 to Tier 2.
Very few beings even knew the true distinction between Tier 1 Hyperversal Extremities and those who were Tier 2 and Tier 3!
But it was broadly known that the requirement for one to be elected as an Adjudicator of a Haven was to be at the Tier 3 at the very least!
Such beings were the cornerstones of the Seven Havens.
And for one reason or another...the Seven Havens had deprived a being of Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2574 Overpowered At Its Best! III
paragraphs: 2574 Overpowered At Its Best! III
When one truly thought about it in the larger picture, it was a very, very sad day for the Seven Havens.
And yet it also seemed appropriate for the punishment of today's incursion to at least be this as an example had to be made!

If the Adjudicator of Dissolution had granted True Death to any Hyperversal Extremities today due to this, it was hard to say what the outcome would be and what storm would be raised among those truly powerful.
Yet her actions had shown her power and decisiveness cleanly today!
She gazed at all those in the surroundings and then towards the figure of the True Emperor of Quintessence seated on a grand floating throne.
He was akin to an ancient Commander with Recorded Histories of countless victories with the way he coldly gazed at everything, his eyes locking with the Adjudicator as he made his intentions clear!
And an instant later, the voice of the Adjudicator rang out again.

[The Apex War of Annihilation could have been considered over and done with had unruly beings not interfered, but because of their incursion...the War of Annihilation between the Lernaeans Lineage and the Noblesse- along with all those who supported them...has still not ended!]
WAA!
[The feud remains open until a clear victory is obtained from either side- and this time without the interventions of anyone.]
A shocking judgment was made as the Adjudicator made something very clear for those listening.
The Noblesse were nowhere to be seen on the battlefield, and yet she proclaimed the war wasn't over.
The only combatants remaining were the Lernaeans led by the True Emperor of Quintessence and the forces of the Avernus Clan and the Singularity Overseers!

She effectively claimed that there was an ongoing war with this small unknown Lineage that held a grander faction name known as the Infinite Hyperversal Haven and the behemoth that is the Avernus Clan and the Singularity Overseers too!
A fantastical proclamation.

After it was said, the Adjudicator of Dissolution gave a cold look to all those here as if she could see the faces of the Hyperversal Extremities who had pulled away and hidden as if nothing had happened, her gaze then turning up to where the white sword that had cut her Extremity Expansion of Adjudication used to be.
It was as if she could see the being behind it.
It was as if she was committing it to memory and she would never forget!
Thereafter, her figure disappeared into a flash of darkness a moment later as only now...did many beings feel like they could breathe again.
The majesty and anger of a Zenith Tier 3 Ultra-dimensional Extremity was that terrifying.
Yet not long after she left, the multicolored throne of the True Emperor of Quintessence buzzed as the watching wills came to focus on him.
Some observed what they saw with their eyes and transmitted it across the walls of different Havens!
"It seems very easy for those unidentified and with no apparent backing to be bullied and even given the decree of death from others sitting on their high pedestals."
His words began slowly as he gazed at the many peering eyes around him, continuing with grandiosity as behind him, rows of Ultra-dimensional Extremities lined up!
"Today, we make ourselves known."

"Known as those from the Infinite Hyperversal Haven! For any beings daring to seek trouble with us or plot for our demise...you should be entirely prepared for the annihilation of your Inheritance or Clan. Just as the Avernus Clan and the Singularity Overseers should be prepared for what is to come!"
WAA!
He spoke without fear. Those behind him seemed ready and even thirsting for battle, especially the seven Chthonian Sinners of Thanatos who wanted to fully unveil their monstrous forms and power!
The Infinite Hyperversal Haven.

Their introduction into the Seven Havens was a grand one as many knew them from this Apex War of Annihilation, with their entrance being paved by the blood of hundreds of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms and even the bloody authority of a Tier 3 Hyperversal Extremity being stripped away!

At the untimely conclusion of the Apex War, they stood as the clear victors. Victors that others dared not to even approach since they had declared themselves along the same lines as an Inheritance or Clan, and they had even made the Avernus Clan and the Singularity Overseers as their clear enemies.
If they were associated with such a group...others simply didn't even dare to be.
Others.
But then there were the fearless and exceptional ones.
SHAA!

Multiple flashes of light went towards the battlefield that had deathly energies being swept away by a cackling Haven Lich who carried away the remnant corpses of Apex Aeonic Lifeforms who had reached the 14th or 15th Boundary Layer- these corpses not being turned into Emperor Tier Thanatos Vassals right away as the Lich seemed like it had something else in store for them!
In the midst of such an atmosphere...

"Let me be the first to congratulate you on your victory!" The boisterous voice of Erikson thundered out as he arrived gallantly in beach attire, the figure of Ayame not being too far behind as they were among the very few who didn't fear being seen merely associating with the beings who made a Clan and Inheritance their enemy!
On the surface, things seemed to be entirely done as the battlefield quieted down...but they were far from over.
Within the Haven of Oceanus.
In the white gold Plane of Existence where the main body of Emperor Shao remained, the Extremity Soul Clone of Extremity Ariana nodded with somber acknowledgment while beginning to leave.
[The favors Emperor Shao has to fulfill are nearly depleted...but we look forward to working with you whenever fate permits us to utilize the last favor.]
She spoke while her figure disappeared into purple flames, Emperor Shao's eyes calmly gazing forward while stroking a white sword on his lap.

After a while, his head rose as he pondered at the vast cerulean wonder all around him, his voice serene and full of wonder as it portrayed his thoughts that were buzzing with how everything came to be!

[Noah Osmont, is it? Since they appeared and the brilliance you have shown so far, it is likely they have already approached you to be groomed into another Guardian. When I come across you again, will it be as an enemy or an ally?]
His eyes were bright as the picture he saw was vastly different from others.
The Records he viewed were those that others had never seen nor would they ever come to life!
The future he sought...was not something the likes of Extremity Ariana, Destruction, or even the Adjudicator of Dissolution could fathom!
