chapters.title: Chapter 2575 Overpowered At Its Best! IV
paragraphs: 2575 Overpowered At Its Best! IV
The Apex Battlefield became abuzz with even grander activity after the War ended.
After Erikson, Ayame, and others took the lead forward, the audience became even more active as this region lit up with discussions!
It was to the extent that a moment later...
BZZT!

A Hyperversal Extremity Authority bloomed as it nearly caused the calm wills of beings to buzz wildly again, their gazes coming to observe the appearance of a man surrounded by tendrils of Shadows besides the figure of Primeval Elder Silas!
His demeanor was calm as he seemed aged with authority, his figure beginning to float towards Noah's visage on the throne as Silas and the other Shadow Elders followed along with complex emotions.
This...was the first Hyperversal Extremity to have stepped forward after the battle had ended as there were too many possibilities with what his actions meant!
Had the Cult of Endless Shadows decided on a path? And what exactly was the connection between them and the Infinite Hyperversal Haven?!
Questions arose as the peering gazes talked of what had just occurred and continued to prepare for the Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification.
As all of this occured, Noah's will in the body of Alexander continued to observe the wondrous changes caused by the advancement of 81 Boundaries to the 15th Boundary Layer.
There were many astounding changes, especially to the Dynamis of Extremity that were made of these Boundaries!
Many of them required Noah's will to peruse their details and understand just what shocking extent they had grown, but one Boundary in particular...could activate one of its features passively.
It was the Oraculum Dynamis of Extremity that held the Adumbrative Viewpoint!

It had activated by itself to warn Noah right before the incursion of Hyperversal Extremities unfolded, and as the Boundaries making up this Dynamis received such a thorough advancement simultaneously...the abilities of Adumbrative Viewpoint became even more obscene!
HOONG!
In Noah's will contained in Alexander's visage, a blaring glimmer of authority echoed out as a golden book unfolded- taking a portion of his soul into it as Prompts began to cascade down.
[Adumbrative Viewpoint has independently enabled to show the glimmers of Unrecorded Histories waiting for the True Emperor of Quintessence.]
It wasn't due to an alarming cause. It had enabled simply because of his advancement as Noah's soul found itself drawn into the pages of the golden book!

[Due to the thorough advancements of the Boundaries with Oraculum, the feature of Adumbrative Viewpoint can now have you experience your own Unrecorded Histories in an unknown straightforward path of your choosing in a Quintessentially in-depth fashion.]
As the notification faded, Noah's soul that was absorbed into the golden book felt 9 roads form before it.
Roads that seemed like grand stellar rivers as whenever he stepped on one of them...it would take him on a possible Unrecorded History relating to his future!
He gazed at the nine roads of unknown futures and chose the one at the very center as his soul was sucked into it.

And before even a moment could pass, his soul experienced passing through Annals of Extremity as he delved into a wondrous Unrecorded History, his vision clearing up to find himself within the Hyperversal Haven!
He wouldn't just be reading or viewing the Unrecorded History, but it was like he was right there in the flesh- living in it!
At the same time, a booming voice narrated from above.

[As Extremity Gabriella took his clone to observe the Shadow Sword, Noah's will finally sought an even grander path of power as he turned into his Infinite Forge. There, days worth of Loot Light that was withheld from Ruination finally began to climax and build the Fragments of none other than the Second Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi!]

The scenes were wondrous as Noah truly felt like he was living through this History, the sheer usage and possibility of what he was seeing being amazing as it felt like time was sped up on the path he chose.

[A day passed since the Apex War ended, and the wall of Dissolution still did not relent as the Extremity Vein of Dissolution continued to rise to the skies of the Haven. It foretold of a Culmination Step of Extremity Sanctification unlike any other as even the forces of Clans and Inheritances that continued to increase in number did not know what to expect.]

Noah's vision flitted through a great deal of memories and potentialities as what he lived through constantly changed, until soon after, he found his eyes staring at the glorious scene of 81 infinity symbols rotating in the Forge within the depths of his soul, waves of stellar loot light cascading down as 100 Fragments of the Second Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operative formed into a grand scroll!

[He gazed at the Second Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi as he could already feel the nonsensical boosts from it. Instead of being capable of cycling 24 different boundary essences across his atoms with every breath, the number was now 48 as this was only one of its boons!]
The scene was one of wondrous achievement that Noah would only obtain on the second day after the Apex War of Annihilation.
The scene was about to pass as Noah's will gazed at the scroll right before him hungrily as...
'Wait...'
BZZT!
The scene paused.
The Unrecorded History did not continue playing out as Noah gazed at the methodology of Extremity Circulation he would only obtain 2 days away after exhausting all of the Loot Light within his Forge!
His mind seemed to be shining with brilliance at this moment as a sense of profound revelation and potentialities surged within him!
He wanted to try something.
Something unbelievable.
Something others wouldn't even be thinking of, much less attempt.
THUMP!
He felt his heartbeat through his soul as once the idea took root within it, he could not let it go!

As his soul stood in observance of an Unrecorded History...his figure that should have only been an observer rose its hand as a unique golden light of a Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity shone from it.
And while looking at the Second Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operan
di...his mouth moved within this Unrecorded History.
[Hyperversal Plundering].

chapters.title: Chapter 2576 Overpowered At Its Best! V
paragraphs: 2576 Overpowered At Its Best! V
BOOM!
The Unrecorded History Noah was gazing at shook dangerously as the fantastical authority of a Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity unfolded.
The authority of Lotra was blinding as it was truly carried over Noah's Soul and into a History that had yet to happen!
Below the dazzling spinning infinity symbols of the forge, a bejeweled golden hand formed as Noah truly tried to plunder a possible fabrication of reality in the form of an Unrecorded History.
And...
[You are attempting to obtain something in an Unrecorded History of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!]
[A grand and impossible goal, and yet the authority of the Lotra Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity seeks to make it a possibility.]
The bejeweled hand pressed towards the completed scroll of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi as the Unrecorded History around Noah shook with cataclysmic frequency!
And a moment later...
CRACK!
The scene of the Unrecorded History around Noah shattered under the weight of the actions he sought to do!
Along with it, dazzling prompts came.
[The Unrecorded History accessible through the Oraculum Absolute Dynamis of Extremity was not stable enough for the conducted action.]
[Oraculum communicates with its Master that its elevation to a Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity may grant enough stabilization to accomplish the sought after impossibility!]

Noah had simply tried an action of utter impossibility through his intuition, and it had actually failed as the final result of it all...was the Oraculum Absolute Dynamis of Extremity telling him that what he tried to do may succeed so long as he adds more Boundaries into it!
Lotra was already set as it could do the Plundering.

Oraculum needed more power to stabilize the Unrecorded Histories as after that...there may actually be possibilities for him to plunder an unknown number and quality of things in the farthest reaches of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!

Just thinking about the possibilities made Noah's mind buzz as he locked onto the Oraculum Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity and the concepts contained within it, his Will moving along with dense Soul Values and Mana Values as the first Dynamis to undergo elevation was decided!
"What was that performance today?"

Noah's voice echoed out from his clone as it hid the profound brilliance within its eyes that nearly radiated wonder due to what a portion of his soul had just tried to do in the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!
His clone was speaking towards none other than The Adjudicator of Dissolution.

[You call it a show...and I guess that isn't too far from the truth. The response you saw today was the crucial part in all this. The entities that stepped forth to prevent the injustice that would have occurred to you and your people.]

They were in the secluded domain above the Haven of Dissolution, stellar billowing clouds below their feet as while she spoke...her environment began to pulse with spatial light that showed forming gateways emanating auras of Hyperversal Extremities!

[They have been known by few across Recorded History as they do not move for fame or pride. They stretch across Inheritances and Clans as only the truly exceptional beings among all others are chosen. Geniuses outstanding in their stage and outclassing all others. Prodigies blessed by Extremity in ways others cannot fathom!]
WAA!

The portals around her flashed as in the next moment, three dazzling auras of Hyperversal Extremities unfolded as existences adorned in white gold masks and variations of white gold garbs appeared beside the Adjudicator of Dissolution!
One of the Extremities reached towards his white gold mask and slowly took it off as the visage of Extremity Marcellus of the Genesis Institute of Extremity revealed itself!
His eyes were serene and filled with age as he was the next one to speak.

[We move in the shadows of Extremity in order to protect it, only acting when all other measures have failed. We hold Hyperversal Extremities accountable even when Adjudicators fail to do so. We are known as the Curagulus of Extremity, the Protectors of the Seven Havens...the Guardians of Extremity!"
Noah's eyes squinted as he watched these powerful entities unveil themselves before his eyes!
The Curagulus of Extremity.
Existences moving in secret across the Seven Havens as their members were the most powerful individuals across Inheritances and Clans. For them to unveil themselves before Noah at this moment...
He smiled lightly while gazing at them and the figure of Dissolution.
"For you all to be here, shall I assume I made the cut?"
He smiled feely even amidst Hyperversal Extremities as Marcellus stroked his white beard with a similar smile while replying.

[You're chosen as a Candidate along with that First Commander...Alexander King, is it? Exceptional Entities like you will carry the torch forward to make sure the Curagulus of Extremity remains a force of great power over the years to come. So long as you complete your first mission successfully and begin rising through our ranks, you will come to find that holding the position of a Curagulus has its own gains.]
"Oh?" His brows rose with interest as beside Marcellus, the veiled Adjudicator harrumphed while jumping in.

[You do not need to entice him like this. Just know that when you efficiently move to protect these Havens, you can gain access to Resources and even the Armaments of Extremity within the Vaults of Curagulus! With how you've made yourself an enemy of Avernus and the Singularity Overseers, you will come to find that you need all the support you can get.]
Her words carried the same cold authority as she revealed the grand notion of the Vaults of Curagulus!
Caches of treasure Vaults that even held Armaments of Extremity!
Noah found himself in the midst of such a grand reality as there were many questions that remained unanswered.
How widespread was this Curagulus of Extremity? Just how many members did they have to even hold one of the Seven Adjudicators among them? These questions and more buzzed in his mind freely!
And as if they could see the questions through his eyes, the Adjudicator of Dissolution shook her head as she continued.

[As you gain more authority, you will naturally attain more information. For now, the crucial detail to understand is that the Curagulus of Extremity exists to keep in check existences who believe they are above scrutiny. Existences like those who carried out today's incursion...existences belonging to the center of power of the Seven Havens.]
WAA!
The center of power of the Seven Havens!

[The governing body that elects Adjudicators to their positions and has retained dominance across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity. Held together by pillars of all Seven Clans and Major Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity...The Senatus of Extremity!]

The entities that stepped forth to prevent the injustice that would have occurred to you and your people.]

They were in the secluded domain above the Haven of Dissolution, stellar billowing clouds below their feet as while she spoke...her environment began to pulse with spatial light that showed forming gateways emanating auras of Hyperversal Extremities!
[They have been known by few across Recorded History as they do not move for fame or pride.
They stretch across Inheritances and Clans as only the truly exceptional beings among all others are chosen.
Geniuses outstanding in their stage and outclassing all others.
Prodigies blessed by Extremity in ways others cannot fathom!]
WAA!

The portals around her flashed as in the next moment, three dazzling auras of Hyperversal Extremities unfolded as existences adorned in white gold masks and variations of white gold garbs appeared beside the Adjudicator of Dissolution!
One of the Extremities reached towards his white gold mask and slowly took it off as the visage of Extremity Marcellus of the Genesis Institute of Extremity revealed itself!
His eyes were serene and filled with age as he was the next one to speak.
[We move in the shadows of Extremity in order to protect it, only acting when all other measures have failed.
We hold Hyperversal Extremities accountable even when Adjudicators fail to do so.
We are known as the Curagulus of Extremity, the Protectors of the Seven Havens...the Guardians of Extremity!"
Noah's eyes squinted as he watched these powerful entities unveil themselves before his eyes!
The Curagulus of Extremity.
Existences moving in secret across the Seven Havens as their members were the most powerful individuals across Inheritances and Clans.
For them to unveil themselves before Noah at this moment...
He smiled lightly while gazing at them and the figure of Dissolution.
"For you all to be here, shall I assume I made the cut?"
He smiled feely even amidst Hyperversal Extremities as Marcellus stroked his white beard with a similar smile while replying.
[You're chosen as a Candidate along with that First Commander...Alexander King, is it?
Exceptional Entities like you will carry the torch forward to make sure the Curagulus of Extremity remains a force of great power over the years to come.
So long as you complete your first mission successfully and begin rising through our ranks, you will come to find that holding the position of a Curagulus has its own gains.]
"Oh?" His brows rose with interest as beside Marcellus, the veiled Adjudicator harrumphed while jumping in.
[You do not need to entice him like this.
Just know that when you efficiently move to protect these Havens, you can gain access to Resources and even the Armaments of Extremity within the Vaults of Curagulus!
With how you've made yourself an enemy of Avernus and the Singularity Overseers, you will come to find that you need all the support you can get.]
Her words carried the same cold authority as she revealed the grand notion of the Vaults of Curagulus!
Caches of treasure Vaults that even held Armaments of Extremity!
Noah found himself in the midst of such a grand reality as there were many questions that remained unanswered.
How widespread was this Curagulus of Extremity?
Just how many members did they have to even hold one of the Seven Adjudicators among them?
These questions and more buzzed in his mind freely!
And as if they could see the questions through his eyes, the Adjudicator of Dissolution shook her head as she continued.
[As you gain more authority, you will naturally attain more information.
For now, the crucial detail to understand is that the Curagulus of Extremity exists to keep in check existences who believe they are above scrutiny.
Existences like those who carried out today's incursion...existences belonging to the center of power of the Seven Havens.]
WAA!
The center of power of the Seven Havens!
[The governing body that elects Adjudicators to their positions and has retained dominance across the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
Held together by pillars of all Seven Clans and Major Aeonic Inheritances of Extremity...The Senatus of Extremity!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2577 Overpowered At Its Best! VI
paragraphs: 2577 Overpowered At Its Best! VI
The Senatus of Extremity!
A global group of powerhouses whose reach went across all Seven Havens for as long as Recorded History existed!
They elected the Adjudicators of the Seven Havens and controlled things to an unfathomable level.
Their reach extended across the majority of the Hyperversal Extremities within the Seven Havens as they set they controlled all the infrastructure and the behemoth of an economy across the Havens.
The Adjudicator of Dissolution spoke about such beings as Noah's eyes shone brightly.
Before him, Hyperversal Extremity Marcellus took out a white gold mask that shone with silent wonder, his wide eyes radiating light as he spoke.

[So long as you take the Oath of Curagulus, the first thing you will be granted is this Extremity Relic that grants you whatever form you wish and entirely masks the Hyperversal Extremity Authority emanating from you...among its myriad of other functions. With it, you can navigate through different records as you will see the different tiers of Missions you can take, as well as what the rewards for it will be once completed. Through it, you can obtain high tier Extremity Circulation Modus Operandi, Records of Concepts of Extremity expanded over the eons, Records of Dynamis of Extremity, Records of the Inheritances and Clans along with much more.]
An Extremity Relic!
It was nothing like an Armament of Extremity, but it was a relic that contained traces of Extremity!

"Who could have made such a tool and mass produced it?" Noah's hands reached out to grasp the dazzling white gold mask as he saw a layer of Hyperversal Extremity Authority covering it, and he wasn't able to obtain any information on it until this authority faded away!
His question was answered with a dismissive head shake from the Adjudicator of Dissolution as she replied succinctly.
[A Legend you may or may not know. If your achievements are high enough in the future, you may even be able to meet them and commission a genuine Armament of Extremity.]
WAA!
Fantastical words rang out as up to this point, only the Adjudicator and Hyperversal Extremity Marcellus had revealed themselves and spoken.
The other two masked Guardians that came with Marcellus remained quiet and mysterious this whole time as Noah grasped the vibrant and pulsing mask in his hands while pondering with a thoughtful look.
His piercing gaze passed through all of these beings as he asked lightly.
"What if after all this, I turn you all down?"
Yes.
They had unveiled themselves before him when they were this secretive organization, so what if he didn't join them in the end?!
Extremity Marcellus smiled at this moment as he shook his head lightly.
[I do not think this is an opportunity you will deny. One of the requirements for vetting potential candidates is already discerning what their choice will be.]
His eyes were filled with boundless light as he spoke, Noah's sharp eyes turning into crescents as he smiled.
An opportunity he could not deny, was it? For him, it would merely be another tool for his path of glorious power!
"Let's do it."
He gave the acknowledgment.
BZZT!
And Hyperversal Extremity Authority erupted from the Adjudicator of Dissolution as another Oath of Extremity was about to be born!

[Repeat after me. I vow to utilize my authority for the benefit of the Seven Havens of Extremity and the guidelines of the Curagulus of Extremity whenever acting under their name. To not reveal anything of the Curagulus of Extremity to outsiders!]
A fairly basic and nonrestrictive oath.
Noah's eyes glimmered with the golden grandeur of Oraculum as he spoke succinctly.

"I vow to utilize my authority for the benefit of the Seven Havens of Extremity and the guidelines of the Curagulus of Extremity whenever acting under their name. To not disclose anything of the Curagulus of Extremity to outsiders."
WAA!
Hyperversal Extremity Authority buzzed and raged wantonly as an Oath of Extremity was established and witnessed by four Extremities!

It was an Oath from the True Emperor of Quintessence joining the Curagulus of Extremity as at this moment...nobody knew just what drastic of an effect this would have on the History of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!
[Good...with this, another exceptional member of the Curagulus has been born!]
The Adjudicator of Dissolution proclaimed vibrantly as she radiated immense power and wonder!
Her eyes beneath the veil shone with utmost majesty as they had innumerable thoughts and possibilities crossing through them.
At this moment, a memory passed through these veiled eyes.
A memory that seemed like an entire lifetime ago, and yet she could recall it as if it were yesterday.
The environment were filled with darkness as a single obsidian crystalline disk of earth floated at the very center.
A shadowy figure encased in utter darkness floated above the stellar obsidian earth that currently held a single life force that was pulsing with a distinctive authority.
Around her, only ashes and dust of what used to be Lifeforms could be seen as the voice of the shadowy figure thundered out.
[Sergei and Dimitri could not survive as they have now become fuel for your growth, Little Svetlana.]
The ashes and dust around her were the 11 others who had been on the same path as her not too long ago as nothing about them remained!
Her small figure now pulsed uniquely with an authority of distinctive quality.
It felt devoid of life and reality itself.
SHAA!
Svetlana opened her eyes as crackles of Vacuous Hyperversal Authority erupted out!
It was the same crackling authority of nothingness that had been surrounding this whole region they were in this whole time!
Within her body, it seemed refined and docile.
Like it was natural. Like her very existence aligned and was meant just for it.
[Your Innate Vacuous Hyperversal Meridians will pave the way forward. Even though you have entered your Second Vacuous Awakening, you are still far from Extremity. You are still nothing.]
The voice of the Hyperversal Extremity shroud
ed in dense Vacuous Hyperversal Authority boomed on all sides as Svetlana nodded with affirmation.
"Yes, Master!"

chapters.title: Chapter 2578 Overpowered At Its Best! VII
paragraphs: 2578 Overpowered At Its Best! VII
Her eyes were emotionless as she replied, the Hyperversal Extremity floating above her burning with brilliance as he continued.

[You raged against the dying light and became the champion of this batch as anticipations are high for you. Like all other champions, you only have a single mission for your existence! That mission...is to infiltrate the bane of our existence. The Antithesis who spread cancerously and encroach upon our very existence...the Vitalis Malignancies that reject Vacuous Hyperversal Authority in their very nature!]
BOOM!

[They refuse what makes our very existence as their Seven Vitalis Havens continue to spread their authority into our lands. We are greatly weakened when we are even close to their source of authority as you and all the other champions will be one of our weapons against them. You are a weapon that can withstand the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority in their lands as your only purpose is to climb across their ranks and prepare. Prepare for the time when we will reclaim what is rightfully ours!]
A light of zeal crossed the eyes of the veiled figure as towards its words, the reply of Svetlana was an emotionless one.
"Yes, Master."
Not a single emotion could be seen on her face as she replied with affirmation.
This memory, as if it were dust in the wind...quickly faded into nothingness.
In the current time, the veiled eyes of Svetlana blinked as the memory in her mind faded and focused on the scene before her.
The scene of a genius Scion and Ruler of a rising faction who had just joined the Curagulus of Extremity!
Her mind entirely erased and blocked out the rising memories of a distant time as she spoke out.

[Familiarize yourself with the Curagulus Mask and choose your first mission soon. Some may be native in this Haven, others might require you to go to other Havens entirely. But after you are accustomed...bring your First Commander so he can be granted the same opportunity.]
Her words and aura were perfect and free of any discrepancy.
With her usual veiled demeanor, she continued to carry out her duty as her eyes swirled with innumerable complex emotions!
The Oraculum Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity trembled as new branches sprouted out like branching stellar rivers of reality.

Currently, the grandeur of Quintessence was being utilized as massive amounts of Quintessential Hyperversal Mana Values and Soul Values bathed it every second- a new concept being added ever so often!
It began with the concepts of Destiny, Providence, Pathfinder, Moirai, Fate, Karma, Fortune, Kismet, Wisdom, Elysium, and Quintessence.
The first thing that Noah added to the mix was Infinity.

The endless blue of infinity caused the golden tree to pulse with an even brighter splendor as after that, the concepts of Manadynamics, Continuity, Causal Nexus, Dictum, Opulent, Kairos, and Uncertainty were added.
Multiple natural laws were added into the mix for their grand conceptual backing as the number arrived at 19!
It seemed to be just one higher than the minimum required number of Boundaries to form a Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity.
The condition was 18 Crimson Consummate Boundaries at the very minimum to be converted together for such a Dynamis to arise!
After such a grand addition of concepts...the Oraculum Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity released tendrils of halcyon grandeur all around.
[The requirements have been met to elevate Oraculum to an even greater stage!]
The golden light within Noah's soul was retained in as thereafter, the aura of Alexander was retracted as obtaining any information from him would be immensely hard!
[The Oraculum Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity has been born!]
[The feature of Wyrd has been born!]
[All prior concepts of Oraculum have undergone Quintessential elevation!]
A monumental achievement was forged as Noah tackled it first for a single reason.
[Adumbrative Viewpoint]
WAA!
His soul called out grandly.

There were many things to explore as the newly obtained feature of [Wyrd] was also something making his will buzz, but he focused on the reason for elevating Oraculum first as a portion of his soul was taken into a golden book that seemed even more intricate and refined!
His soul appeared before multiple paths as he chose the same one as before.
And a pathway of an Unrecorded History began to play out as he seemed to be living in the very midst of it!
A myriad of scenes he had observed before passed before him.
They continued to play out until...

[He gazed at the Second Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi as he could already feel the nonsensical boosts from it. Instead of being capable of cycling 24 different boundary essences across his atoms with every breath, the number was now 48 as this was only one of its boons!]
The glimmering scroll radiating pure majesty could be seen right before him as with a voracious light of tyranny, Noah's soul bellowed out!
[Hyperversal Plundering!]
WAA!
Torrential waves of glory suffused outwards.
A bejeweled golden hand appeared within Noah's Forge as it plucked down towards the completed Fragments of the Second Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi!
[You are attempting to obtain something in an Unrecorded History of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!]
[A grand and impossible goal, and yet the authority of the Oraculum Quintessential Dynamis of Extremity and the Lotra Quintessential Absolute Dynamis of Extremity seek to make it a possibility.]
[An enormous amount of your Mana and Soul Values are being drained!]
The Unrecorded History remained stable.
It didn't fracture and break down like before!
All that was left now was Noah's own capabilities as his portion of soul drew from the source and erupted with magisterial glory!
[Your soul is being put under a great strain!]
His soul felt like it was drawing everything from his visage of Alexander.
Even after endless seas of Quintessential Hyperversal Mana Values bathed everything, thousands of his Quintessential Hyperversal Soul Values were also drained unceasingly!
The bejeweled hand pressed down with tyranny while supported by such grandeur as it grasped the vibrant scroll within it.
And with vigor and unbeatable might, this hand plucked with force a single time!
Time felt like it came to a stop.
The circulation of essence and the beating of a heart felt like it stopped!
Until...
BOOM!
Golden light erupted from all around as if an endlessly burning sun had just been born.
And with it...
[An impossible course of action!]
[The Second Volume of the Quintessential Breath of Extremity Modus Operandi has been plundered!]
Noah's mind buzzed as dense waves of information and authority began to descend.
[An Achievement worthy of being heralded across the Records of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity!]
[Through your actions, your Soul has become exposed to an unknown Hyperversal Authority from the depths of Aeonic Annals of Extremity!]

chapters.title: Chapter 2579 Overpowered At Its Best! VIII
paragraphs: Noah's main body and Alexander King's body were entirely separate, and yet they shared the same soul.
Two pieces of a single being!
While the separation meant some things could only be utilized by one body, there were other things that Noah's main body benefited from.
At this moment, a prompt blazed over the soul within the body of Alexander King about him being exposed to an Unknown Hyperversal Authority from the depths of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity.
Due to the ridiculous actions of Plundering something that did not yet exist- something from the Unrecorded History of a possible future!
It caused his soul to be exposed to a type of Unknown Hyperversal Authority as a vibrant colorless transparent authority washed over Noah's soul!
It didn't differentiate between which parts of him as the moment it washed over the soul within Alexander, it also washed over the soul within Noah's main body.
{The unknown Hyperversal Authority has tainted your soul as unknown effects are beginning to manifest!}
The colorless transparent essence was filled with a profound force of life as Noah's soul cried out with fervor at its mere presence!
And just as it began to express shocking effects onto Noah's soul...
BZZT!
A massive shock erupted within him.
As if something utterly rejected what this authority stood for!
CRACK!
Fissures instantly erupted and began to spread across Noah's resplendent soul as the gazes of all of his bodies changed!
{The Vacuous Hyperversal Authority within your Soul is utterly rejecting the Unknown Hyperversal Authority!}
A dreadful phenomenon unfolded as within Noah's soul, it felt like two utterly opposite authorities had interlinked with him as at this moment, they utterly denied each other.
As if they could never mix.
As if one was the Antithesis of the other!
BOOM...CRACK!
His soul across all bodies splintered as his expression became increasingly grim.
Tendrils of two authorities raged and fought against each other with him as the vessel, threatening to destroy him completely!
In the midst of all this, his multiple Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity born from different Dynamis of Extremity shook and erupted with their authority to protect their Master.
But the instant the authority of the Indefatigable Dynamis of Extremity that was the doorway which led to Vacuous Hyperversal Authority joined the fray to help its Master...
HOONG!
The transparent Unknown Hyperversal Authority roared out as it was maddened even more, its tendrils ferociously smacking down to destroy everything with its abundant life force!
{The Unknown Hyperversal Authority has been identified to be the Vitalis Hyperversal Authority!}
As his soul was getting utterly torn apart, he was at least able to learn of the identity of the authority ripping him apart.
Vitalis.
It was a concept that was the direct opposite of Vacuous!
Vitalis quite literally translated to life or life-giving.

An authority hidden within the very depths of the Seven Aeonic Havens as very few beings knew of it, and there was no record on whether any being could actually manipulate it even though it was the basis of the makeup of the very Havens!

What was complicated to understand was the fact that this authority that was the very backbone of the Seven Vitalis Havens...why was it that whenever Extremities or even Noah called out Vacuous Hyperversal Authority that rejected reality within the Seven Vitalis Havens- no rejection occurred in their Aspects of Existence?
Why was it that one could unlock and gain access to Vacuous Hyperversal Authority through Dynamis of Extremity or other means while they lived within the Seven Vitalis Havens?!
And now, both of these shocking authorities were in the depths of Noah's soul.

The Vitalis Hyperversal Authority was also the backbone of the Aeonic Annals of Extremity as Noah's recent intrusion and action into obtaining something from an Unrecorded History had caused him to be uncovered to this authority, its exposure being something that should have been a grand positive event as it washed over his soul.
And yet...
'Fuck.'
BOOM!
Even as Quintessence rose in addition to all the authorities of Dynamis of Extremity, the raging polar opposite authorities utterly decimated everything as all of Noah's Soul splintered apart!
He didn't even get a chance to question why these authorities acted the way they did in regards to him as darkness descended.
{Your Quintessential Hyperversal Soul has experienced a version of True Death.}
Death.
True Death!
And yet...
THUMP!
Like the beat of a heart, the countless Fragments of Noah's Soul shone with endless brightness as they slowly came back together!
He died...but not really.
Because so long as the Infinite Hyperversal Haven was not destroyed, he wouldn't die!

When his Fragments of souls were about to be entirely erased from existence, his Record remained untouched as in the Planar Palisades of Extremity, the Infinite Hyperversal Haven roared out like an engine as sources of its essence flowed through the connection it held with its Master.
Noah's consciousness and will felt like it faded for one instance and reappeared in the next instant as the moment his fragmented soul began to come together...
ROAR!

The fucking tendrils of Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority raged as the battlefield they were on was reconstructed once more, and their fight destroyed the very battlefield they fought on as Noah's soul shattered into pieces once more!

His Concepts of Extremity surged to try and repair the damage as the Perennial Yggdrasil of Extremity that were becoming shattered into pieces the same as Noah's soul fought with every ounce of their authority as in a short period of time- in a fraction of an instant....
{Your Quintessential Hyperversal Soul has experienced a version of True Death.}
Noah's soul was entirely shattered to the point of true death as once more as just like before, Quintessence shone.
His soul began to repair itself.

His soul glimmered full of vitality as the Vitalis and Vacuous Hyperversal Authority raged once more, the same result occurring again as Noah found he could not even separate his soul from either authority!
{Your Quintessential Hyperversal Soul has experienced a version of True Death.}
Death came once more.
But this time...it took a bit more time before his soul was shattered to pieces.
And not too long within the span of an instant...
{Your Quintessential Hyperversal Soul has experienced a version of True Death.}
It began repeating in a cycle!
